gzhung gi cho ga mi 'jug pa la tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan yang mdo 'dir ma bstan pa rnams mdo gzhan gyi cho gas sgrub po/ ༈ ahno ro rā tri ṣu/ ahna las rā tri ma yin pa la r'o/ /a han tshig tu grub pa'i ahaḥ'i mtha'i rnam bcad ni/ pha rol ming gi thog ma'i yi ge ha ba gang byung yang rnam bcad r ru 'gro ste/ rātri la sogs pa ma gtogs so/ de la a haḥsgrub par bya ste/ a ha n si bzhag si yal/ n s de rnam bcad do/ a haḥ pa ti bzhag/rnam bcad r drangs/ a harpa/ tiḥnyin mo'i bdag po ste nyi ma'o/ a haḥg ṇaḥ/ a hargaṇaḥ/ nyin mo'i tshogs pa zhes so/ ༈ rā tri la sogs pa ma yin pa zhes pas/ rā tri rū pa ra thanta ra la sogs pa ni.a han gyi mthar yang rnam bcad r yig tu mi 'gro ste/ 'chad 'gyur/ a las a la u'o/ /zhes pa thob bo/ ༈ a to ྅ tyuḥ/ a las a la u'o/ de yang*/ ataḥ a ti uḥzhes pa la rnam bcad u/ de o/ ot las a dbyi/ ta'i i y/ t dang y uḥl drangs pa ste/ a gnyis bar du u'i dper brjod gzhung nyid la'ang tshang ngo*/ /snga ma'i mtha'i a yig las phyi mar yod pa'i rnam bcad ni pha rol a yig mthong na rnam bcad u yig tu 'gyur ro/ kaḥ.arthaḥbazhag ka'i a phral/ de'i pha rol gyi rnam bcad de artha'i a mthong bas/ u yig tu song*/ u la o drangs korthaḥ/ don gang yin zhes so/ gong gi ahaḥrātri la a ho rā tri/ nyin mtshan zhes bya'o/ ༈ ha be/ ha ba la'o/ tshu rol a yig mtha' na yod pa'i rnam bcad ni/ pha rol ha ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge sgra ldan du grags pa dang phrad na yang rnam bcad nyid u yig tu 'gro'o/ kaḥ gtaḥbazhag/ka'i a phral/ a dang ha ba'i bar gyi rnam bcad u/ u la o/ drangs/ ko ga taḥ gang la 'gro zhes so/ ༈de dang 'dra bar/ de baḥyā ti/ de bo yā ti/ lha thob bo/ zhes so/ ༈ ma naḥr thaḥ/ yid rtog gam yid kyi shing rta'o/ ༈ /ā da be lo pash/ ā las a ba la dbyi'o/

tshu rol ā'i mthar yod pa'i tsheg drag gis pha rol a ba so sor bsdu ba ste/ dbyangs dang sgra ldan mthong na/ lugs gcig la rnam bcad dbyi bar bya'o/ de bāḥ a tra bzhag pa'i ā ring po phral/ 'di a gnyis kyi bar gyi rnam bcad yin/ lugs gcig la gong ltar u ru 'gro /a'i dgos chos ma yin pa/ a ba'i yi ge spyi 'gros kyi dbang du byas na tsheg drag dbyi'o/ b.ā la drangs/ de bā atraḥ lha 'dir zhes so/ ༈ bā tāḥ banta/ rnam bcad phyis/ bā tā banti/ rlung zhon te dri'o/ ༈ swa re ya twambā/ dbyangs la y nyid yang na'o/ /tshu rol a yig dang mtha'i rnam bcad dang*/ pha rol dbyangs phrad na rnam bcad nyid y dbyangs med du 'gro ba'am/ yang na spyir btang dbyi ba nyid do/ ka lā par ā bho dag las dbyangs la dbyi zhes/ ā kho na la bshad pa 'dra ba gcig yod kyang*/ 'dir a ring thung gnyis ka'i mtha'i rnam bcad la khyad med par bzhed/ spyir yang*/ at zhes pa a thung kho na dang*/ āt zhes pa ā ring kho na dang*/ a zhes sam/ ā zhes gang smos kyang gnyis ka go bar 'dod de/ gzhung 'dir ni gong du bshad pa at āt la'ang ma nges te/ i u ṛ la'ang 'dra'o/ /de bāḥ atraḥtshar gnyis bzhagarnam bcad y/ de a la drangs/ de bā ya traḥ gcig shos a'i mtha' dang*/ pha rol a ba yin pas rnam bcad yal/ de bā a traḥ lha rnams 'dir/ zhes so/ rnam bcad phyis pa la slar mtshams mi sbyor ba ni spyir btang so/ ༈ bho saḥ/ bho la sa'o/ bhos la sogs pa'i pha rol du/ a ba so sor bsdu ba byung na/ mthar brten s dbyangs med rnam bcad du gyur pa de dbyi'o/ /bhos si bzhag/bha gos si/ aghos si si rnams 'jigas mtha' rnams tshegabhoḥ e hi bzhagabho la sogs pa'i mtha'i rnam bcad ni/ o'i mtha'i tsheg drag yin na'ang dmigs gsal yin pas/ r ru mi 'gro ste/ gong bzhin e sogs te a ba la dbyi'o/ /bho e hi/ kye 'dir byon zhes so/

༈bha goḥ na ma ste/ bzhagan yig a ba yin rnam bcad phyis/ bha go na ma ste/ skal ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ aghoḥ ya hi bzhagaya a ba yin/ rnam bcad yal/ agho ya hi/ sdig pa dengs shig gam/ jo bo bzhud cig ces pa'o/ ༈ nā mi noraḥ nā mi las r'o/ tshu rol nā mi ste/ a yig gnyis sbangs pa'i dbyangs kyi mtha'i rnam bcad ni/ pha rol a ba so sor bsdu ba dang phrad na/ r yig tu 'gyur ro/ /agniḥ atraḥ 'di nā mi nang sel i mtha' la yod pa'i rnam bcad te/ 'di 'dra'i rigs kun la dbyangs phral nas bya ba byas na blo zhan la go bde'o/ agn.iḥ atraḥbazhaganā mi i'i mtha' na yod pa rnam bcad de/ a ba'i yi ge a mthong bas/ r yig tu song*/ r a la drangs/ gna yang i la drangs/ agni ra traḥ me 'dir zhes so/ /༈ pa ṭuḥ ya dza te/ u phral/ nā mi u dang/ a ba'i nang gi ya'i bar du rnam bcad r/ so sor drangs/ ya gnyis brtsegs/ pa ṭury+ya dza te/ mkhas pa lha mchod do/ zhes so/ ༈ u ṣa so ro budhe/ u ṣas kyi budha la ra'o/ /'di kha skong gi mdo yin zer/ tshig mtha' u ṣas kyi rnam bcad kyang nā mi'i pha rol min yang r ru 'gyur ro/ u ṣas budhaḥbazhagas rnam bcad/ de r ru song*/ /u ṣarbudhaḥ sngon nas gsal ba'o/ zhes te/ me 'bar ba'i don no/ ༈ re pha pra kṛ ti ka sy kha be bā/ re pha'i rang bzhin can ni kha pa la yang na'o/ re pha'i rang bzhin gyi don mi r yig las byung ba ste/ r dbyangs med rnam bcad du song ba'i rnam bcad des/ pha rol du kha pa ste/ sde pa'i dang po dang gnyis pa mthong na r ru bsgyur ba'am/ pha rol dang sdoms nas ྈྐ ྉྤ ru bsgyur ba yang na'o/ gīr si/ si yal r rnam bcad/ gīḥ pa ti bzhagarnam bcad 'di r yig las byung ba yin/ pha rol pa yig kha pa so sor bsdu ba yin pas/ yang na bar gyi rnam bcad r yig tu 'gyur drangs/ gīrpa tiḥ/ yang na rnam bcad ṣ yig tu song*/ pa la drangs/ ྉྤ yig byung*/

gī ྉྤ tiḥ/ smra ba'i bdag po ste/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal lta bu'o/ ༈de dag 'dra bar/ dhuḥpa ti bzhagarnam bcad r drangs/ dhu rpa tiḥ/ yang na rnam bcad ṣaḥ pa la bsres pas dhū ྉྤ ti/ sa'i bdag po rgyal po'am/ gnya' thag can te khyu mchog go /de dag ni nā mi'i pha rol kyi dbang du byas so/ /༈ /raḥ/ ra rnams kyi'o/ /r yig rnams las byung ba'i rnam bcad ni/ a ba pha rol du byung na/ nā mi'i pha rol ma yin kyang re phar 'gyur ro/ pratāḥ atraḥ bzhaga'adi r las byung ba ste/ ā yig ring po'i mtha' yin kyang a ba pha rol la r ru 'gro/ drangs/ prātā ra traḥ tho rangs 'dir/ zhes so/ ༈ aṃ taḥ/ ga taḥ bzhaga.a thung gi mtha'i rnam bcad yin/ ga yig a pa yin/ rnam bcad r/ drangs antarga taḥ/ nang du 'gro ba'o/ ༈ ri lo po dīrgha shtsa/ ra la dbyi ste ring po yang ngo*/ r yig las byung pa'i rnam bcad de/ pha rol ra yig mthong na/ thog mar r yig dbyangs med du 'gyur*/ de ma thag r phyis/ snga ma'i dbyangs thung du yin na ring por 'gyur ro/ / pu naḥ ra ma te/ bzhagarnam bcad r/ r yig ni pha rol ra yig mthong bas ra yig snga ma nyid dbyi/ na'i dbyangs a thung ni ā ring por song*/ pu nā ra ma te/ slar yang rtsed mo byed do/ ༈ shuktiḥ ru pyā tma nā bhā ti/ bzhaganā mi mtha' las rnam bcad r/ pha rol ra mthong tsheg drag gi r ya la/ ta'i dbyangs i thung ī ring por song*/ shuktī ru pyātma nā bhā ti/ nya phyis dngul gyi bdag nyid/ sems pa'o/ zhes so/ ༈ saiṣāddha se/ sa dang e ṣa las ha sa la'o/ tshu rol sa dang e ṣa'i ming yod pa'i mtha' na gnas pa'i tshe drag de sa pha rol ha sa ste gsal byed gang mthong yang*/ rnam bcad nyid mi snang ba byed de dper brjod ni/ saḥ tsar ti/ bzhagarnam bcad yal/ sa tsa ra ti/ de 'gro'o/ de za'o/ /de spyod do/ zhes pa'o/ ༈eṣaḥ sa ha ti/ rnam bcad yal e ṣa sa ha ti/ de la phan pa'o/ de dang 'grogs pa'o/

༈yang spyir btang la rnam bcad phyis pa slar mtshams mi sbyor mod kyang*/ dmigs gsal la/ nges tshig dang gsang tshig gis mtshams sbyor ba yod de/ 'dir sgra'i gzhung la brten nas/ ma thob thob pa dang*/ thob pa 'gog pa ni/ ni pā te nges tshig gi sgrub pa zhes bya la/ rig byed las 'byung ba'i de 'dra de la gsang tshig ces bya'o/ gsang tshig de yang byings sgrub kyi skabs su nyung la/ mtshams sbyor dang si sogs la shin du mang ngo*/ 'dir/ saḥdang e ṣa/ bzhag/pha rol gsal byed min kyang*/ de zhes pa'i skad dod kyi sa'i pha rol kyi rnam bcad phyis zin pa na/ spyir btang las 'gongs te slar yang mtshams sbyor ba ste/ rig byed dang rig byed kyi yan lag las 'byung ba'o/ slar yang e dang ai la ai'o/ zhes pas/ sai ṣa/ zhes par 'gyur te/ de 'dir zhes pa'o/ /dper brjod ni/ sai ṣa dā sha ra thī rā maḥ saiṣa rā dza yudhi ṣtiraḥ/ sai ṣa ka rṇa ma hā tyā gī /sai ṣa bhī mo ma hā ba laḥde'i bod skad ni/ de 'di shing rta bcu pa'i bu dga' byed/ /de 'di rgyal po g.yul ngor brtan pa'o/ /de 'dir gtong ba chen po rna ba can/ /de 'di 'jigs pa stobs ni chen po'o/ /zhes so/ tshig rkang re re'i mgo na/ sai ṣa zhes ba re 'byung ba ni/ saḥ.eṣaḥzhes pa yod pa'i rnam bcad gnyis dbyi snga ma mtshams sbyar bas/ sai ṣa zhes pa/ sdeb sbyor sgrig pa dang tshig rkang mnyam pa'i phyir du/ sgra gzhung spyir btangs bkag kyang de ltar mi 'gal ba'o/ /dā sha ra thi ni shing rta bcu pa'i bu zhes pa ste/ /da sha bcu/ ra tha shing rta'o/ /da sha ra tha la bu brgyud kyi rkyen iny ster/ da sha ra tha i ny ny yal/ dang por 'phel ba da ring por song*/ tha'i a phyis/ i la drangs/ dā sha ra thi ste/ shing rta bcu pa'i bu zhes pa'o/ /rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu ni bzhi ste/ lha rā ma dang*/ sha tru gha na dang*/ bha ra tha dang*/ lakṣ+ma ṇa rnams so/ /de rnams las su snyam na rā ma ste/

dā sha ra thi si bzhag/si rnam bcad/ dā sha ra thiḥrā ma rā mthong bas rnam bcad r ru song*/ ra la r dbyi/ dbyangs snga ma ring po'o/ /dā sha ra thī rā maḥbyung ngo*/ /rna ba can ni/ sngon 'thab dka'i sgo srungs rnams nub re bzhin srin po gcig gis bsad nas zos/ nub gcig rna ba can sgo srungs la yod pa/ srin po dang gyad stobs bkye bas rna ba can rgyal lo/ /da mi la gnod pa ma byed cig byas pas/ 'o na nyid re bzhin gser bhā ra gcig bzhi char bcas pa ster dgos zer ba ltar rtag tu byin skad/ se ba brgyad la ma sa gcigam sa bcu gnyis la to la gcigato la stong phrag la bhā ra yin/ ma sha ka ni ma sa'i ming ngo*/ /sa bā bhā ra/ zhes pa bzhi cha dang bcas pa'i bhā ra la zer/ gzhan yang rang gi pags pa byin pa dang*/ 'chi ba'i tshe yang bram ze la sog ser gyi rang bzhin byin pa sogs slong mo bas blangs tshad ster ba'o/ /g.yul ngor brtan pa ni 'thab sar mi 'bros pa dang nam yang rdzun mi smra ba'o/ /'jigs pa ni 'jig sde ste glang po che stong phrag bcu'i stobs yod skad de/ phul byung tsam yin par mngon yang*/ pha bong khru bcu gnyis pa gru bzhi pa lag gis 'phangs nges pa'o/ /de dag go ba skye ba'i phyir 'phros don tsam mo/ rnam bcad kyi mtshams sbyor rdzogs so/ /༈ /da ni 'phros don gzhan cung zad bshad de/ 'grel bar ji skad du/ ya dukta lau ki kā ye ha ta dwe de ba hu laṃ bha bet/ se māṃ bhu myā da de so ṣā mi tyā dī nā ma duṣta tā/ bod skad du/ 'jig rten pas gang bshad pa 'di dag dang*/ /rig byed las ni de 'dra mang po 'byung*/ /sa gzhi ma byin blangs dang bur shing ma/ /de de 'di zhes la sogs nyes pa med/ /ces te/ gang 'jig rten 'di na mkhas pas bshad pa dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ rig byed las dmigs gsal dang*/ gsang tshig gi sgrub pa gzhan yang de 'dra ba mang du yod pa rnams brda sprod rang gzhung dang ma mthun yang nyes pa med de legs pa'i yan lag go

se māṃ bhu myā da de/ saḥ.i māṃ bhū mi a ā da de/ saḥ ni de i māṃ 'di/ bhū miṃ sa gzhi/ a dgag pa/ ā da de kun nas sbyin pa/ de gnyis sdoms/ ma byin pa kho nar blangs pa'o/ / de'i tshe sa'i rnam bcad phyis rjes slar mtshams sbyar ba'o/ a i e/ semāṃ/ de 'di'o/ a dang ā mtshungs pa sbyar ma'i nga ro phyis/ i y ā dang bsres/ bhū myā da de grub/ de zhes pa lha mi'u thung ste/ lha min stobs ldan gyi sa gzhi phrogs pa'o/ kha cig bhū mi ād de/ kho na yin zer nas phar sa gzhi byin pa'i bshad pa byed de mi 'thad do/ /so ṣā mi tya di/ zhes pa ni/ de bur shing ma zhes pa sogs zhes par bsgyur ro/ saḥ uṣāṃ i ti ā di zhes pa la/ saḥni de/ uṣāṃ ni bu raṃ shing mo ste/ lha kṛṣṇa'i bu a ni rudha'i chung ma'i ming yin/ de ni srin po ba nā su ra'i bu mo'o/ /i ti zhes pa dang*/ ā di sogs pa'o/ /sa'i rnam bcad phyis kyang slar/ u la o byas pas/ so ṣāṃ/ nga ro i la drangs/ mi ti la i ytya/ de ā la drangs pa'o/ /de sai māṃ zhes dang*/ so ṣā ma zhes rnam bcad phyis pa'i rjes su mtshams sbyar kyang nyes pa med pa'i dper brjod do/ ༈yang brjod pa/ kwa tsitp+ra brittiḥkwa tsi da pra bṛttiḥ/ kwatsi dwibhā ṣa kwatsi da n+ya de ba/ /bi dhe rbi dhā naṃ ba hudhā sa mī kṣ+ya tsa turbidhāṃ bā hu la kaṃ ba danti/ la lar 'jug dang la lar mi 'jug pa/ la lar gdam nga la lar gzhan du bsgyur/ /cho ga'i rim pa mang po legs 'dod de/ / sgrub tshul bzhi po mang du bshad pa'o/ skabs la la 'ga' zhig tu ste/ phal cher la mdo'i don spyir btang dmigs gsal tshig zin 'jug pa dang*/ la lar nges tshig gi sgrub pa dang*/ man ngag gsang tshig gis/ mdo'i dngos bstan la spyir btangs dang*/ dmigs gsal gnyis shugs bstan te gsum ka spangs bas mdo'i don mi 'jug pa dang*/ yang la lar bu bhā ṣa gnyis su smra ba gang mang ste/

mdo don dang mdo don ma yin pa 'dam kar byed pa dang*/ la lar mdo tshig gis zin pa'am ma zin pa gang yin yang rung*/ gong gi bhū miṃ gi nga ro dbyi ba lta bu/ rgyu mtshan bshad du med pa dang*/ ā de sha byed pa sogs gzhan du bsgyur ba ste cho ga bzhi po dag go/cho ga'i bya ba mi 'dra ba'i grub tshul mang po dag yod pa mi 'gog ste 'dod pa yin kyang*/ sgrub tshul bzhi po de mang po de dag 'dus par bshad do/ /barṇā ga mo barṇa bi paryayashtsa dwau tsā pa rau barṇa bi kā ra nā shau/ dhā tosta darthā ti sha ye na yo ga sta du tsya te pañtsa bi dhaṃ bi ruktaṃ/ yi ge glo bur yi ge bsnol ba dang*/ nyams dang yi ge rnam 'gyur gnyis ni gzhan/ /byings de'i don la phul byung sbyor ba ste/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga lnga po nges par bshad/ ces te gzhan yang rnam 'gyur rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi'am lnga yod de/ yi ge glo bur ba ste/ sngar rgyun med pa'i yi ge gsar pa bsnan pa ā ga ma dang bar rkyen rnams yin la/ spyir rkyen thams cad sngar med glo bur du byung ba ltar snang yang*/ tshig dang rkyen/ ming dang rkyen/ byings dang rkyen rnams snga phyir sbyor rgyu'i dngos po rnams khyad gzhi yin pas yi ge glo bur ba ma yin no/ /yi ge bsnol pa ni/ snga ma'i gsal byed phyi mar spos/ phyi ma'i gsal byed snga mar spos pa yin la/ yi ge nyams pa ni dbyi ba ste/ lo pa/ lo pa sha/ luk ste gsum mo/ /yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba ni/ ā de sha la sogs pa'o/ /de yang mtha' 'gyur ba dang*/ ngo bo 'gyur ba 'brel ba can dang*/ 'brel ba med ba sogs sna tshogs pa'o/ gnyis ni gzhan zhes pa/ nyams dang rnam 'gyur gnyis ni glo bur ba dang bsnol ba las rnam par 'gyur tshul gzhan yin no zhes so/ /byings kyi don de la phul byung du sbyor ba ni/ bzhi po de'i nang na ci rigs pa'ang yod pas logs su mi 'dren pa'am/ de dag tu ma 'dus pa yang yod pas lnga par yang bgrang ngo*/

/byings de'i dang po'i don gang yin pa de ka ches phul du byung bar 'gro ba'i don gyi rkyen gyi cho ga la/ byings kyi don de la phul du byung ba'i sbyor ba zer ro/ barṇā ga mo ga bend+rā dau sidhe barṇa bi parya yaḥ/ ṣo ḍa shā dau bi kāraḥsyā dwarṇa nā shaḥbṛ ṣo da re/ yi ge glo bur ba lang dbang po sogs/ /yi ge rab tu bsnol ba seng ge'o/ /bcu drug sogs ni rnam par 'gyur ba yin/ /yi ge nyams pa rgyas pa'i lto ba zhes/ /zhes so/ /ā ga ma la ā ga mo/ /zhes pa'i rna ru ni rnam bcad u'i shul lo/ ༈ go/ ind+ra bzhag bar du a yig ā ga ma byin/ go a mthong bas o ab/ g ab a ind+ra a ni i la e/ so sor drangs pas/ ga bend+ra/ ba lang gi dbang bo ste khyu mchog go /ga bend+ra ā dau mtshams sbyar bas/ ga bend+rā dau byung*/ de yang ā di di bzhag de au bsgyur/ de ḍi t yin pas ṭi da'i i phyis/ d au la drangs pas/ ā dau byung ba'o/ /'di phul du byung ba'i don can no/ ༈yi ge bsnol ba ni hings/ zhes pa la/ dbyangs so sor phral/ h id s a byung*/ dbyangs gnyis gong 'og ma bsgyur bar/ h s'i gnas su bskyal/ s yig ha'i gnas su bskyal nas so sor drangs bas sidha grub/ gzhung las/ sing ྄he ni/ sing ྄ha la ngi byin pa'o/ ༈ yi ge rnam 'gyu?r ni/ ṣa ṣa da sha bzhag /ṣ dbyangs med u/ dra ḍa ྄ru song*/ u la o/ ṣo byung*/ ṣo ḍa sha grub/ ṣu u ru 'gro ba 'brel ba med kyang bsgyur ba yin/ da ḍa ru 'gyur ba 'brel bas 'gyur ba'o/ /yi ge nyams pa ni/ pṛ ṣa t u da ra bzhag/t yig rgyu mtshan 'brel maid par phyis pa'o/ /u la o/ /ṣo ru song*/ pṛ ṣo da ra/ grub/ pṛ ṣa t chen por rgyas pa dang ri dwags la 'jug /u da ra lto ba'o/ /des na rgyas pa'i lto ba'am/ ri dwags lto ba'o/ /de nas yi ge glo bur ba'i dper brjod/ ga bend+ra yi ge bsnol ba'i dper brjod/

si ng ha/ yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba'i dper brjod/ ṣo ḍa sha /yi ge nyams pa'i dper brjod/ pṛ ṣo da ra'o/ ༈ /barṇā bi kā ra nā shā bhyāṃ dhā to ra ti sha ye na yaḥ/ yo gaḥs u tsya te pradzñairma yu ra bhra ma rā di ṣu/ yi ge rnam par 'gyur dang nyams dag gis/ byings la phul du byung ba 'dren pa gang*/ /rma bya dang ni bung ba la sogs su/ /shes rab can gyis sbyor ba de smras so/ /yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba'i rigs las byings la phul byung gi dper brjod ni/ rma bya ste/ ma yu ra zhes pa lta bu yin la/ yi ge nyams pa'i phul byung sbyor ba'i dper brjod ni/ bung ba'i skad dod*/ bhra ma ra lta bu'o/ de yang ru sgra la lo/ zhes sam/ rai sgra la'o/ gang rigs bzhagarkyen ḍa sbyin/ ḍ yal/ a bzhagaḍit la ṭi dbyi bas/ ru yin na u dang*/ rai yin na ai yal/ drangs bas ra byung*/ de la si rnam bcad/ raḥgrub/ sgra 'byin pa'i don yin/ yang na rkyen a yig sbyin/ ra'i srog u dang*/ ai brjod don/ drangs/ si rnam bcad byas kyang 'ong ngo*/ ༈ ma hī gong du bzhag ste sa gzhi'i ming yin/ ma hī raḥ zhes pa bzhagaphul du byung ba'i yi ge rnam par bsgyur te/ hī zhes pa'i h dang dbyangs ī ring po sdoms pa de/ yū ring por bsgyur ba/ ma yū ra grub/ sa steng du skad phul du byung bar sgrog ba'i don te rma bya'i skad dod do/ /rma bya'i mjug sgro mdongs can la/ dhwa dza ste rgyal mtshan zer/ rma bya sgro mdongs can la/ ka lā ya ra zer/ de med pa la laṇḍor zer/ sgro mdongs kyi dbus kyi thig le la/ tsand+ra ka zer/ rgyud las/ bod skad la/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu 'od/ /zhes pa las ma byung yang*/ rgya gar gyi skad tsand+re ka la/ rgya 'grel 'ga' na nag po'i bshad pa byed pa mi 'gal ba der gda'/ rma bya pho gar byed cing mchi ma 'bab pa la/ ang shu zer/ de rma bya mos 'thungs pa las/ mdongs kyi thig le 'byung bar grags so/

/phyis byung rgya gar gyi cha rgyus med par/ rgya gar gyi bshad pa ka byed mkhan tsho ya cha'o/ ༈ yang bhramat raḥbazhag/yi ge nyams pa ste/ t yig dbyi/ 'di yang phul du byung ba'i don yin/ bhram t/ 'khor ba/ raḥsgra 'byin pa'o/ /ma'i mtha' rten t yig phyis pas phul byung du song bas/ sgra chen po dang bcas te 'phur lding byed pa'i don te/ bhra ma rang ha byung ba yin no/ /rnam 'gyur gyi dbye ba bshad pa 'di rnams mtshon byed de/ gzhung phyi ཿbung ba'o/ /seng ge yang hing sa ste 'che pa phul du byung ba'i don la/ sim rnams su rgyas par rtogs par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir cung zad bshad pa ni/ slar 'chad 'gyur ba rnams la/ slob sla ba'i phyir dang po nyid nas 'jug sgo cung zad bshad pas 'dris su 'jug pa yin la/ mtshams sbyor tsam kho na las gzhan mi slob pa rnams la ni/ blo gros rgyas par byed pa'i gal chen yin no/ /'dir sa dang eṣa las ha sa la'o/ /zhes pa yan chad kyis rnam bcad kyi mtshams sbyor rdzogs kyang*/ de man chad 'grel par 'phros don cung zad tshigs bcad du mdzad 'dug pas de dag gi don zur tsam smros pa'o/ swa ra swa sti byā ka ra ṇa'i gzhung las mtshams sbyor gyi gzhung legs par bshad pa'o/ gcig zhus/ /bibha kt+yantaṃ pa daṃ/ rnam dbye'i mtha' can ni tshig go /rnam dbye gnyis las 'dir si sogs so/ a bibhakti nā ma/ rnam dbye med pa ni ming ngo*/ /byings kyi mtshan nyid bor ba zhes bya ba/ kṛt mtha'i rkyen sogs byin pas byings las 'gyur grub pa si sogs ti sogs kyi rnam dbye ma byin pa ni ming ngam rtags sam/ shapda zhes bya'o/ tasmāt/ de yang*/ si au dzas/ am au shas/ ṭā bhyam bh-is/ nge bhya ma bhyas/ /nga si bhyām bhya s/ nges os ām/ ngi os sup/ ༈dang por a thung mtha' can spyir btang la/ de ba'i sgra la dper brjod du bya ste/ de ba'i ming ngam rtags la/

rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig si byin/ de ba si/ si'i srog gi i ni brjod don yin pas phyis/ s srog med/ sro bisarga/ s r dag gi rnam bcad do/ /byings kyi mtha' ma yin pa ste/ ming mtha'a'am tshig mtha' la rkyen gyi s yig r yig srog med rnams rnam bcad du 'gyur zhes bya ste/ de yang tshig mtha' yin na/ pha rol du yi ge gzhan med kyang der 'gyur ba yin la/ tshig mtha' min par ming tsam yin pa sogs la/ ra sa'i so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge sum cu po gang rung pha rol du yod pa'ang dgos pa las/ 'dir tshig mtha' yang yin pas/ si'i s srog med rnam bcad du song bas/ de ba ཿlha grub bo/ de ba la rnam dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig au byin/ o dang au la au'o/ /zhes pas rtags mtha'i a au ru bsgyur/ de bau lha dgazhes pa grub/ de ba la rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzas byin/ de ba dza s dza yig ni/ dzas ī'o zhes pa'i mdo lha'i bya ba'i dgos pa can yin cing*/ rtags don yin pas phyis/ de ba as 'dra ba'i yi ge la ring la ring bo'o/ /pha rol dbyi ba'i a ring por song*/ s rnam bcad du bya'o/ de lha rnams bāḥ༈ mdo gzhan las ni a yig gi dzas la/ a suk res 'ga'o zhes bshad pas*/ de ba dza s/ a suk byin ba/ de ba'i srog gi a ring song*/ de bās a suk k rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ su'i u brjod don yin pas phyis/ de bā s as/ lha rnams/ s dbyangs med pha rol tu drangs/ sra phyi ma rnam bcad/ de bā saḥ'adi sdeb sbyor dang rig byed lugs te yang na ba'o/ ༈/ de ba la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig am byin/ de ba am/ amsha sor sya/ am shas dag gi a'o/ tshu rol rtags mtha' mtshungs pa'i yi ge yod la/ pha rol am dang shas kyi a dag ming mtha' la dbyi ste/ 'on kyang byings kyi mthar byin pa yin na mi dbyi'o/ /'dir ming mtha' yin pas dbyi ste/ de ba m/ m rjes su nga ro/

de baṃ lha la zhes pa grub bo/ /de ba la gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au ster te/ dang po'i gnyis tshig dang cho ga 'dra'o/ /de bau grub/ de ba la gnyis pa'i mang tshig shas byin/ de ba shas/ sh yig ni/ shas la'o zhes sogs mdo bya ba la dgos mod/ /brda chad tha snyad kyi don yin pas phyis/ lha la/ de ba as/ sonaḥpuṃsaḥ skyes pa las sa'i na'o/ /skyes pa'i rtags kyi mtshungs pa'i yi ge yod pa'i mtha' can gyi pha rol du bzhag pa'i shas kyi s yig ni n so?g med du 'gyur ro/ sha si/ shas la'o/ shas kyi sha yig phyis zin kyang nus pa as la yod pas/ /rtags mtha'i a ring por 'gyur ro/ /as de thog ma shas yin pas/ shas la'o zhes shas kyi ming btags pa'o/ /as kyi a ni/ am shas dag gi a'o/ /zhes pas dbyi'o/ de bā n lha rnams zhes pa grub/ ༈ gsum pa'i gcig tshig gi rkyen ṭā yin te/ de ba la ṭā byin/ de ba ṭā/ ṭ ni ṭā i na'o sogs kyi rtags don nam/ rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ ṭen/ ṭā i na'o/ ṭa'i a i na zhes par bsgyur/ a i la e'o/ /zhes pas rtags mtha'i a er song*/ de ben lha yis grub/ gnyis tshig ni/ addhi/ bha la a'o/ de ba bhyām/ de ba'i rtags mtha'i a yig ni/ rnam dbye bha yig mthong bas ā yig tu 'gyur ro/ m ni kun la 'dra ste nga ror bsgyur kyang rung ma bsgyur kyang rung ngo*/ de bā bhyāṃ/ lha dag gi grub po/ mang tshig ni*/ bbhyaḥ bha'i bha a'o/ /de ba bhis/ a thung mtha' can las pha rol rkyen rnam dbye'i bhis kyi bha yig ni a ru bsgyur te/ ā de sha bya'o/ /de yang is kyi gong du 'bri'o/ /der ā de sha'i a de/ is kyi i mthong bas a i bhangas tsa.a si tsa/ tsa gsum tshig sdud kyis phyis/ ngas gnyis mi zad pa las 'jigasi rnam bcad/ bha bhi aḥ iy ru song*/ dzha sa tshu rol dzha bha pha rol la dza ba ru 'gyur bas/ bhab ru song*/ phar drangs/

bbhyaḥl e'o/ /deb e s/ rtags mtha'i a/ pha rol e mthong*/ 'phel ba ai ru song*/ s rnam bcad/ de baiḥlha rnams kyis grub/ ༈ sdeb sbyor las/ bhi rang sor bzhagartags mtha'i a er bsgyur dgos te/ ji skad du/ a yig bhi s la e yig yang na'o/ /s rnam bcad/ de be bhiḥkārṇebhiḥ/ ༈ rnam dbye bzhi pa'i gcig tshig de ste/ de ba de ng'i ng ni dit kyi bya ba'i don yin pas dbyi ste/ 'dir ma zad nga ldan bzhi car gyi nga yig rnam pa kun tu dbyi'o/ nge rak nge yi ak'o/ /de la ak ā ga ma ster te 'di kat ā ga ma yin pas rnam dbye'i mthar bzhagak rjes 'brel/ e a y'o/ /zhes pas/ de e a y ru song*/ de ba a y a/ mtshungs pa'i yi ge la ring po'o/ /de bā ru song*/ dbyangs med pha rol a la y drangs/ de bā ya lhā'i ched du/ grub bo/ gnyis tshig de ba bhyām/ de bā bhyāṃ du 'grub ste/ lha dag gi ched du gong rnam dbye gsum pa dang 'dra mang tshig gi rkyen bhyas yin te/ esbhi ba hu twe/ sa bha mang po nyid la e'o/ /de babhyas/ bhi sa ྄ma gtogs pa'i rnam dbye sa yig bha yig gang yin la yang*/ 'dra ste/ mang tshig gi rkyen yin na/ de mthong bas a thung mtha' na e ru 'gyur ro/ /de las 'di mang tshig gi bha yig ste/ de be bhyas/ s rnam bcad/ debe bhyaḥgrub po/ lha rnams kyi ched du/༈ rnam dbye lnga pa'i dbang du byas te gcig tshigangasi ste/ de ba nga si ng dbyi/ nga si rat/ nga si a t do/ /a thung mtha' can la/ ngasi at du bsgyur ba'i ā de sha bya la/ de yang nga dang i phyis nas at du bsgyur ba blo la bzhag go /'dra ba ring po/ de ba t grub/ lha las/ gnyis tshigade ba bhyām/ lha dag las de bā bhyāṃ du bsgyur ba dang*/ mang tshigade ba bhyas/ de be bhyaḥlha rnams las*/ zhes par bsgyur ba ni/ gong bzhi pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ ༈ rnam dbye drug pa'i dbang du byas nas gcig tshig ngas yin te/

ngassu/ ngas sya'o/ de ba ngas/ a thung mtha' can la rkyen ngas ni/ nga yig phyis/ a s sya ru bsgyur/ de ba sya/ lha yi grub/ gnyis tshig ni/ o si/ os la'o/ de ba os/ de ba'i rtags mtha' a ni rnam dbye o s mthong bas e yig tu 'gyur la/ e ay/ dbyangs med pha rol s rnam bcad/ de ba yoḥgrub/ lha dag gi mang tshig ni/ de ba ām/ nu ṭ maḥ nu ṭ ām la'o/ rnam dbye ām la nuṭ ā ga ma sbyin te/ 'di ṭi t ā ga ma yin pas/ rnam dbye'i sngon du bzhag dgos so/ /ṭ rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ 'dir ām la nu t ster ba ni/ rtags mtha' mtshungs pa'i yi ge yod na yin no/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ nā mi/ nām la'o/ pha rol nām las tshu rol rtags mtha' ring bor 'gyur bas/ de bā lha rnams kyi grub nā/༈ rnam dbye bdun pa'i dbang du byas nas gcig tshig ngi'o/ /de ba ngi nga dbyi/ a i la e'o/ /lha la de be/ grub/ gnyis tshig de ba os/ de ba yoḥlha dag la zhes par 'gyur ba drug pa'i skabs bzhin no/ /mang tshig gi dbang du byas te/ de ba sup bzhag p rjes 'brel/ kwi lāt ṣaḥsaḥkṛ tasya/ ku i la las ṣa ru byed de sa'o/ /sa dang bha mang po nyid la ni e'o/ zhes pas sup kyi sa yig ni mang tshig yin pas/ rtags mtha'i a e ru bya'o/ ka sde dang i la so sor bsdu ba ste/ i u ṛ l̥ e ai o au ha ya ba ra la bcu gsum po'i rtags mtha' can gyi pha rol kyi/ rnam dbye sa yig ni ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ 'gyur ba de yang brjod pa bde ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sgra mdo rnams su de ltar byed pa yin gyi rgyu mtshan gzhan ni med do/ de bas na mdo'i byed pas bsgyur na/ de be ṣu/ grub/ lha rnams la/ ༈ bod pa'i don la gcig gnyis mang tshig gsum las/ dang po ni/ ā mant+ra ṇe siddhiḥ bod pa la si dhi'o/ /mngon du mthong ba la smra ba'i ming 'bod byed pa na bod pa ste/

mgron du 'bod pa lta bu ni ma yin no/ /bod pa'i don du sbyin pa'i rnam dbye si la dhi zhes brda chad bya'o/ /de ba si bzhag/samā naddherlo bo3dhātoḥbyings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la dhi dbyi'o/ /byings yin na mtshungs pa yin kyang dhi mi 'phyid la/ byings kyi mtha' ma yin pa'i tshu rol ming mtha' la mtshungs pa'i yi ge bcu po gang rung zhig yod pa la/ pha rol du bod si byung ba rnams dbyi'o/ /de ba/ mngon du smras pa'i bod tshig gi rnam dbye byin pa'i rtags su ming gi thog mar he yig bzhag par bya'o/ /he ni mtshon pa ste/ bho la sogs pa yang ngo*/ de ba/ grub/ he/ kyi lha gnyis pa gnyis tshig ni/ de ba au/ de bau/ rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ he/ de bau/ grub/ kyai lha dag gsum pa mang tshig ni/ de ba dzas/ de bāḥ/ gong rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ he de bāḥgrub/ kye lha rnams zhes so/ /'dis mtshon te 'og ma rnams la'ang so so'i skabs thob dang sbyar te shes par bya'o de ltar na/ si au dzas rnams/ don tsam ston pa dang*/ bod pa'i don te dgos pa'i dbang gis lan gnyis ldabs pas/ rnam dbye nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de ba'i sgra la byed pa ltar/ gha ṭa/ bum pa pa/ gos ṭa ma ṭa/ gnas staṃ bha/ ka ba ku mbha bum pa be pra/ bram ze bṛkṣa shing la sogs pa ches mang po rnams la cho ga 'di kho na sbyor te/ spyir btang a thung mtha' can pho rtags rnams la'o/ /a thung mtha' can yin yang*/ sarba la sogs pa rnams la ni cho ga cung zad mi 'dra ba yod de/ de la sarba la sogs pa ni/ sarba thams cad/ bi shwa sna tshogs/ u bha gnyis u bha ya gnyis min/ a n+ya/ gzhan a n+ya ta ra/ /gzhan dang gzhan i ta ra/ rang las tha dad ḍa ta ra dang ḍa ta ma dang ni/ ka ta ra ji tsam dang ka ta ma ji tsam dang yang*/ sa ma ra mnyam pa si mar sa cha 'am mnga' zhabs ne ma ra khrims/ e ka gcig dang*/ pū rb+bar shar par pha rol dang ni a ba ra dakṣi ṇa gzhan/

lho dang de bzhin utta ra/ byang a pa ra gzhan zhig dang*/ a dha ra dma' ba dang mchu dang swa rang*/ /anta ra/ bar mtshams tyad tad yang dang gang ces e tad lkog 'gyur dang*/ i dm/ a das 'di gsum mngon gyur dwi/ gnyis/ ci/ 'di dang ba dang smad pa gnyis yod/ yuṣma khyed/ a smad bdag/ bha bt yod min byung gyur zhes bya so lnga'o/ rtags gsum cho ga thams cad 'jug rung yin/ de la re zhig pho rtags kyi dbang du byas te/ rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig la/ sarba si/ sarb+baḥ ces par 'gyur/ gnyis tshig la/ sarb+ba au/ sarb+bau/ zhes par 'gyur te/ de gnyis de ba'i rtags dang 'dra'o/ /mang tshig la/ sarba dzas/ dza sī/ dzas ī'o/ /sarba sogs kyi nang nas a thung gi mtha' la pha rol dzas ril gyis ī ru bsgyur/ sarba dzas/ sarba ī/ a i la e'o/ sarbe/ grub/ ༈rnam dbye gnyis pa la/ gcig tshigasarba am/ sarbaṃ/ gnyis tshigasarba au/ sarb+bau/ mang tshigasarba shas/ sarb+bān rnams grub ste/ de ba'i rtags dang 'dra'o/ ༈ rnam dbye gsum pa'i dang po ni/ sarba ṭā/ ṭā ina'o/ sarba i na/ a i la e'o/ /sarben/ zhes so/ /ṣurno ṇo ྅ naṃ ti/ ṣa ra ṛ las mtha' min pa'i ṇa na'o/ /tshu rol du ṣa yig dang re pha dang ṛ yig yod la/ yi ge gzhan gyis bar ma chod na/ pha rol na yig mtha' ma yin pa ste srog can yod pa rnams ṇa yig 'gyur la/ mtha' ste srog med yin na ṇa ru mi 'gyur te/ sarb+ba la gnyis pa'i mang tshig shas byin pa'i rjes ni/ sarb+bān zhes n yig bya yi/ sarbāṇa zhes ṇ yig mi bya ba bzhin no/ /a ba kupabanta re ྅ pi/ a ba ku pu bar na yod kyang ngo*/ /a ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge a i u ṛ l̥ e ai o au ha ya ba/ zhes pa rnams dang*/ ku ni ka sde/ pu ni pa sde/ yi ge de rnams tshu rol ṣa ra ri dang*/ pha rol na yi ge bar na yod kyang na yig ṇa yig tu 'gro la/ lhag ma yi ge rnams yod na mi 'gyur ro/ /snga ma'i dmigs gsal lo/

/de ltar na/ sarba zhes pa las/ sar zhes pa'i r mthong bas/ pha rol a na'i na yig srog can ṇa ru 'gro ste/ bar na ba dang e yod kyang e yig ni a ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin/ ba yig ba sde yin pa de yod kyang*/ na de ṇa yig tu song ngo*/ /sarbe ṇa/ grub gnyis tshig/sarb+ba bhyām/ sarb+bā bhyāṃ/ mang tshigasarba bhis/ sarb+beḥ rnams de ba dang 'dra/ ༈rnam dbye bzhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ sarb+ba de nga phyis/ sarb+ba sogs la smaṭ'o/ rnam dbye la smaṭ ā ga ma ster/ 'di ṭi?ta yin rnam dbye'i gong du 'bri/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ sarb+ba sma e/ a e la ai'o/ smai/ sarb+basmai/ grub/ gnyis tshigasarb+ba bhyām/ sarb+bā bhyā/ mang tshig/ sarb+ba bhyas/ sarb+be bhyaṃḥ gong ma rnams dang 'dra/ ༈ lnga pa'i gcig tshigasarb+ba ngasi/ ng dang i phyis/ as bzhaga.ataḥ.atra la'o/ /ngas kyi as at du bsgyur/ smaṭ ā ga ma byin te gong bzhin la/ sarb+ba sma at/ sma'i a dang pha rol at mtshungs pa 'dra ba byas pas/ sarb+ba smāt/ grub/ gnyis tshig sarba bhyam sarb+ba bhyāṃ/ mang tshig sarba bhyasra/ sarbebhyaḥ ༈drug pa'i dang po/ sarb+ba ngas/ ngas sya'o/ /zhes pas/ sarb+ba sya/ gnyis tshigasarb+ba os/ sarb+bayoḥ/ gong bzhin/ mang tshig ni/ sarb+ba ām/ su ḍā maḥ suṭ ām la'o/ /gong du nuṭ ster ba'i don du/ suṭ ā ga ma ster/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ sarb+bas ā m/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o/ /rtags mtha' er bsgyur/ sarb+be ku i la las ṣa ru byed de sa'o/ /s ṣa ru bsgyur/ dbyangs med/ sarb+beṣāṃ/ ༈ bdun pa'i dang po la/ sarb+ba/ ngi ng phyis/ ngi smin/ ngi smin'o/ /ngi'i i smin du bsgyur te/ sarb+ba smin/ gnyis tshigasarb+ba os/ sarba yoḥ/ mang tshigasarb+ba sup/ sarb+be ṣu/ rnams kyang de ba'i skabs bzhin no/ ༈ bod pa la yang*/ he sarb+ba/ he sarb+bau/ sarb+ba dzas/ dzas ril gyis ī ru 'gyur bas/ he sarb+be/ de dang 'dra bar bi shwa la sogs pa'i sarb+ba nā ma'isgra a yig mtha' can kun spyir btangs su/

sarb+ba dang sgrub tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ ḍa tar dang ḍa tam ni rkyen yin gyi ming ma yin mod/ ming gzhan gyi mthar sbyar te 'byung bas/ de'i tshe bya ba byed tshul sarb+ba dang 'dra'o/ ༈ pūrb+ba la sogs pa dgu ste/ pūrb+ba/ ba ra/ a ba ra/ dakṣi ṇa/ atta ra/ a pa ra/ a dha ra/ swa antar rnams so/ de ltar dgu po rnams la dzas ī ru bsgyur nas/ pūrb+be/ pa re sogs su byed pa dang*/ de ba'i sgra bzhin mtshungs 'dra byas pas/ pūrb+bāḥ ba rāḥ/ zhes sogs su byed pa 'dam ka yin no/ /nga dang ngi la yang*/ sarb+ba dang de ba'i bya ba gang rung 'dam ka can byed pas/ pūrb+ba da si/ pūrb+basmātra/ pūrb+ba di/ pūrbāsmin/ zhes pa sarb+ba'i lugs dang*/ pūrb+ba nga si/ pūrb+bāt/ pūrb+ba ngi*/ pūrb+be/ zhes pa de ba'i lugs yang na bar bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams sarba kho na bzhin bsgrub bo/ ༈ yang pra tha ma/ dang po tsa ra ma/ pags pa ta ya ṭ/ yin rkyen a ya ṭ/ a lpa/ chung ngu a byed rdha/ ka ti ji tsam byung pa ya la sogs pa la yang de dang 'dra'o/ /dza sībā/ dzas ī yang na'o/ dper na/ pra tha ma/ dzas/ dzas ī/ pra tha me/ pra tha ma/ dzas/ pra tha ma/ as/ 'dra ba ring po/ pra tha māḥ/ zhes te/ pra tha ma sogs la rnam dbye lhag ma thams can spyir btang de ba'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /ta yaṭ dang a yaṭ ni rkyen yin yang*/ de dang de'i mtha' can ni rkyen mtha' can gyi ming yin pas sgra ste ming gi nang du bzung par bya'o/ ༈ /tī ya zhes pa'ang rkyen yin mod/ sarba sogs dang gzugs 'dra bar bya ste/ ngit te ng ldan rnams/ sarb+ba la sogs pa dang*/ de ba la sogs pa gang rung gi bya ba gdam nga yin no/ ༈ ming gzhan gyi mthar tī ya 'jug tshul ni/ sarb+ba sogs kyi nang tshan/ dwi zhes pa'i mthar tī ya sbyar ba/ dwi tī ya la sarba sogs kyi rang lugs ltar/ de la dwi tī ya smai/ nga si la dwi tī ya smā t/ ngi la dwi tī yasmin/ zhes pa dang*/ de ba shabda ltar na/ de la dwi tāe yā ya/

nga si la dwi tī yātra/ ngi la dwi tī ye/ zhes pa'o/ ༈sarb+ba sogs min yang*/ tṛ tī ya la yang de bzhin no/ ༈sarb+ba'i nang tshan/ u bha la ni/ si sogs gcig tshig bdun dang*/ dzas sogs mang tshig bdun mi 'jugaganyis tshig bdun po kho na 'jug pas/ /de dag kyang*/ ༈dang po la/ u bha au/ u bhauoṃ༈gnyis pa la/ u bha au/ u bhau/ ༈gsum pa la/ ubha/ bhyam/ ubhā bhyaṃ/ ༈bzhi pa la/ u bha bhyam/ u bhā bhyāṃ/ ༈lnga pa la/ u bha bhyam/ ubhā bhyāṃ/ ༈ drug pa la/ ubha/ os/ ubha yoḥ/ ༈bdun pa la/ ubha/ os/ u bha yoḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈u bha ya la ni/ au la sogs pa gnyis tshig bdun po med de/ gcig tshig bdun dang mang tshig bdun no/ /de yang*/ ༈dang po'i gcig tshiga.u bha ya si/ u? bha yaḥmang tshiga.u bha ya/ dzas/ u bha ye/ ༈ gnyis pa'i gcig tshiga.ubha ya am/ u bha yaṃ/ mang tshig/u bha ya shas/ ubha yān/ ༈gsum pa'i gcig tshiga.ubha ya ṭā/ ubha ye na/ mang tshig u bha ya bhis/ u bha yaiḥ/ ༈bzhi pa'i gcig tshig u bha ya nge*/ u bha ya smai/ mang tshiga.u bha ya bhyas/ u bha yebhyaḥ༈ lnga pa'i gcig tshig u bha ya ngasi/ u bha ya smāt/ mang tshig/ubha yabhyas/ u bha ye bhyaḥ ༈ drug pa'i gcig tshiga.u bha ya ngas/ u bha ya sya/ mang tshiga.u bha ya/ ām/ u bha ye ṣāṃ/ ༈ bdun pa'i gcig tshiga.u bha ya ngi*/ u bha ya smin/ mang tshig/u bha ya sup/ ubha ye ṣu/ zhes bya ste/ sarb+ba la sogs pa rang gi bya ba nyid do/ /'o na sarb+be ṇa zhes pa ltar 'dir mi 'byung ba ci zhe na/ de ni sarb+ba'i sde tshan de la rnam dbye 'jug tshul gyi bya ba ma yin/ sarb+ba'i rtags rang nyid la ra yig yod pa'i nus pa kho na yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /de dag ni at mtha' can gyi sarb+ba nā ma'i skor ro/ ༈ /da ni pho rtags mā sa'i sgra'i dbang du byas te/ mā sa sya lo po bā/ mā sa'i dbyi ba yang na'o/ /mā sa'i sgra la pha rol du rnam dbye gang byung kyang*/

rtags mtha'i dbyangs nyid dbyi ba dang*/ a thung mtha' can pho rtags spyir btangs de ba'i sgra la bshad pa lta bu'i bya ba gnyis po 'dam ka yin la/ mā sa'i zhes drug sgra 'byung ba'i don/ dbyi rgyu'i yi ge de mā sa'i rtags rang nyid kyi nang tshan du gtogs pa'i yi ge gcig yin pa'i don no/ de la de ba'i sgra dang mthun pa'i tshul ni/ tshu rol mā sa la/ pha rol rnam dbye nyer gcig rim can du bzhag nas/ gong de ba'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ ༈ mā saḥ/ mā au/ mā sāḥ༈ mā saṃ/ mā sau/ mā sān/ mā se na/ mā sā bhyāṃ/ mā saiḥ/ ༈ mā sā ya/ mā sā bhyaṃ/ mā sā bhyaḥ/ ༈ mā sāt/ mā sā bhyaṃ/ mā se bhyaḥ/ ༈ mā sa sya/ mā sa yoḥ/ mā sā nāṃ/ ༈mā se/ mā sa yoḥ/ mā se ṣu/ ༈he mā sa/ he mā sau/ ha mā sāḥ/ zhes pa rnams yin no/ ༈ gnyis pa rtags mtha'i a yig dbyi ba'i phyogs ni/ mā sa'i rtags nyid kyi bya ba dngos yin la/ thams cad la yang dbyangs med pha rol du 'dren/ s srog med rnam bcad du 'gyur ba las/ a phyis pa'i pha rol rnam dbye'i bha yig gi tshu rol rnam bcad rnams dbyi'o/ zhes nges par byas nas/ mā sa si/ sa'i srog gi i phyis/ mā sa s/ mā sa'i dbyi ba yang na'o/ /rtags mtha'i a phyis/ ha se baḥserlobaḥ ha sa īp la si dbyi'o/ /ha sa'i mtha' ste rtags mtha' gsal byed mtha' can dang īp la pha rol si dbyi'o/ zhes pas 'dir gsal byed mtha' la si phyis/ r s dag gi rnam bcad/ māḥgrub/ mā sa au/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ mā sau/ mā sa dzas/ dz phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ r s rnam bcad/ mā saḥ༈ mā sa am/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ mā saṃ/ mā sa au/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ mā sau/ mā sa/ sha phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ r s rnam bcad/ mā saḥ mā sa ṭā/ ṭ phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med/ mā sā/ mā sa bhyām/ bha'i nus pas a phyis/ mā sa'i s srog med dang*/

s rnam bcad du song bar ma zad/ at pi lo pa sha/ zhes pas/ rnam bcad phyis/ mā bhyāṃ/ mā sa bhis/ pha rol bha mthong bas sa srog gi a phyis/ s rnam bcad/ rnam bcad phyis/ bhas kyi s rnam bcad/ mā bhiḥ/ ༈ mā sa nge*/ nga dbyi/ a phyis/ dbyangs medapha rol/ mā se/ mā sa bhyām/ a phyis/ s rnam bcad/ de yang phyis/ mā bhyāṃ/ mā sa bhyas/ a phyis/ s rnam bcad/ de yang phyis/ bhyas kyi s rnam bcad/ mā bhyaḥ/ ༈mā sa nga si/ ng dang i rjes 'brel/ mās as/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ s rnam bcad/ mā saḥ/ ༈mā sa bhyām/ mā bhyāṃ/ mā sa bhyas/ mā bhyaḥ/ ru bsgyur sa gong bzhin no/ mā sa ngas/ ng phyis/ mtha'i a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ s rnam bcad/ mā saḥ/ mā sa os/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ s rnam bcad/ mā soḥ/ mās ām/ a phyis dbyangs med pha rol/ mā sāṃ/ ༈ mā sa ngi nga dbyi a phyis mā si/ mā sa os/ mā soḥ/ gong bzhin/ mā sa sup/ p rjes 'brel/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ mā ssu/ ༈ mā sa si/ a phyis/ i 'jig s rnam bcad/ he māḥ/ mā sa au a phyis/ dbyangs med drangs/ he mā sau/ mās dzas/ dza song*/ a phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ he mā saḥ/ des a thung mtha' can pho rtags kyi sdai tshan rags pa rnams kyi bya ba rdzogs so/ ༈ /da ni skyes pa'i rtags ā ring mtha' can gyi dbang du byas te/ so ma pā shapda sgrub pa la/ so ma pā si/ i phyis/ s rnam bcad/ so mapāḥ/ so ma pā au/ o dang au la au'o/ /so ma pau/ so ma pā dzas/ dz song*/ 'dra ba'i yi ge pha rol dzas kyi a phyis/ so ma pāḥ ༈bod pa'i si 'dir mi dbyi ste/ de dbyi ba ni byings ma yin pa'i dbang du byas la/ 'di ni byings mtha' yin pas so/ /so ma pā si/ i brjod don/ sa ྄rnam bcad/ he so ma pāḥ/ he so ma pau/ he so ma pāḥ/ gnyis tshig mang tshig gi bod pa'ang rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra'o/ /so ma pā/ am/ am gyi a phyis/

so ma pāṃ/ so ma pā au/ o au ru bsgyur/ so ma pau/ so ma pā shas/ ā to dhā to rlo paḥ āt kyi byings kyi dbyi'o/ /de yang rtags mtha' ā yig byings dang 'brel ba ni pha rol shas la sogs pa'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin rnam dbye gang mthong yang*/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyi bar bya ste/ so ma pā/ shas/ sha so?ng*/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ pha rol drangs pas/ so ma paḥgrub/ shas la sogs pa zhes so/ au gnyis dang am dang*/ dzas kyi as rnams ma yin pa'i don no/ ༈ so ma pā ṭā ṭ song*/ so ma pā ā/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ drangs pas/ so ma pā/ so ma pā bhyām/ gzhan bya ba med/ som pā bhyāṃ/ so ma pā bhis/ gzhan med/ so ma pā bhiḥ/ ༈so ma pā nge*/ ng phyis/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis pha rol drangs/ sa ma pe/ so ma pā bhyām/ so ma pā bhyāṃ/ so ma pā bhyas/ /gzhan med/ so ma pā bhyaḥ/ ༈so ma pā ngasi/ ng dang i song*/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ dbyangs med drangs/ s rnam bcad/ so ma paḥ so ma pā bhyām/ so ma pā bhyaṃḥ/ so ma pā bhyas/ so ma pā bhyaḥ/ so ma pā ngas/ as bzhagartags mtha'i ā phyis/ drangs/ so ma paḥ so ma poḥ.os/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis/ dbyangs med/ sa rnam bcad/ so ma poḥ so ma pā ām/ rtags mtha'i ā phyis pha rol drangs so ma pāṃ/ ༈so ma pā ngi*/ da phyis/ rtags mtha' dbyangs med/ so ma pi/ so ma pā os/ ā phyis/ dbyangs med/ so ma poḥste drug pa dang 'dra/ so ma pā sup/ p rjes 'brel/ gzhan bya ba med/ so ma pā su/ zhes pa grub po/ /de bzhin du/ ki lā la pā/ chu 'thung shaṃ khadhmā dung bzo ba/ ma dhu 'thung pā/ sbrang rtsi la sogs pa mang po dag kyang so ma pā dang bya ba 'dra'o/ ༈ da ni i thung mtha' can gyi dbang du byas na/ ha ri si/ i brjod don/ s rnam bcad/ ha riḥ/ ha ri au/ au yu/ rnam dbye au mtshams sbyor bas yu byung au ni i u dag go /i thung mtha' can dang*/ u thung mtha' can pho rtags la/

dang po'i gnyis tshig au dang*/ gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au dgartags mtha'i dbyangs dang mtshungs par 'gyur te/ rtags mtha'i i la au dga.i thung du 'gyur ba dang*/ rtags mtha' u la au gnyis po u thung du 'gyur ro/ 'dir rtags mtha' i thung yin pas/ au i thung du bsgyur/ 'dra ba la ring po'o/ ha rī/ ha ri dzas/ dz 'gro/ e o dza si/ e o dzas la'o/ /i thung mtha' can pha rol dzas la rtags mtha' e ru 'gyur/ /u thung mtha' can pha rol dzas la rtags mtha' o ru 'gyur/ 'dir i thung yin pas/ he re/ zhes par 'gyur/ e ay/ dbyangs med/ sa rnam bcad/ ha ra yaḥ/ 'dir sambu ddhi ste bod pa'i rnam dbye la/ hi ri si/ i song*/ byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la dhi dbyi'o/ /zhes pas/ /dhi ni bod si yin pas/ rnam dbye'i si'i s phyis/ ha re/ zhes byung ba la/ dhau/ dhi la'o/ pha rol dhi mthong bas rtags mtha'i i thung e dang*/ /u thung o ru 'gyur ba las/ 'dir ha ri las ri'i srog gi i e ru bsgyur/ he sngon du bzhag he ha re/ grub/ si ni song zin ci'i phyir rtags mtha' 'gyur 'gro snyam na/ 'grel bar dhi'i yul las/ zhes 'byung bas/ sngar dhi byung pa'i nus pa'am/ shul gyis kyang 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ste 'di lta bu gzhan yang mang ngo*/ /gnyis tshig ha ri au/ he ha rī/ mang tshig ha ri dzas/ ha ra yaḥzhes pa rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang 'dra ba las he sngon du bzhag go /he ha ra yaḥ/ grub po/ ༈ ha ri am/ am shas dag gi a'o/ /zhes pas am gyi a song*/ ha riṃ/ ha ri au/ dang po'i gnyis pa dang 'dra/ harī/ ha ri shas sh song*/ skyes pa la s'i n'o/ zhes pas/ as kyi s n ru byas pas a n/ shas la'o zhes pas rtags mtha' ring por bsgyur/ am shas dag gi a'o/ /zhes shas kyi a phyis/ ha rīn/ ༈ha ri ṭā bzhagaṭ 'gro/ ṭā nā st+ri yāṃ/ bud med min pa la ṭā nā'o/ /it mtha' dang ut mtha' bud med min pa zhes pas/

pho rtags dang ma ning rtags la/ pha rol ṭā zhes pa'i ā ni nā ru bsgyur/ ṣa ra ṛ las mtha' min pa'i na ṇa'o/ /zhes i bar na yod kyang sngon du ra mthong bas pha rol na ṇa ru 'gro bas/ ha ri ṇā/ grub bo/ /ha ri bhyām/ ha ri bhyāṃ/ ha ri bhis/ ha ri bhiḥ/ ༈ ha ri nge bzhagang 'jigangi ti/ ngit la'o/ /ngit te nga ldan gyi rnam dbye bzhi po pha rol tu gang byung na yang rtags mtha' it et dang*/ u t ot du 'gyur ba las/ skabs 'dir/ ha ri ha re ru 'gyur/ e ay ru bsgyur/ dbyangs med gnyis drangs pas/ ha ra ye/ ha ri bhyām/ ha ra bhyāṃ/ ha ri bhyas/ ha ri bhyaḥ/ ༈ha ri nga si/ ng dang i phyis/ a s bzhagangit la'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i i ni e ru gyur/ ngasi nga so ra sya/ ngasi ngas dag gi a'o/ /ha re as zhes pa la rtags mtha' et dang ot kyi pha rol/ nga si dang ngas kyi as zhes pa'i a yig dbyi'o/ /'dir nga si'i rkyen gyi khong na yod pa'i a yig phyis/ sa rnam bcad/ ha reḥ/ ha ri bhyām/ ha ri bhyāṃ/ ha ri bhyas/ ha ri bhyaḥ/ ༈ha ri ngas/ ng dbyi/ ngit la'o/ /ha re/ nga si ngas dag gi a'o/ /rkyen gyi a song*/ rnam bcad/ ha reḥste gong nga si dang gzugs 'dra'o/ /ha ri os bzhagartags mtha'i iy ru bsgyur/ ra las y yang gnyis so/ zhes pas/ ha ra zhes pa nyid kyi r srog med de'i nus pas srog gi iy ru song ba de/ gcig las gnyis su 'gyur te/ y snga ma'i sngon du y gcig 'phel lo/ /o la y drangs/ y cig shos kyang de'o steng du drangs/ r yang de'i steng du sbyar te/ s rnam bcad du byas pas/ hary+yoḥ/ ha ri ām/ nuṭ ā ga ma/ u dang ṭa song*/ dbyangs med/ nām la'o/ /zhes pas ring por 'gyur bas/ ha ri ha rī ru bsgyur/ ha rī nām/ ṣa ra ṛ las mtha' min pa'i na ṇa'o/ /ha rī ṇāṃ/ ༈ ha ri ngi bzhagadamigs gsal yin pas/ ngit la'o/ zhes pa 'dir mi 'jug go

nge rau/ nga'i au'o/ /it mtha' dang ut mtha'i pha rol du phyin pa'i ngi ni au ru bsgyur/ sa tsa ḍi t/ de ni ḍi t/ /ngi au ru bsgyur ba'i au de la ḍi t kyi ming 'dogs so/ ḍi ti ṭeḥ/ ḍi t la ṭi'o/ ṭi ni rtags mtha'i dbyangs kyi ming yin/ pha rol ḍi t mthong bas/ tshu rol ṭ-i'i ming can rtags mtha'i dbyangs de dbyi'o/ dbyangs med pha rol/ ha rau/ ha ri os/ ha ri'i iy/ y gnyis/ dbyangs med drangs pa drug pa'i gnyis pa bzhin te/ hary+yoḥ/ ha ri su p/ pa ྄song*/ ku i la las ṣa ru byed de sa'o/ /zhes pas/ su'i sa ṣa ru bsgyur te/ he re ṣu/ zhes so/ ༈ de bzhin du/ a gni/ me ri gi ri/ ra bi/ nyi ma ka bi snyan ngag mkhan pra pri ti yal sogs pa'o/ ༈ /u thung mtha' can gyi rtags kyi dbang du byas/ bhā nu 'od zer la sogs pa'o/ /de yang bshad ma thag pa ha ri'i sgra la byas pa'i cho ga rnams 'dir yang sbyor ba ste/ dbyangs mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur khyad 'phran bu ma gtogs khyad par med do/ bhā nusi/ s rnam bcad/ bhā nuḥ/ bhā nu au/ rkyen au ni ur 'gyur 'dra ba ring po'o/ /bhā nū/ bhā nu dzas/ nu no ru song*/ o ab/ rnam bcad/ bhā na baḥ/ ༈ bhā nu am/ a phyis/ bhā nuṃ/ bhā nu au/ au ur song*/ bhā nū/ bhā nu/ shas/ a phyis/ s nr 'gyur/ nu ring po/ bhā nū n/ ༈bhā nu ṭā/ ṭā nā ru song*/ bhā nu nā/ bhā nu bhyāṃ/ bhānu bhiḥ/ gong ma rnams dang 'dra/ ༈ bhā nu nge*/ ng phyis/ nu no ru song*/ o ab/ bhā na be/ bhā nu bhyāṃ/ bhā nu bhyaḥ/ ༈ bhā nu/ ngasi/ bhā nu as/ a phyis nu no/ bhā noḥ/ bhā nu bhyāṃ/ bhā nubhyaḥ/ ༈ bhā nu ngas/ bhā nu as/ a 'jig/nu noḥ bhā noḥ bhānu os/ u ru song*/ bhā n b os la drangs pas/ nwo/ bhā nwoḥ/ bhā nu ām/ nuṭ byin/ nu ring por song*/ na ṇa ru mi 'gro /bha nu nāṃ/ ༈bhā nu ngi/ ngi au ru bsgyur/

ḍi t la rtags mtha'i dbyangs song*/ bhā nau/ bhā nu os/ gong du drug pa'i os dang 'dra/ bhā nwoḥ/ bhā nusupra/ sa ṣa ru bsgyur/ bhā nu ṣu/ ༈bod pa'i don la/ bhā ni si/ si rnam bcad/ he bzhagahe bhā nuḥ/ bhā nu au/ au ni u ru bsgyur/ hebhā nū/ bhā nu dzas/ nu no ru song*/ o ab/ drangs pas/ he bhā na/ kyai nyi ma rnams baḥ/ zhes grub/ gzhan yang*/ biṣṇu khyab 'jug dang*/ bā yul rlung sogs pa mang po dag ste/ 'dir it mtha' dang ut mtha' 'am/ i thung mtha' can dang u thung mtha' can zhes 'byung*/ gzhung gzhan las agni'i rtags zhes ming btags so/ ༈ /sa khi shapda la/ se ḍā dheḥ dhi ni bod si'i ming yin la/ a dhiḥni dhi min pa'o/ /tsheg drag ni si'i rjes so/ dhi ma yin pa la si ḍā'o/ sa khi si/ grogs po rnam dbye dang po sbyin/ si'i i brjod don/ s ni ḍār song*/ ḍit las ṭi'o/ zhes rtags mtha'i dbyangs la ṭi zer bas/ ḍa mthong bas rtags mtha'i i phyis/ ḍ yang khyad don yin phyis/ ā bzhag dbyangs med pho rol sbyar te/ kha ā la drangs/ sa khā grub bo/ ༈ yang sa khi la bod si byin/ bod si 'jigadhi'i yul las rtags mtha'i i e/ he sa khe/ dhi ma yin pa zhes pas/ bod sri 'jig si gzhan mi 'jig pa'i khyad bar bshad pa'o/ ai sa khyuḥ/ ༈sa khi'i ai'o/ sa khi au/ 'grel bar si sogs lnga la zhes 'byung yang*/ au sogs bzhi la rtags mtha'i i air bsgyur/ ai āy/ dbyangs med gnyis po pha rol so sor drangs/ sa khā yau grub/ sa khī'i zhes drug sgra'i don/ rtags mtha'i yi ge yongs rdzogs min/ de'i nang gi mtha' ma dbyangs kho na bskyur ro/ /zhes pa ste/ mi'i dbyug pa longs shig byas pa/ dbyug ba kho na yin gyi/ mi dang bcas pa min pa bzhin no/ /'grel par gnyis tshig ces pa las med kyang*/ gzhan ma yin/ dang po'i gnyis tshig dang gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au la sdeb sbyor dang rig byed las/

sa khi'i rtags mtha' ai dang*/ au ā ru bsgyur/ ai āy/ so sor drangs/ sa khā yā/ grub/ sa khi dzas/ dz khyad don/ rtags mtha' ai/ ai ā y/ so sor drangs/ ra sa dag gi rnam bcad do/ sa khā yaḥ/ grub/ ༈ sa khi a m/ rtags mtha' ai/ ai ā y/ so sor drangs/ m nga ro/ sa khā yaṃ/ grub/ sa khā la/ gnyis pa'i au gong dang 'dra/ sa khā yau/ rig byed las/ sa mā yā/ lnga po song ngo*/ /de nas sa khi shas mtshungs pa'i pha rol shas kyi snr song*/ a phyis/ rtags mtha' ring po/ sa khī n/ grub po/ ༈ sa khi pa tyo rīk/ sa khi pa ti dag la īk'o/ sa khi dang pa ti bdag po la pha rol du ṭā dang nge dang ngi gang yod kyang*/ sa khi dang pa ti'i rtags mthar/ īk.ā ga ma ster te/ sa khi ṭā/ ṭra phyis ā/ īk k rjes 'brel/ mtshungs 'dra ring po/ 'dir ring por gyur pa yin pas/ ṭā nā'o zhes pa mi thob/ iy dbyangs la'o/ /iy ru song*/ dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khyā grub/ ā ga ma glo bur ba ste/ rtag par mi yong bas/ īk ma byin na/ mtshungs 'dra med pa sa ring po med/ ṭā nār 'gyur bas/ sa khi nā grub/ sa khi bhyām/ sa kha bhyāṃ du bya ba kho na yin/ sa khibhis/ sa khi bhiḥru bsgyur/ ༈sa khinge/ ng phyis e/ iy dbyangs la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khye/ grub/ īkra ā ga ma byin na/ mtshungs 'dra/ sa khī/ gzhan 'dra/ yang na ngi t la'o zhes īk mi ster ha ri dang 'dra'o/ /sa khi bhyām/ gong dang 'dra/ sa khi bhyas/ sa khi bhyaḥru bsgyur/ ༈ ṛ ngeng*/ ṛk nga la'o/ sa khi dang pa ti'i pha rol tu nga yig gi rkyen gnyis te ngasi dang ngas gnyis gang yin kyang*/ rtags mthar ṛk ā ga ma ster ro/ sa khi nga si/ ng dang i phyis/ as/ ṛk byin/ sa khi ṛk as/ iy dbyangs la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol lan gnyis/ sakhy-ir as/ ṛ to nga uḥ ṛt las nga'i u'o/ rtags mtha'i ṛ yig pha rol/ ngasi dang*/ ngas kyi a yig kur （ur ）'gyur bas/

as/ de ni us ru song*/ de yang ḍi t do/ zhes nga si dang*/ ngas kyi a yig ur song ba de ḍi t zhes brda chad sbyar nas/ ḍit pha rol du byung bas/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyis te/ dbyangs med pha rol/ s rnam bcad/ sa khyuḥgrub/ sa khi bhyām/ sa khi bhyāṃ/ sa khi bhyas/ sa khi bhyaḥ/ gong dang 'dra/ ༈ sa khi ngas bzhag nge phyis ṛk/ nga la'o/ rtags mthar ṛk byin/ iy dbyangs la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ ṛtlas nga'i u'o/ /rnam dbye'i a yig ur song*/ ḍit las rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyis/ pha rol du drangs/ s rnam bcad/ sa khyuḥgrub ste ngasi sgra ji bzhin no/ sa khi os/ iy dbyang la'o/ /dbyangs med pha rol/ s rnam bcad/ sa khyoḥgrub/ sa khi āmra/ nuṭ byin/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ rtags mtha' ring po/ dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khī nāṃ/ grub/ ༈sa khi ngi/ d phyis/ au ru bsgyur/ ḍiṭ la ṭi'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i i phyis/ /rtags mthar īk ā ga ma byin/ k rjes 'brel/ nga phyis pa'i i aur bsgyur ba de ḍiṭ yin no/ /iy dbyangs la'o/ īk gi ī y ru song*/ dbyangs med pha rol/ sa khyauau/ sa khi os/ gong dang 'dra/ sa khyoḥ/ sa khi sup/ p phyis/ ku dang i la las sa ṣa'o/ rkyen gy-i s yig ṣ yig tu bsgyur/ sa khi ṣu/ grub po/ ༈pa ti la ni/ rkyang pa dang tshig bsdud can gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ pa ti zhes pa lta bu'o/ /phyi ma ni/ pra dzā pa ti/ skyed dgu'i bdag po zhes pa lta bu'o/ /tshig de yang pa ti nyid dang 'brel pa la yin gyi/ ming tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod kyang*/ gong du ming gzhan ma 'brel pa yod pa la mi rtsi'o/ /de gnyis las/ pa ti'i sgra rkyang pa la/ si au dzas/ am au shas rnams ha ri skabs te i thung mtha' can spyir btang dang 'dra bar bsgrub la/ ṭa nas su p kyi bar sa khi dang 'dra bar bsgrub ste/ ༈pa ti si/ pa tiḥ pa ti au/ au ī/ pa tī/ pa ti dzas/

pa ta yaḥ/ ༈pa ti bod pa'i si/ si zhig shul gyi rtags mtha' e/ he pa te/ he pa tī/ he pa ta yaḥ/ rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra'o/ ༈pa ti am/ pa tiṃ/ pa ti au/ pa tī/ pa ti shas/ pa tī n/ ༈pa ti ṭā/ īk ster/ pa tyā/ yang na ha ri'i sgra ltar/ pa ti nā/ pa ti bhyām/ pa ti bhyāṃ/ pa ti bhis/ pa hi bhiḥ/ ༈pati nge*/ pa tye/ pa ti bhyāṃ/ pa ti bhyaḥ/ ༈pa ti ngasi/ ṛk byin/ i y/ ṛk las a'i u'o/ rkyen gyi a u/ de yang ḍitdo/ patyuḥ/ pa ti bhyāṃ pa ti bhyaḥ/ ༈ pa ti ngas/ gong ngas dang 'dra/ pa tyuḥ/ pa ti os/ pa tyoḥ/ pa ti ās/ nuṭ byin/ pa tī nāṃ/ ༈ pa ti ngi/ au ru bsgyur/ ti'i srog phyis/ īka byin/ pa tyau/ pa ti aus/ pa tyoḥ/ pa ti sup/ pa ti ṣu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ gnyis pa pa ti'i sgra tshig sdud dang 'brel ba la ni/ spyir btang ha ri dang 'dra ba kho na ste/ dang po drug gong bzhin dang*/ ṭā sogs la/ pra dzā pa ti nā/ pra dzā pa ti bhyāṃ/ pra dza pa ti bhiḥ/ ༈pra dzā pa ta ye/ pra dzā pa ti bhyāṃ/ pra dzā pa ti bhyaḥ/ pra dzā pa ti bhyāṃ/ pra dzā pa ti bhyaḥ ༈pra dzā pa teḥ/ pra dzāpa tyoḥ/ pra dzā pa tī nāṃ/ ༈ pra dzā pa tau/ pra dzā patyoḥ/ pra dzā pa ti ṣu/ zhes pa ste/ i thung mtha' can spyir btang nyid kyis bsgrubs pas go sla'o/ ༈dwi ces pa sarb+ba sogs kyi nang tshan yin/ de'i nang gi tyatra sogs bcu'i nang tshan te/ bcu po ni/ tyadra ta t yat e ta t i dm/ adas/ dwi/ kim yuṣmadra/ asmad/ zhes pa'o/ de rnams la i thung mtha' can ni/ dwi gcig pu yin pas skabs 'dir/ dwi'i sgra la dwi gnyis kyi skad dod yin cing*/ grangs bgrong ba'i skabs dang 'brel ba'i dwi'i sgra la gcig dang mang tshig gi rkyen mi 'jug ste gnyis tshig kho na sbyor ro/ 'o na 'dir si med pa la si sogs zhes pa ci snyam na/ grangs bgrong ba'i skabs la med kyang spyir yod pa dang*/ de las khyad par du 'di ltar go dgos te/

si sogs zhes pa rnam dbye bdun gsum nyer gcig gi spyi ming du btags pa yin pas 'grel par si sogs zhes so/ sya dā deṣte raḥsyā dau/ tyat sogs kyi ṭi'i si sogasa.a'o/ /zhes so/ /si sogs la tyat sogs kyi ṭi 'o/ /tshu rol tya t sogs bcu la/ pha rol si sogs gang byung yang*/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs ṭi'i ming can de a yig tu 'gro ste/ 'dir dwi au/ dwa au ru 'gro /o au la au'o/ zhes pas/ dwau/ gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig kyang de dang 'dra/ de bzhin du/ dwi bhyā m/ dwa bhyāṃ/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa kun 'dra ste/ dwa bhyāṃ/ dwi os/ drug pa bdun pa 'dra ste rtags mtha'i a de slar yang er bsgyur/ e ay/ dwa yoḥdwa yoḥ/ ༈ tri ni gsum gyi skad dod yin grangs bgrong ba'i skabs su/ tri'i sgra la mang tshig kho na sbyor ba/ tri dzas/ tri as/ e o dzas la'o/ tra yaḥ/ ༈tri shas/ trī n/ ༈tri bhis/ tri bhiḥ/ ༈tri bhyas/ tri bhyaḥ/ ༈tri bhyas/ tribhyaḥ zhes dzas/ shas/ bhis/ bhyas/ rnams spyir btang ha ti'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ ༈tre ra yang/ tri yi a yang'o/ /tri la ām/ tri ām/ nuṭ ā ga ma byin/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ dbyangs med pha rol/ tri nām/ tri sgra de/ pha rol nām mthong bas rtags mtha'i i.a yng bsgyur/ tra a yad/ nām/ d phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol tu drangs/ tra'i ra btags kyi nus pas/ nā ṇār song*/ tra yā ṇāṃ/ lugs gcig la/ a yang lta bu yi ge mang por 'gyur ba la/ bsgyur bya tri'i tra r i gsum k bsgyur ba'ang 'dod skad la/ 'on kyang ayang ni ng'i brdas i kho na bsgyur ba nyid 'thad do/ ༈tri su p/ tri ṣu ru byed pa'ang ha ri dang 'dra'o/ ༈ ka ti'i sgra la yang mang tshig kho na sbyor te/ ka ti dzas/ dzas yongs rdzogs 'jigaka ti/ ༈ ka ti shas/ shas yongs rdzogs 'jig/ka ti/ ka ti'i sgra las dzas shas 'jig go /ces bshad pas so/

༈ka ti bhas/ ji tsam ka ti bhiḥ/ ༈ka ti bhyas/ ka ti bhyaḥ/ ༈ka ti bhya sḥ/ ka ti bhyaḥ ༈ka ti sup/ ka ti ṣu/ zhes pa'o/ /ka ti ni rtags gsum pa can te/ /ka ti pu ru ṣa/ pho rtags/ ka ti st+ri ya/ mo rtags/ ka ti pa trā ne/ ma ning yin pa lta bu'o/ de yan chad kyis it mtha' can gyi sde tshan spyir btang dang dmigs gsal rnams bshad zin to/ ༈ /da ni īt mtha' ste ī ring po'i mtha' can bshad pa ni/ su shrī shapda/ gzugs mdzes sam/ dpal phun sum tshogs pa su shrī si rnam bcad/ su shrīḥ/ ybordhā to ri yu bau swa rau/ byings kyi ī ū iy up dag dbyangs la'o/ ming dang byings gzhi mthun pa'i rtags mtha' byings kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i ī ring po de/ pha rol dbyangs dang rnam dbye'i gzhi mthun can mthong ba na/ iy ru 'gyur ba las/ shrī ni ī ring bo dang byings mtha'i gzhi mthun yin la/ de bzhin du de 'dra'i ū de/ rnam dbye dbyangs la u b ru 'gyur ro/ /'dir ī iy ru 'gyur te/ si gong du bshad zin/ slar bha ldan rnams dang sup ma gtogs pa rnam dbye thams cad dbyangs yin pas de ltar go bar byas te/ su shrī au bzhaga.ī phral/ shra ī/ byings rtags kyi mtha'i ī iy ru bsgyur/ shr iy auzhes so/ dbyangs med/ su shri yau/ su shrī dzas/ dz song*/ ī i y/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ su shri yaḥ/ ༈ sambuddho gsum po yang de gsum dag 'dra la he bzhag pa nyid do/ he su shrīḥ/ he su shri yau/ he su shri yaḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈su shrī.am/ rtags mtha'i īt/ iy drangs pas/ su shriyaṃ/ bhyām/ bhis/ bhyām/ bhyas/ bhyām/ bhyas/ zhes pa drug dang sup ma gtogs/ kun la īt iy ru bsgyur/ dbyangs med pha rol 'dren pa go bar byas te/ su shrī au/ iy/ su shri yau/ su shrī shas/ 'di la sn bsgyur ba sogs dmigs gsal la bkag ste/ su shri yaḥ/ ༈ su shrī ṭā/

ṭra song*/ iy/ su shri yā/ su shrī bhyām/ su shī bhyaṃ/ su shrī bhis/ su shrī bhiḥ/ ༈su shrī nge/ ng dbyi/ iy/ su shri ye/ su shrī bhyām/ su shrī bhyāṃ/ su shrī bhyas/ su shrī bhyaḥ/ ༈su shrī ngasi/ ng dang i song*/ /iy/ su shri yaḥ/ su shrī bhyām/ su shrī bhyaṃ/ su shribhyas/ su shri bhyaḥ/ ༈su shrī ngas/ su shri yaḥ/ su shrī os/ su shri yoḥ/ su shrī ām/ su shri yāṃ/ su shrīngi/ ng phyis/ iy/ su shri yi/ ༈su shrī os/ su shri yoḥ/ ༈su shrī su/ p rjes 'brel/ i la las sa ṣa ste/ gratya ha raḥ su shrī ṣu/ ༈de bzhin du/ su dhī la yang ste/ su dhī si/ sudhīḥ/ sudhi au/ su dhī yau/ su dhi dzas/ sudhiyaḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa thams cad snga ma bzhin no/ ༈/ū yig mtha' can la/ swa yaṃ bhū la sogs pa ste/ su shri gzugs mdzes sam bde bar 'byor ba īt iy ru byed pa'i dod du/ rtags mtha'i ūt ub ru bsgyur ba ma gtogs cho ga thams cad 'dra ste/ swa yaṃ bhu si/ swa yaṃ bhūḥ/ swa yaṃ bhū au/ /swa yaṃ bhu bau/ swa yaṃ bhū dzas/ swa yaṃ bhu baḥ/ ༈swa yaṃ bhu am swa yaṃ bhū waṃ/ swa yaṃ bhū au/ swa yaṃ bhu bo/ swa yaṃ bhū shas/ swa yaṃ bhu waḥ/ ༈swa yaṃ bhūṭā/ swa yaṃ bhu bā/ swa yaṃ bhū bhyām/ swa yaṃ bhū bhyāṃ swa yaṃ bhū bhis/ swa yaṃ bhū bhiḥ/ ༈swa yaṃ bhu nge*/ swa yaṃ bhu be/ swa yaṃ bhū bhyām/ swa yaṃ bhū bhyāṃ/ swa yaṃbhūbhyas/ swi yaṃ bhu bhyaḥ/ ༈swa yaṃbhūngasasi/ swa yaṃ bhu baḥ swa yaṃ bhū bhyām/ swa yaṃ bhū bhyāṃ/ swa yaṃ bhū bhyas/ swa yaṃ bhū bhyaḥ/ ༈swa yaṃ bhu ngas/ swa yaṃ bhu baḥ/ swa yaṃ bhu os/ swa yaṃ bhu boḥ/ swa yaṃ bhū ām/ swa yaṃ bhū bāṃ/ ༈ swa yaṃ bhū ngi/ swa yaṃ bhu bi/ swa yaṃ bhu os/ swa yaṃ bhu boḥ/ ༈swa yaṃ bhū sup/ swa yaṃ bhū ṣu/ zhes pa rnams so/

se na nī zhes pa la/ su shrī las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod de/ ybau bā/ y b dag yang na'o/ /byings dang ming gi lus sbyar ba la rtags mtha'i īt y kho na dang*/ ūtb kho nar byed de/ de yang mtha'i dbyangs de'i snga rol tu yi ge brtsegs ma med pa dang*/ sngon du yi ge gnyis sam gsum sogs yod pa dgos so/ /bha ṣa barbhū/ lo dus su 'byung punarbhū/ slar yang 'byung ba/ gnyis 'dir bzung la/ gzhan bhū'i sgra dang dhī sgra spangs pa'i pho rtags īt.ūty rkyang pa dang b rkyang par bsgyur ba yin te/ rnam dbye dbyangs yin pa rnams la de ltar go bar bya'o/ ༈se na nī sde'i 'dren a ste dmag dpon no/ si/ se na nīḥ/ sen nī au/ nī ī phral/ n srog med/ ī zhes pa y ru bsgyur/ senāny.au/ dbyangs med pha rol pas drangs pas/ se na n+yau/ se nā nī dzas/ dz phyis/ īya ྄ru bsgyur/ drangs/ se nā n+yā/ se nā nī am/ ī ni y ru song*/ drangs/ se nā n+yaṃ/ se nā nī au/ gong bzhin/ se nā n+yau/ se nā nī shas/ sh song*/ ī ni y/ drangs/ se nā n+yaḥ/ se nā nī ṭā/ īy/ drangs/ senān+yā/ se nī nā bhyām/ se nā nī bhyāṃ/ se nā nī bhis/ se nā nī bhiḥ/ se nā nī nge/ ng dbyi/ īy/ drangs/ se nā n+ye/ senā nī bhyām/ senā nī bhyaṃ/ se nā ni bhyas/ se nā nī bhyaḥ/ gong dang 'dra/ ༈se nā nī nga si/ ng dang i phyis/ ī y/ drangs/ senā n+ye/ se nā nī bhyām/ se nā nī bhyaṃ/ se nā nī bhyaḥ ༈se nā nī ngas/ ngasi dang 'dra/ se nā n+yaḥ/ se nā nī os/ senā n+yoḥ/ se nā nī.ām/ se nā nī la sogs pa rnams las ām la nu yang na'o/ /zhes gzhan las bshad pas/ se nā nī nuṭra ām/ u dang ṭra phyis/ senā nī nāṃ/ se nā nī ām/ īy ru bsgyur/ se nā n+yāṃ/ ༈ āmengaḥ ngi ām'o/ nī tshig sdud can la rnam dbye ngi ni ām du 'gyur te/

se nā nī ngi/ ngi las d phyis/ i ām du bsgyur/ ḍi t la ṭi'o/ zhes pa thob pa ltar snang yang 'dir mi sbyor te/ se nā nī ām/ īy/ se nā n+yāṃ/ se nā nī os/ se nā n+yoḥ/ se nā nī sup/ se nā nī ṣu/ ༈he se nā nau/ he se nā n+yaḥ/ yang na'o zhes/ se nā nī kho na la yang na ston pa min/ īt mtha' ut mtha' spyi la yang na ba ston no gsung ste/ se nā nī sogs rag la/ su shrī'i bya ba dang*/ rang gi bya ba gdam ka yin nam dpyad do/ /tshig sdud med pa'i nī rkyang pa la ni/ /ī ring po i yr 'gro ste/ si au dzas/ am sogs la/ nīḥni yau/ ni yaḥni yaṃ sogs su bsgyur te/ su shrī skabs dang 'dra'o/ ༈lū zhing rnga ba rkyang pa la ni i y ru byed pa'i dod/ ub ru bsgyur ba nyid ma gtogs/ su shrī dang 'dra ste/ swa yaṃ bhū'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin yin pas/ lūḥ lu bau/ lu baḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈lū tshig sdud can ni/ se nā nī dang 'dra ste/ dper nas rnga ba yab lū si/ ya ba lūḥ/ ya ba lu au/ ya ba lwau/ ya ba lū dzas/ ya ba lwaḥ/ he ya ba lūḥ/ sogs/ bhyarṣā bhū dang*/ pu narbhū yang de dang 'dra ste/ bharṣā bhūḥbharṣā bhāau/ bharṣā bhāḥ sogs dang*/ pu narbhuḥ/ pu narbhāau/ pu na rbhāḥsogs so/ ༈/bā da pra mī/ ri dwags kṛ sna zhes pa yang phal cher de dang 'dra ste/ bā da pra mīḥ/ bā da pra myau/ bā da pra myaḥsogs/ 'on kyang rnam dbye'i rkyen gsum la mi 'dra ste/ am dag shas dang ngi gsum mo/ bā da pra mī am am gyi a yig phyis/ bā da pra māṃ/ ༈bā da pri mī shas/ am shas dag gi/ a'o/ shas gyi a phyis/ bā da pra mīḥ/ ༈ bā da pra mī ngi*/ nga dbyi/ 'dra ba la pha rol dbyi/ bā da pra mī/ zhes so/ /ī ring ū ring gi mtha' can bshad zin to/ ༈ /da ni ṛ t mtha'i rnam dbye 'jug tshul la/ /dang po pi tṛ'i sgra la mtshon na/ se ra/

si ā'o/ rit mtha' can rnam dbye dang po'i si ā ru 'gyur te/ pi tṛ si/ i brjod don/ s ā ru bsgyur/ de ni ḍi t yin pas/ ḍi t la ṭi'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i ṛ phyis/ dbyangs med pha rol/ pi sgy/ pi tṛ.au/ ar baṃ tsa pu/ lnga la ar'o/ lnga la zhes pa rnam dbye dang po lnga yin la/ da lta na/ si'i bya ba la ar mi 'byung bas/ gnyis pa sogs bzhi la zer dgos so snyam na/ tshig sdud kyi khyad par las mi 'gal te/ ba lang dkar po can 'dir shog byas na rdzi bo 'ong gi ba lang mi 'ong ba bzhin no/ /dngos su na rkyen dbyangs bzhi ste/ pa tṛ au/ ṛ aru?/ drangs/ pi ta rau/ pi tṛ dzas/ ṛ aru?/ drangs pi ta raḥ/ ༈ dheraḥ dhi ar'o/ ṛt mtha' la bod si byin na/ dhi ste bod si nyid ar du 'gyur/ de ni ḍit yin pas ḍot ṭi'o/ /zhes mtha'i ṛ dbyi dgos so/ ༈ pi tṛ si/ i brjod don/ s ar ṛ dbyi/ dbyangs med drangs/ r rnam bcad/ he pi taḥ/ he pi ta rau/ he pi ta raḥgong dang 'dra/ ༈pi tṛ am/ ṛ ar/ drangs/ pi ta raṃ/ pi tṛ au/ bi ta rau/ pi tṛ shas/ sh song*/ s n/ ṛ ṝ ru song*/ a phyis/ pi tṝnra/ ༈ pi tṛ ṭā/ ṛ r ru song*/ drangs/ pi trā/ pi tṛ bhyāṃ/ pi tṛ bhiḥ/ pi tṛ nge/ ṛ r drangs/ pi tre/ pi tṛ bhyāṃ/ bi tṛ bhyaḥ/ ༈ pi tṛ ngasi/ pi tṛ as/ rit las nga'i u'o/ /as us ru song*/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ pi tuḥ/ pi tṛ bhyāṃ/ pi tṛ bhyaḥ/ ༈pi tṛ ngas/ pa tṛ as/ ṛt la nga yi u'o/ /ṛ phyis/ pu tuḥ/ pi tṛ os/ ṛr*/ s rnam bcad/ pi troḥ/ pi tṛ ām/ nuṭ/ ṛ ring po/ na ṇa ru song*/ pi trau ṇāṃ/ ༈ ngau/ ngi la'o/ /pi tṛ ngi*/ ṛ ar du bsgyur/ t a dang*/ r i la drangs/ pi ta ri/ pi tṛ os/ pi troḥ/ pi tṛ su pra/ pitṛ ṣu/ ༈de bzhin du/ dzā mā tṛ la mag pa sogs pa'ang de kho na 'dra ba las/ rnam dbye drug pa'i mang tshig gi skabs/

nu ṭ ster yang*/ rtags mtha' ring por byed pa dang mi byed pa gdam nga ste/ dzā mā tṛ nuṭ ām/ dzā mā tṝ ṇ-i/ dzā mā tṛ ṇāṃ/ zhes so/ ༈ kartṛ gyi sgra la/ gzhan rnams pi tṛ'i sgra dang 'dra/ dang po lnga khyad yod de/ stu rār/ sa tṛ dag gi ār'o/ sa tṛ rkyen can te tṛ rkyen dang 'brel pa'am 'dus pa'i sa yig ṛt mtha' kartṛ lta bu de ni rnam dbye lnga la ār du 'gyur ro/ /'dir kartṛ gyi tṛ yig rkyen yin mod sa yig med pa la ji ltar 'dus shing 'brel snyam na/ da lta med kyang sngon 'dus pa ste/ byings kṛ la rkyen stṛ byin/ sa khyad don/ ka'i srog gi ṛ ar/ drangs pas/ kartṛ byung tri sngon dang po stṛ yin pas so/ /kartṛ si bzhaga.i brjod don/ rtags mtha' ār du bsgyur/ si ā'o/ /kartṛ'i rtags kyi pha rol tu rnam dbye dang po'i si'i sa srog med ā ru 'gro ste/ ā 'di ḍit yin pas 'dra ba'i bya ba mi byed de/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs te/ ār gyi ā phyis/ rt srog med ā la drangs/ kartā/ pi tā dang*/ kartā rkyen gzugs gcig du byung kyang bya ba mi 'dra ste/ 'dir ni rkyen ā ru song*/ rtags mtha' ār ring por song ba'i ā dbyi ba yin/ pi tā'i skabs rtags mtha'i ṛ ār du mi bsgyur ba khyad par ro/ /au sogs gzhan bzhi la yang*/ pi tṛ skabs su/ rtags mtha'i ar thung ngu dang*/ 'dir ār ring por bsgyur ba'i khyad kho na ste/ kartṛ au/ ṛ ār/ kartā rau/ kartṛ dzas/ as/ ṛ ār/ kartāraḥ/ ༈ kart-i am/ ṛ ār/ kartā raṃ/ ka rtṛ au/ ṛ ār/ kartā rau/ lhag ma shas sogs bcu drug dang*/ saṃ bo dha na gsum po rnams/ pi tṛ dang khyad med do/ /de bzhin du/ na tsha bo bhṛ/ p-itra shāstṛ/ tshad ma'i mtshon cha can ho tṛ/ shro tṛ/ thos pa can gā tṛ smra ba can la sogs pa yang kartṛ dang 'dra'o/ ༈ u thung mtha' can gyi rtags kyi nang tshan/

kroṣtu 'i ci spyang sgra la yang*/ si au dzas/ am au ste/ rkyen lnga po 'jug tshul/ kartṛ dang mtshungs te/ tṛ rkyen can zhes pa kun la'o/ kroṣtu si/ rnam dbye mthong bas rtags mtha'i u ṛ du gyur/ kroṣt-i?s/ si ā ru song*/ ḍit las ṭi phyis/ kroṣtū grub/ u ṛ du bsgyur/ ṛ ār/ dbyangs med pha rol/ kroṣtā rau/ kroṣtu dzas/ dz song*/ u ṛ/ ṛ ār/ drangs/ kroṣtā raḥ/ kroṣtu si/ ༈ bod si phyis/ s'i nus pas rtags mtha'i u ot du gyur/ he bzhag he kroṣto/ he kroṣtārau/ he kroṣtā raḥ/ si sogs rkyen lnga dang*/ bod si bya ba mi 'dra bas/ bod pa'i don gyi si ni lnga po la mi the bar tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa'o/ kroṣtu am/ u ṛ/ ṛ ār/ kroṣtā raṃ/ kroṣtū au/ kroṣtā rau/ kroṣtu/ shas/ s n/ rtags mtha' ring pa/ shas kyi a dbyi/ kroṣtūn/ zhes kartṛ dang*/ pi tṛ dang yang mthun/ sngar bha nu'i skabs dang yang mthun no/ /'grel par/ shas kyi skabs na/ tṛ'i sgra dang mi mthun zhes gsungs pa ni/ /rtags mtha'i u ṛ ru mi 'gyur ba'i don te/ gzhan 'dra'o/ ༈ ṭā nas brtsams te/ dbyangs kyi rkyen la kartṛ dang*/ bhā nu'i lugs 'dam ka yin par mdo gzhan las 'byung ba ltar sbyor te/ kroṣtu ṭā/ kroṣtā 'am/ kroṣtunā/ kroṣtu bhyāṃ/ poṣtu bhiḥ/ ༈ kroṣtu nge/ kroṣte dang*/ kroṣta be/ kroṣtu bhyāṃ/ kroṣtu bhyaḥ/ ༈kroṣtu ngasi dang*/ ngas kyi a phyis/ s rnam bcad/ kroṣtuḥ/ yang na a phyis/ u or gyur/ kroṣtoḥ/ kroṣtu bhyāṃ/ /kroṣtu bhyaḥ/ ༈kroṣtungas/ ngasi dang 'dra/ kroṣtuḥ'am/ kroṣtoḥ/ ngasi dang ngas kyi a phyis pas ṛ r mi thob po/ kroṣtu os/ ṛ r/ kroṣt+roḥ/ yang na u b ru bsgyur/ kroṣt+woḥ gang yang bcos ma bcos min gyi/ rab sbyor cho ga de la ni/ /rtag dang mi rtag gang de la/ /rtag pa'i cho ga stobs ldan nyid/ /kroṣtu ut mtha' yin pas/

/bhā nu'i lugs ni ut mtha' rang lugs yin pas bcos ma min pa dang gtan du ba'am rtag pa'i cho ga yin la/ tṛ rkyen la sogs pa ṛt mtha'i lugs sbyor ba ni/ gzhan las blangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ bcos ma dang mi rtag pa glo bur ba yin pas/ /gtan du ba'i cho ga dbang btsan pa'i brdar/ drug pa'i mang tshig la ṛt mtha'i lugs mi byed do/ kha cig ām dbyangs yin/ kyang nuṭra byin nas dbyangs pha rol tu mi 'gyur/ num byin pa'i gong du dbyangs pha rol yin kyang*/ nām ma yin pas ṛ ring por mi 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no zer ba mi 'thad de/ ṛ mtha' thams cad la yang thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ kroṣtu ān bzhag/nuṭ byin/ kroṣtū nāṃ/ 'di skabs gsal byed kyi sngon du byung bas/ tṛ sgra bzhin du mi byed ces ṛ ar mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal byed pha rol yin zhes pa'i don du 'grel ba'i dpe gcig na'ang 'dug ste/ gcig 'gas blo bzo bcug pa 'dra'o/ ༈kroṣtu ngi/ u ṛ ar/ kroṣta ri/ yang na ngi au/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ kroṣtau/ kroṣtu/ os/ gong bzhin/ kroṣtoḥ/ kroṣt+woḥkroṣtu sup/ kroṣtu ṣu/ skabs 'dir ṝ tra l̥tra dang l̥̄tra etra rnams kyi mtha' can med par grags so/ /pho rtags ai mtha' la/ su rai sgra ste/ rai sasbhi/ rais dang bha la'o/ /ait mtha' can la rnam dbye sa yig can si dang su p gnyis/ bha yig can bhyāṃ bhis bhyām bhyas bhyām bhyas te brgyad po de la/ rtags mtha' ai ā ru 'gyur la/ dbyangs kyi rang bzhin rnam dbye rnams la/ rtags mtha' āy ru bsgyur dgos te/ su rai si i song*/ ra'i srog ai ā ru 'gyur/ s rnam bcad/ su rāḥ su rai au/ ra'i ai yig ā y ru bsgyur/ drangs pa/ su rā yau/ 'di gnyis kyis phyi ma kun la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ su rai dzas/ su rā yaḥ/ ༈ bod pa la yang de kho na te/ he su rāḥ he su rā yau/

he su rā yaḥ/ zhes pa'o/ 'grel par thog ma bod si kho na las ma bshad de lhag ma gnyis phal cher du rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra bas dogs pa med la/ si la mi 'dra ba re yod pa mang ba la 'dir mi 'dra ba med pa la kha gsal byas ba'o/ /'di'i rigs 'og tu'ang mang ngo*/ /༈su rai am/ su rā yaṃ/ su rai au/ su rā yau/ su rai shas/ su rā yaḥ/ ༈su rai ṭā/ su rā yā/ su rai bhyām/ su rā bhyāṃ/ su rai bhis/ su rā bhiḥ/ ༈ su rai nge*/ su rā ye/ su rā bhyāṃ/ su rā bhyaḥ /༈ su rai ngasi/ su rā ya/ su rā bhyūṃ/ su rā bhyaḥ/ ༈ su rai ngas/ su rā yaḥ/ su rai os/ su rā yoḥ/ su rai ām/ su rā yāṃ/ ༈su rai ngi*/ su rā yi/ su rai os/ su rā yoḥ/ su rai sup/ su rā su/ ༈ ot mtha' can la go'i sgras mtshon na/ o rau/ o ni au'o/ rnam dbye thog ma lnga po las gcig pha rol du mthong bas/ rtags mtha'i o yig au yig tu 'gyur ro/ /go si/ o aus rnam bcad/ gauḥ go au/ o au ru song*/ au āb/ drangs/ gā bau/ go dzas/ o au/ āb/ drangs/ gā baḥ/ ༈bod pa'i don la'ang bya ba gzhan med de/ he gauḥ he gā bau/ he gā baḥ/ ༈ amsha si/ ā am shas la'o/ /'dir rnam dbye thog ma lnga zhes gong du bshad kyang*/ am la dmigs gsal du/ rtags mtha'i o ni ā ru bsgyur ba ste/ 'on kyang o dang ā 'dam kar bya zer ro/ /'grel pa'i dkyus la gdam nga med kyang*/ am ni lnga po'i cho ga dang*/ am shas gnyis rang gi cho ga ste bya ba gnyis 'dzin dgos/ gzhung gzhan las kyang bshad/ 'di'i 'grel bshad 'ga' las kyang yod ces/ paṇḍi ta 'chad do/ go am zhes bzhag ga'i srog gi o ni ā ru bsgyur te/ 'dra ba'i yi ge gāṃ/ go au/ gong dang 'dra/ ga bau/ go shas/ o ā ru bsgyur/ 'dra ba'i yi ge/ gāḥ/ ༈go ṭā/ ṭra song*/ o ab/ drangs/ gā bā/ go bhyāṃ/ go bhiḥ/ ༈go nge/ ng phyis/ o ab/ ga be/ go bhyāṃ/ go bhyaḥ/

༈ go nga si/ ng i gnyis phyis/ as bzhagangasi ngas kyi a'o/ /zhes pas/ a mi snang bar song*/ goḥ/ go bhyāṃ/ go bhyaḥ/ ༈go nga s/ nga si dang 'dra/ goḥ/ go as/ o ab rnam bcad/ ga boḥ/ go ām/ o ab/ ga bāṃ/ sdeb sbyor las nuṭra ster ba'ang yod pas/ go nāṃ/ 'greng bu dang na ro la rtags mtha' ring por 'gro rgyu med/ 'greng bu na ro nyid rtag tu ring po yin pas so/ ༈go ngi*/ o ab/ ga bi/ go os/ ga boḥ/ go sup/ go ṣu/ de bzhin du/ suryo rab tu snang zhes pa'i sgra la'ang go sgra ji bzhin no/ ༈ au yig mtha' can la 'dir/ glo zhes pa'i sgra ste/ de yang rkyen ha sa ste gsal byed dang po can brgyad ma gtogs pa thams cad la/ rtags mtha'i au yig āb ru bsgyur ba kho na yin la/ bod pa gsum yang rnam dbye dang po gsum dang 'dra'o/ glau si/ rnam bcad/ glauḥ/ glau au/ au āb/ glā bau/ glau dzas/ au āb/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ glā baḥ/ ༈he glauḥ/ he glā bau/ he glā baḥ/ glau am/ glā baṃ/ glau/ au/ glā bau/ glau shas/ glā ba༈ glau ṭā/ ṭra song*/ glā bā/ glau bhyāṃ/ glau bhiḥ/ ༈ glau nge*/ ng dbyi/ glā be/ glau bhyāṃ/ glau bhyaḥ/ ༈ glau ngasi/ ng i phyis/ glā baḥ/ glau bhyāṃ/ glau bhyaḥ/ ༈ glau ngas/ glā baḥ/ glau os/ glā boḥ/ glau ām/ glā bāṃ/ ༈ glau ngi*/ gla bi/ glau os/ glā boḥ/ glau sup/ glau ṣu/ zhes pa rnams 'grub bo/ dbyangs mtha'i rtags las pho rtags can gyi bya ba rnams rdzogs so/ ༈ da ni dbyangs kyi mtha' can mo rtags kyi bya ba rnams brjod par bya ste/ dang por ā yig mtha' can nam/ āp mtha' zhes pa'i sde las/ spyir btang gaṃ ga'i sgra la/ dang por gaṃ ga zhes pa la/ ā pa taḥst+ri yāṃ/ bud med la a la ā p'o/ /gaṅga āp/ p rjes 'brel/ 'dra ba'i yi ge las ring po zhes pas/ gī ring po song*/ gaṅgā zhes pa grub ste mo rtags so/ a yig mtha' can mo rtags su sgrub pa thams cad des 'gre'o/

/de la rnam dbye rnams ster ba las/ gaṅgā si/ ā paḥ/ āp las so/ /ā mtha' la rnam dbye dang po'i su dbyi'o/ /gaṃ gā grub bo/ /au rī/ au ī'o/ /gaṅgā au/ mo rtags āpra la au zhes pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa ī ru bsgyur/ a i la e'o/ /gaṃ ge /gaṃ gā dzas/ 'dra ba/ rnam bcad/ gaṃ gāḥ/ ༈ dhi riḥ/ dhi i ru'o/ /ru zhes pa'i skad dod med kyang mi nor ba'i don no/ /āp la dhi byin na/ dhi nyid i thung ngu 'gyur/ gaṅgā i/ zhes so/ /a i la e'o/ /he gaṃ ge/ he gaṃ ge/ he gaṃ gā/ de gnyis rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra/ ༈ ā mbā/ na gar ko ṭa'i lha mo akkā/ 'bigs byed lha mo a llā nor rgyun ma zer rnams la'ang*/ dhi i thung du 'gyur/ he ambe/ he alle/ he akke/ 'di gsum ka u mi'i ming ngo zer lha mo thams cad rgyud gcig zer ba'i lugs so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈gaṃ gā am/ mtshungs 'dra/ gaṃ gāṃ /gaṅgā au/ gaṃ ge/ gong bzhin/ gaṃ gā shas/ dzas dang 'dra/ gaṅgāḥ/ ༈ ṭau sor/ ṭā os dag la e/ gsum pa'i gcig tshig ṭā dang*/ drug pa dang bdun pa'i gnyis tshig os la rtags mtha' e dang e ay ru 'gro'o/ /gaṃ gā ṭā/ ṭra song*/ rtags mtha' e/ e ay/ drangs/ gaṃ ga yā/ gaṅga bhyāṃ gadgā bhiḥ/ ༈ ngi tāṃ yaṭ/ ngit rnams kyi yaṭra'o/ /nge dang*/ ngasi dang*/ ngas dang*/ ngi rnams la skabs 'dir/ yaṭra ā ga ma ster te/ gaṅgā nge*/ de la yaṭra ster ni dgos na/ 'di ṭit yin pas rnam dbye'i sngon du ste/ gaṅgā yaṭra e ṭra rjes 'brel/ a ni/ e la ai/ drangs/ gaṃ gā yai/ gaṅgā bhyāṃ/ gaṅgā bhyaḥ/ ༈gaṅgā nga si/ yaṭra byin/ gaṃ gā ya as/ mtshungs pa/ rnam bcad/ gaṃ gā yāḥ/ gaṃ gā bhyāṃ/ gaṃ gā bhyaḥ/ ༈ gaṅgā ngas/ ngasi dang 'dra/ gaṅgā yāḥ/ gaṃ gā os/ ṭā os dag la e/ zhes pas rtags mtha' e/ e ay/ rnam bcad/ gaṅga yoḥ/ gang gā ām/ nuṭra/ gaṅgā nāṃ/ ༈gaṅgā ngi*/ d phyis/ yaṭra byin/

ngi ām'o/ zhes pas/ i ām du bsgyur/ gaṃ gā ya ām/ gaṃ ga yāṃ/ gang gā /os/ gaṃ ga yoḥ/ gaṃ gā sup/ p rjes 'brel/ gaṅgā su/ ༈de bzhin du/ shraddhā/ dad pa me dhā/ blo gros shā lā/ khang pa mā lā/ 'phreng ba he lā/ smad ra do lā/ khyogs zhes sogs mang po zhig 'di dang 'dra'o/ ༈ sarb+ba rang nyid gong du bshad pa ltar pho rtags yin rung/ āp byin mor bsgrubs pas so/ /sarb+bā ces pa mo rtags te/ skyes pa'am skye bo thams cad ces pa lta bu la pho rtags 'jugadangos po la mo yin pa dang*/ sa gzhi la sogs pa blos btags pa'i mo mang po 'dus pa la yang*/ sarb+bā mo rtags 'jug go /sarb+bā la rnam dbye 'jug tshul gzhan rnams spyir btang gaṅgā'i skabs dang 'dra/ ngit rnams la khyad par yod de/ ya ṭonyatstsha/ yaṭra kyi a tra yang ngo*/ /yaṭra kyi at yang ngo*/ /yaṭra ā ga ma byin pas rtags mtha' a thung du 'gyur la/ yang zhes pas yaṭra la sngon du suṭ ā ga ma ster ro/ /de bas na/ sarb+bā la si sogs sbyin/ sarb+bā/ swarb+be/ sarb+bāḥ/ ༈he sarb+be/ he sarb+be/ he sa rb+bāṃḥ/ ༈sarb+bāṃ/ sarb+be/ sarb+bāḥ/ ༈ṭā os dag la e dang*/ e ay/ zhes pas/ sarb+ba yā/ sarb+bā bhyāṃ/ sarb+bā bhiḥ/ ༈sarb+ba nge*/ ngitra rnams kyi yaṭra/ zhes pas/ yaṭra/ yaṭra kyi at yang ngo*/ /zhes pas/ /rtags mtha' a thung dang*/ yaṭra kyi gong du suṭra sbyin/ /ṭra gnyis dang su'i u rjes 'brel/ sarb+ba s ya e/ e ai/ yai drangs/ syai/ sarb+ba syai/ sarb+bā bhyāṃ/ sarb+bā bhyaḥ/ ༈sarb+ba ngasi/ ng i phyis/ yaṭra/ suṭra/ rtags mtha' thung ngu*/ e ai/ sarb+ba syāḥ/ sarb+bā bhyāṃ/ sarb+bā bhyaḥ/ ༈sarb+bā ngas/ d phyis gzhan ngasi dang 'dra/ sarb+ba syāḥ/ sarb+bā os/ ṭā os dag la e dang*/ e ay/ s rnam bcad ces pas/ sarb+ba yoḥ/ sarb+bā ām/ nuṭra kyi dod*/ suṭra byin/ sarb+bā sāṃ/ ༈sarb+bā ngi*/ ngi ām du bsgyur/ yaṭra/ suṭra sbyin/ rtags mtha' a thung*/ sarb+bas ya ām/

sarb+ba syāṃ/ sarb+ba yoḥ/ drug pa dang 'dra/ sarb+bā su/ ༈dza rā rgan po zhes pa'i sgra la/ gaṅgā'i bya ba sgra ji bzhin pa byed pa dang*/ dbyangs thog ma can gyi rnam dbye gang byin kyang*/ dza rā nyid dza ras ru bsgyur ba 'dam kha ste/ dza rā si/ si dbyi/ dza rā/ dza re/ dza rāḥ/ ༈he dza re/ he dza rāḥ/ ༈dza rāṃ/ dza re/ dza rāḥ/ ༈ dza ra yā/ dza rā bhyāṃ/ dza rā bhiḥ/ ༈dzarā yai/ dza rā bhyāṃ/ dza rā bhyaḥ/ ༈dza rā yāḥ/ dza rā bhyaṃ/ dza rā bhyaḥ/ ༈dza rā yāḥ/ dza ra yoḥ/ dza rā ṇāṃ/ ༈dza rā yāṃ/ dza rā yo/ dza ra su/ zhes pa rnams ni ā ring mtha' can mo rtags spyir btangs kyi lugs yin la/ ༈yang dza ras zhes par bsgyur ba ni/ si dang bha ldan rnams dang sup rnams bor ba ste/ dza rā au/ dza ra sau/ dza rā dzas/ dza ras/ as/ dza ra saḥ/ ༈dza rā am/ dza ras/ am/ dza ra saṃ/ dza rā au+-i/ dza ra sau/ dza rā shas/ dza ra saḥ/ dza ra ṭā/ dza ra sā/ ༈dza rā nge*/ dza rā nga si/ dza ra saḥ/ ༈dza rā ngas/ dza ra saḥ/ dza rā os/ dza ra soḥ/ dza rā ām/ dza ra sāṃ/ ༈dza rā ngi*/ ༈dza rā si/ dza rā os/ dza ra soḥ/ zhes pa rnams so/ /mo rtags ā ring mtha' can gyi cho ga bstan zin to/ ༈ da ni mo rtags i thung mtha' can las buddha sgra la/ rnam dbye dang po gsum dang*/ gnyis pa gsum pho rtags i thung mtha' can spyir btangs dang 'dra ste/ buddhi si/ rnam bcad/ buddhiḥ/ buddhi au/ au ni ī ū dag go /zhes bas/ au/ ī ru song*/ buddhī/ buddhī dzas/ e o dzas la'o/ /zhes pas/ buddhe ru song*/ e ay/ buddha yaḥ/ ༈bod pa'i don la/ buddhi si/ byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la/ dhi dbyi/ zhes pas phyis/ dhi la'o zhes pas/ rtags mtha' e ru bsgyur/ he buddhe/ au dang dzas la he bzhag ba las gzhan dbye ba med/ ༈ bu ddhi am/ am shas dag gi a'o/ /a dbyi/ buddhiṃ/ buddhi au/ gong bzhin/ buddhī/ buddhi shas/ 'di ha ri dang cung mi 'dra ste/ s'i n mi byed/ shas la'o zhes pas/

rtags mtha' ring po/ buddhī/ a phyis/ buddhīḥ/ ༈ buddhi ṭā/ budhyā/ bhyāṃ bhis 'dra/ i dudbhyāṃ/ it ut dag las so/ bud med kyi rtags it mtha' dang*/ ut mtha'i pha rol du/ ngit byung na/ ngit la aṭu ā ga ma ster/ buddhi nge*/ d dbyi/ aṭra byin/ buddhi a e bzhaga.a yig e mthong ai ru song*/ buddhi'i iy drangs buddhyai/ de yang 'grel bar gdam gar bshad de/ aṭra mi sbyin na/ buddhi e/ rtags e/ e ay/ buddha ye/ bhyāṃ bhyas 'dra'o/ ༈buddhi nga si/ buddhi as/ it ut dag las so/ /zhes pas/ aṭra sbyin/ buddhi a as/ 'dra ba'i yi ge iy/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ buddhyaḥ/ yang na/ aṭra spangs pas/ buddhi as/ rtags mtha' e/ buddhe as/ ngasi ngas kyi a phyis/ rnam bcad/ buddheḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ'adra'o/ ༈buddhu ngas bzhagangasi dang 'dra bar bsgrubs buddhyāḥ/ yang na buddheḥ/ buddhi os/ iy/ rnam bcad/ buddhyaḥ/ buddhi ām/ nuṭra/ buddhī nāṃ/ ༈st+ri yāṃ yoḥ/ i u las bud med la'o/ /i ring thung u ring thung gi mtha' can mo rtags kyi pha rol gy-i ngi ni yang na ām du 'gyur ro/ /bud dhi ngi*/ ng phyis/ i au ru bsgyur/ de ḍitra yin pas/ ṭi phyis/ buddhau/ buddhi i/ it ut dag la'o/ /zhes at byin/ buddhi aṭra i/ i ām/ iy/ drangs/ buddhyāṃ/ buddhi os/ buddhyoḥ/ buddhi sup/ ku i la las sa ṣa zhes pas sa ṣa ru bsgyur/ buddhi ṣu/ buddhi kho na ltar/ ma ti/ blo gros bhu ti/ 'byor ba dhṛ ti/ 'dzin 'chang ru tsi mdzes pa la sogs pa rnams kyang rnam dbye 'jug tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ /dhe ba 'jom ste kā ma dhe nu/ 'dod 'jo nu'i sgra la/ dhe nu si/ rnam bcad/ dhe nuḥ/ dhe nu au/ au ni snga ma dang 'dra ba ū ru song*/ 'dra ba/ dhe nū/ dhe dzas/ u o/ o ab/ rnam bcad/ dhe na baḥ/ ༈bod pa'i don la/ dhe nu si byings min pa la dhi phyis/

rtags mtha' o/ he dhe no/ he dhe ni/ he dhe na baḥ/ ༈dhe nu am/ a phyis/ dhe nuṃ/ dhe nu au/ dhai nū/ dhe nu shas/ rtags mtha' ring*/ rkyen gyi a phyis/ dhe nūḥ/ ༈dhe nu ṭā ub/ dhe nwā/ bhyāṃ bhiḥ'adra/ ༈dhe nu nge*/ /aṭra ster/ dhe nu a e bzhaga.a ni ai/ dhe nu'i ub/ dhi nwai/ dhe nu nge o awa/ dhe na be/ /dhe nu bhyāṃ/ dhe nu bhyaḥ/ ༈dhe nu ngasi/ aṭra/ mtshungs pa/ uwa/ dhe nwāḥ/ dhe nu nga si a phyis/ rtags mtha' o/ dhe noḥ/ bhyāṃ/ bhyaḥ'adra/ ༈de nu ngas/ ngasi dang 'dra/ dhe nwoḥ/ dhe noḥ/ dhe nu os/ dhe nwoḥ/ dhe nu ām/ nuṭra/ rtags mtha' ring*/ dhe ni nāṃ/ ༈dhe nu ngi*/ ngi au/ rtags mtha'i u phyis/ drangs/ dhe nau/ yang dhe nu ngi*/ aṭra/ i ām/ 'dra ba ring ub/ dhe nwāṃ/ dhe nu os/ dhe nwoḥ/ dhenu su?p/ dhe nu ṣu/ de bzhin du/ ra dzdzu thag pa la sogs pa'ang 'dra'o/ ༈na dī'i rgyun can te chu bo'o sgra/ hasepaḥserlopa/ ha sa īp la si dbyi'o/ /nedīsi/ si dbyi/ īt kyi mtha' kun la rnam dbye dang po'i si dbyi ba kho na yin/ na dī/ na dī au/ īy ru bsgyur/ na dyau/ na dī dzas/ na dyaḥ/ ༈dhau hra swa/ dhi la thung du'o/ /mo rtags ī mtha' dang ū mtha' la/ bod si byin na/ rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gyur/ bod si 'jig go /he na di/ he na dyau/ he nadyaḥ/ ༈na dī am/ a phyis/ na dīṃ/ na dī au/ na dyau/ na dī shas/ a phyis/ rnam bcad/ na dīḥ/ ༈na dī ṭā ī/ īy/ na dyā/ na dī bhyāṃ/ na dī bhiḥ/ na dī nge/ ngi tā maṭra/ ngit la aṭra'o/ /mo rtags ī dang ྄ū'i mtha' las/ ngit yod pa rnams la aṭra ā ga ma ster te/ na dī nge/ aṭra/ na dī a e/ /a ai ru bsgyur/ ī y/ drangs/ na dyai/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ'adra/ ༈na dī nga si/ aṭra/ na dī a as/ mtshungs pa/ na dī ās/ ī y/ drangs/ na dyāḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ'adra/ ༈na dī ngas/ nga si dang 'dra/

na dyāḥ/ na dī os/ ī y/ rnam bcad/ nadyoḥ/ na dī ām/ nuṭra/ na dī nāṃ/ ༈na dāe ngi/ aṭra/ ngi ām/ īy/ drangs/ na dyāṃ/ na dī os/ na dyoḥ/ nadī sup/ na dī ṣu/ na dī dang 'dra bar/ gau rī/ u ma'am lo brgyad ma swa ra swa tī dbyangs can ma brāhma ṇī/ bram ze mo ku mā rī/ gzhon nu ma ki sho rī/ lo brgyad ma ka la bhā/ mdzes ma bu mo chung du rang la'ang zer la sogs pa mang ngo*/ /de dag ni īp mtha' yin te/ dper na/ na da la bud med kyi rkyen īp byin/ p rjes 'brel/ de'i srog a phyis/ drangs pas/ na dī zhes pa lta bu yin no/ ༈lakṣ+mī ni īp mtha' ni min/ mo rtags ī ring mtha' can yin pas phal cher dang 'dra ba dang*/ yang na pa yod pa la/ /dang po'i si mi dbyi ste rnam bcad du byed pa'ang yin/ bod si la rtags mtha' thung ngu rang du byed/ gzhan lhag ma rnams na dī ji lta ba'o/ ༈ st+rī zhes pa'i sgra la/ si dbyi ba kho na yin/ st+ri bhrū boḥ/ st+rī bhru yi'ang ngo*/ st+rī dang bhru'i sgra la/ pha rol rkyen rnam dbye dbyangs thog ma can la/ rtags mtha' iy dang ub ru bsgyur/ zhes te/ st+rī'i srog gi ī ring po de/ i thung y srog med dang bcas par 'gro ba dang*/ bhru'i srog gi ū ring po de/ u thung w srog med dang bcas par 'gro bas/ st+rī st+riy/ bhru la/ bhrub ru 'gyur te/ de yang st+rī si/ si dbyi/ st+rī/ st+rī au/ rtags mtha'i ī/ i y ru bsgyur/ st+ri yau/ st+rī dzas/ iy/ st+ri yaḥ/ ༈bod si la rtags mtha' thung si phyis/ he st+ri/ he st+ri yau/ he st+ri yaḥ/ ༈bāmsha si/ am shas la yang na'o/ st+rī am/ ī iy du bsgyur/ st+ri yaṃ/ yang na am gyi a phyis/ st+rīṃ/ st+rī au/ iy/ st+ri yau/ st+rī shas/ iy/ st+ri yaḥ/ tshig phrad kyi sgrub ba yin na ma gtogs/ /mo rtags la shas kyi s nar ru mi bsgyur ro/
