/yang na st+rī shas/ shas kyi a phyis/ s rnam bcad/ st+rīḥ/ ༈st+rī ṭā/ iy/ st+ri yā/ bhyāṃ bhiḥ/ ༈st+rī nge*/ aṭra/ iy/ a ai ru song*/ drangs/ st+ri yai/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈st+rī ngasi/ aṭra/ st+ri iy/ a as bzhagamatshungs 'dra drangs/ rnam bcad/ st+ri yā/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈st+rī ngas/ ngasi dang 'dra/ st+ri yāḥ/ st+rī os/ iy/ st+ri yoḥ/ st+rī ām/ nuṭra/ ṣa ra ra sogs/ rtags mtha' ring po sngar nas grub/ st+rī nāṃ/ ༈st+rī ngi*/ st+rī i/ i ām du gyur/ iy/ st+ri yāṃ/ st+rūi os/ st+ri yoḥ/ st+rī sub/ st+rī ṣu/ ༈shrī'i sgra la/ si rnam bcad/ shrīḥ/ gzhan/ shri yau/ shri yaḥ/ ༈ shri yaṃ/ shri yau/ shri yāḥ/ ༈shri yā/ shrī bhyāṃ/ shrī bhiḥ/ rnams na dī dang 'dra/ ༈be yu boḥ/ yang na iy ub la'o/ /mo rtags byings mtha' it dang ut iy dang ubr song ba la/ pha rol ngit bzhi bo rnams byung na/ aṭra ā ga ma ster ba dang mi ster ba yang na bar bya'o/ /shrī nge*/ ng phyis/ rtags mtha' iy/ aṭrabyin/ ṭra song*/ a de e mthong bas ai ru song*/ drangs/ shri yai/ yang na shrī e iy/ shri ye/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈shrī nga si/ aṭra/ mtshungs pa/ iy/ shri yāḥ/ yang na aṭra ma byin pas/ shri yaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈shrī ngas/ ngasi dang 'dra/ shri yāḥ/ shri yaḥ/ shrī os/ shri yoḥ/ mdo gzhan las/ shrī la sogs pa rnams kyi ām la nu yang na'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ shrī ām/ nuṭra/ shrī ṇāṃ/ yang na iy shri yāṃ/ ༈ shrī ngi*/ aṭra byin/ ngi ām/ iy/ shri yāṃ/ 'di aṭra mi ster na ām du yang mi bsgyur te/ iy/ drangs pas/ shri yi/ shrī os/ shri yoḥ/ shrī sup/ shrī ṣu/ ༈de bzhin du/ dhī blo/ hrī/ ngo tsha bhū/ bhū la sogs pa la yang bsgyub tshul shrī kho na dang 'dra'o/ ༈ ba dhu bu mo dang*/ dzambu la shing gi rigs sogs pa ni/ na dī sgra dang 'dra ste/ badhūsi/ badhūḥ/ badhū au/ ub/ ba dhwau/

de bzhin du/ badhwaḥ/ ༈he ba dhu/ he badhwau/ he badhwaḥ/ ༈badhwāṃ/ ba dhwau/ shas kyi skabs 'dir s'i n mi byed/ a dbyi/ rtags mtha' ring po'i/ /pa dhūḥ/ ༈badhwā/ ba dhū bhyāṃ/ ba dhu bhiḥ/ ༈badhwai/ badhū bhyāṃ/ badhū bhyaḥ/ ༈badhwāḥ/ ba dhū bhyāṃ/ ba dhu bhyaḥ/ ༈ba dhwāḥ/ badhwoḥ/ badhu nāṃ/ ༈badhwāṃ/ badhwoḥ/ badhu ṣu/ ༈ /ṛ yig mtha' can mo rtags la/ mā tṛ la sogs pa ste/ de yang gong du pho rtags su gtogs pa'i pi tṛ'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /mātā/ mā ta rau/ māta raḥ/ ༈he mā taḥ/ he mā ta rau/ he mā ta raḥ/ ༈mā ta raṃ/ mā ta rau/ mā tṝḥ shas kyi n mi byed a phyis rtags mtha' ring po'o/ ༈ mā tṛṭā/ ṛ ni r ru song*/ mātrā/ bhyāṃ bhyiḥ/ ༈mā tre/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈mā tṛ ngasi/ nga yi u'o/ nga u r bsgyur/ ṭi phyis/ mātuḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈mā tuḥ/ mātroḥ/ mā tṝ ṇāṃ/ ༈mātari/ mā troḥ/ mā tṛ ṣu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ swa sṛ'i sgra ni/ kartṛ gyi skabs dang 'dra ste/ swa sā/ swa sā rau/ sā rā raḥ/ ༈he swa sāḥ/ he swa sā rau/ he swa sā raḥ/ ༈ swa sā raṃ/ swa sā rau/ swa sṝḥ ༈ swa srā/ bhyāṃ bhiḥ/ ༈swa sre/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ng u/ ṭi phyis/ swa suḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈swa suḥ/ swa sroḥ/ swa sṝṇāṃ/ ༈ swas ri/ swa sroḥ/ swa sṛ ṣu/ zhes so/ ༈ e yig mtha' can mo rtags las rai zhes pa'i sgra ni/ su rai/ zhes pa'i skabs dang khyad med de/ rāḥ/ rā yau/ rā yaḥ/ ༈he rāḥ/ he rā yau/ he rāḥ/ ༈rā yaṃ/ rā yau/ rā yaḥ/ ༈rā yā/ rā bhyāṃ/ rā bhiḥ/ ༈rā ye/ rā bhyāṃ/ rā bhyaḥ/ ༈rā yaḥ/ rā bhyāṃ/ rā bhyaḥ/ ༈rā yaḥ/ rā yoḥ/ rā yāṃ ༈rā yi/ rā yoḥ/ rā su/ ༈go zhes pa la/ pho rtags mo rtags gnyis ka yod pa las/ mo rtags kyi go sgra la'ang*/ rnam dbye 'jug tshul pho rtags dang khyad par med de/ goḥ/ gā bau/ gā baḥ/ ༈he goḥ/ he gā bau/ he gā baḥ/ ༈gāṃ /gā bau/ gāḥ/ ga bā/ go bhyāṃ/ go bhiḥ/ ༈ga be/

/go bhyāṃḥgo bhyaḥ/ ༈goḥ/ go bhyāṃ/ go bhyaḥ/ ༈goḥ/ ga boḥ/ ga ba/ yang na go nāṃ/ ༈ga bi/ ga boḥ/ go ṣu/ ༈ mo rtags au yig mtha' can las/ nau zhes pa'i sgra ni/ pho rtags glau zhes pa'i sgra dang khyad par med de/ nauḥ/ nā bau/ nā baḥ/ ༈he nau/ he nā bau/ he nā bāḥ/ ༈nā baṃ/ nā bau/ nā ba/ nā bā/ nau bhyāṃ/ nau bhiḥ/ ༈ nā be/ nau bhyāṃ/ nau bhyaḥ/ ༈ nā baḥ/ nau bhyāṃ/ nau bhyaḥ/ ༈nā baḥ/ nā boḥ/ nā bāṃ/ ༈nā bi/ nā boḥ/ nau ṣu/ zhes pa rnams so/ /dbyangs mtha'i rtags las mo rtags rnams rdzogs so/ ༈ /da ni dbyangs mtha'i rtags las ma ning gi rtags bshad par bya ste/ a to am/ at las am'o/ /ma ning a thung gi mtha'i pha rol tu rnam dbye dang po'i si ste/ dhi min pa'i si dang*/ gnyis pa'i am ni/ nges par am kho nar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di snyam du si ni am du 'gyur pa bden du chug kyang*/ am nyid phyis nas yang am du byed pa dgos pa med do/ /zhes dogs so/ / min te dgos pa gzhan yang yod mod/ luk zhes bya ba'i dbyi bas 'jig pa de min pa'i don du go byed de/ 'og tu ma ning la si am 'jig go /zhes pa la sogs gcod pa'o/ /'dir ku la'i sgra la mtshon na/ ku la si i phyis/ s am du bsgyur/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ drangs/ ku laṃ/ ༈bod si ni dbyi ste/ bya ba gzhan med/ he ku la/ ༈ī mau/ au ī'o/ /ku la au/ au ī ru song*/ a i la e ku le/ ༈ ku la dzas/ zhes pa bzhagadza shsha bzhagadza shsha so shiḥ/ dzas shas dag gi shi'o/ /sha yig ni thams cad pa'i don te/ dz as gsum ka bsgyur gyi /a lta bu gcig kho na bsgyur ba min pa'i brda'o/ /gzhan las kyang*/ lci ba'i shit thams cad kyi'o/ /zhes bshad/ lci ba'i dzas shas lta bu yi ge du ma 'dus pa'i don no/ /nu ma ya maḥ ya ma min pa'i num'o/ /ya ma so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dgu po rtags mtha' la med na ma ning skabs 'dir/ dzasshas la num ā ga ma ster te/

pha rol sha yig dag la ster zhes 'grel bar 'byung ste/ sha yig ni shi la zer te/ dzas shas shi ru bsgyur ba'i ming ngo*/ /ku la dzas/ dzas shi zhes par bsgyur/ num ā ga ma byin/ gzhan las/ m it mtha' can dbyangs kyi pha rol lo/ /zhes 'byung bas/ i brjod don dang*/ m gnas kyi don yin pas/ num gyi u dang m dbyi/ gnas ni skabs 'dir dbus su 'jog pa'o/ /ku la nu shi/ no padhāyāḥ/ na'i u padhā'i 'o/ /na u pa dhā ni/ mtha' las snga ma u pa dhā'o/ zhes 'byung na/ 'dir mtha' ni n gsar byung de yin pas/ de'i snga ma dang po'i rtags mtha' an u padhā'o/ /n mtha' ru byung pa'i nus pas de ring por 'gyur te/ n rkyang pas mi na pha rol tu rkyen gyi sha yig yod na yin no/ /sh phyis/ n i la drangs/ ku lā ni/ grub po/ ༈ku la am/ a song*/ ku laṃ/ ku la shas/ dzas dang 'dra/ ku lā ni/ ༈lhag ma ṭā la sogs pa rnams pho rtags de ba'i sgra dang sgrub tshul 'dra ste/ ku le na/ ku lā bhyāṃ/ ku laiḥ/ ༈ku lā ya/ ku lā bhyāṃ/ ku le bhyaḥ/ ༈ku lāt/ ku lā bhyāṃ/ ku le bhyaḥ/ ༈ku la sya/ ku la yoḥ/ ku lā nāṃ/ ༈ku le/ ku la yoḥ/ ku le ṣu/ ༈he ku la/ he ku lau/ he ku lāḥ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈de bzhin du/ mū la rtsa ba dang*/ pha la 'bras bu dang*/ pa tra lo ma dang*/ pu ṣpa me tog dang*/ kuṇḍa snod dam dong dang*/ ku ṭumba la nye du sogs pa dpag tu med pa yang de dang 'dra'o/ ༈ shatwan+yā deḥ a n+ya la sogs pa la shtu'o/ /a n+ya la sogs pa 'phral du 'chad 'gyur rnams la/ si dang am ni shtu zhes par bsgyur dgos te/ an+ya si/ i phyis/ s ni shtu zhes par bsgyur/ u brjod don/ sh gong bzhin thams cad pa'i don te dbyi/ an+yat/ ༈ an+ya am/ si dang 'dra ste/ an+yat/ gzhan ku la dang 'dra/ a n+yat/ a n+ye/ an+ya ni/ ༈ an+yat/ an+ye/ an+ya ni/ a n+ye na/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ de bzhin du/ i ta ra'i sgra la/

i ta rat/ i ta re/ i ta rā ṇi/ la sogs pa dang*/ ༈ ka ta ra'i sgra la/ ka ta rat/ ka ta re/ ka ta rā ṇi la sogs dang*/ ༈ka ta ma'i sgra la/ ka ta mat/ ka ta me/ ke ta mā ni la sogs pa dang*/ ༈ a n+ya ta ra'i sgra la/ a n+ya ta re/ a n+ya ta rā ṇi/ la sogs pa ste/ rkyen ḍa ta ra ḍa ta ma la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /da ni i yig mtha' can la/ asthi zhes ba'i sgra la/ na puṃ sa kātasya mo rluk/ ma ning la si am dag 'jig go ma ning i mtha' la si dang am ni luk zhes te 'jig 'jig ces brda chad dngos 'di dang*/ gzhan rnam grangs su bkod pa dag ma 'dres pa bya'o/ pas dbyi ste/ luk gi sgras phyis pa tsam ma gtogs bya ba gang yang med pa'o/ /asthi si/ si dbyi/ a sthi/ asthi am/ am dbyi/ yb-i? ṇāṃ/ i u ṛ rnams kyi'o/ /ma ning skabs 'dir/ bod pa'i don la si byin na/ dhi de'i nus pas rtags mtha' yon tan du 'gyur te/ i ni e dang*/ u ni o dang*/ ṛ ni ar du 'gyur te/ asthi si/ byin/ i e/ asthi/ he bzhag /si dbyi/ he asthe/ 'grel par yang na bar bshad de/ yon tan ma byas na he asthi/ skabs 'dir 'grel par/ saṃbho dha na li na gzugs gsum sa mtha' u sha nas dang*/ /de bzhin na mtha' u shan de nas a mtha' u sha na pa sangs la/ /ik mtha'i yon tan stag rkang rus gcig ming nang nas mchog 'phags pa/ /lhag min drang srong nyin mo 'dod de ma ning rtags la'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ u sha nas dang*/ u shan/ u na/ zhes pa gza' pa sangs kyi ming yin la/ ma ning gi bod pa/ s mtha'/ n mtha'/ dbyangs mtha' gsum ga la rtags mtha'i yon tan 'byung bar drang srong ma dhya di nas bshad do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /nā mi naḥswa re/ nā mi dbyangs la nu'o/ /ma ning nā mi'i rtags mtha' can/ pha rol rnam dbye'i rigs dbyangs kho na ba'am/ dbyangs dang po can la/ num ā ga ma ster te/ asthi/ au num/ um dbyi/ au ī'o/ drangs/ asthi nī/ a sthidzas/

shi ru bsgyur/ num/ um phyis/ a sthin shi/ sh song*/ asthin/ i byung*/ drangs/ asthi ni/ u ba dhā ring po'o/ /asthīni/ am/ aushas kyang de dang 'dra ste/ asthi/ asthi nī/ asthī ni/ zhes pa'o/ ༈atstsā sthaṃnā sha sā dau/ asthi rnams kyi na at shas la sogs pa la'o/ /asthi la sogs pa rnams la/ pha rol tu shas la sogs pa ste/ shas kyi rting ma ṭā la sogs pa'i skabs 'dir 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i nang tshan rigs gcig la/ dngos su smon pa de mi bsdud pas/ 'dir yang shas mi sdud/ ṭā man thad sdud de/ ṭā byin gyi dbyangs kyi rnam dbye rnams gang byung yang*/ rtags mtha'i i a ru 'gro zhing*/ num ā ga ma ster ro/ /allo paḥsra re ྅mba yuktātstsha sā dau/ ma ba rab sbyor ma yin pa las shas sogs la at dbyi ste dbyangs la'o/ skabs 'dir ni num byin pas gsar du n mthar song ba'ang yin la/ gdod ma ma ning i mtha' yang yin la/ ma yig gam ba yig yod pa'i rab sbyor te/ ma'am ba yod pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma min pa cig pha rol du shas kyi rjes ma nas byung ba'i dbyangs kyi rnam dbye yod par gyur na/ u pa dhā ste/ gdod ma'i rtags mtha' dngos su mtha' las snga ma ste/ n mtha'i gong gi a yig ni dbyi bar bya'o/ /ma yig dang ba yig yod pa'i rab sbyor la ni mi dbyi'o/ /asthi ṭā/ num/ i a ru bsgyur/ a phyis/ a sthan ā/ n ā la drangs/ sth srog med kyang n la drangs/ asthanā/ bhyāṃ bhiḥ/ ༈ asthi nge num/ a phyis drangs/ asthn/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈asthi ngasi num/ i a/ a phyis drangs/ asthanāḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ asthi ngas/ ngasi dang 'dra/ asthanaḥ/ isthi os/ num/ i a/ phyis drangs/ a sthonaḥ/ asthi ā/ nu m/ i a/ phyis drangs/ asthaṃn/ ༈bedyoḥ/ i ngi dag la yang na'o/ /i dang ngi pha rol la ni u pa dhā'i a yig dbyi ba'am mi dbye ba yang na ba ste/ asthi ngi num/ i a/ a phyis drangs/

asthin/ yang na a ma phyis pas/ astha ni/ asthi/ os/ drug pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ asthonaḥ/ a sthi supa/ asthi ṣu/ zhes te/ 'dir a sthi sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas/ da zho dhi/ sa mdung kthi/ a mig ldan kṣi la sogs mang po ste sgrub tshul gcig pa'o/ ༈ de bzhin du/ bā ri chu/ bā ri ṇī/ bā rī ṇi/ am sogs la/ bā ri/ bā ri ṇī/ bā rī ṇi/ zhes pa rnams asthi'i sgra dang 'dra/ bā ri ṭā/ nā mi zhes pas/ num/ ṣa ra ri las nā ṇā ru song*/ bā ri ṇā/ ༈des dbyangs kyi rnam dbye kun la rigs 'gre ste/ /bā ri nge*/ nu m/ bā ri ṇe/ ༈ bā ri nga si/ num/ bā ri ṇaḥ bhyāṃ gsum bhyaḥganyis bhiḥrnams 'dra/ ༈ bā ri ngas/ num/ bā ri ṇaḥ/ bā ri os/ num/ bā ri ṇoḥ/ bā ri ām/ num/ bā ri ṇāṃ/ ༈bā ri ngi*/ nu m/ bā ri ṇi/ bā ri os/ num/ bā ri ṇoḥ/ bā ri sup/ bā ri ṣu/ ༈ na puṃ sa ka sya hra swaḥ/ ma ning gi thung du'o/ i mtha' sogs ma ning la rnam dbye byin na/ rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gro ba shas che ste/ grā ma ṇī si/ i phyis/ sa 'jigartags mtha' thung du'o/ grā ma ṇi/ grong sde'i phra ma mkhan rnam dbye dbyangs rnams byung na/ num ā ga ma ster te/ grā ma ṇī au/ au ī ru bsgyur/ num/ rtags mtha' thung du/ drangs/ grā ma ṇi nī/ grā ma ṇī dzas/ dzas shi ru bsgyur/ num mtha' thung ngu/ sha dang m phyis/ grā ma ṇa in/ i zhes pa las/ mang tshig gi nus pas i gong ma slar ring por 'gro ༈ so sor drangs pas/ grā ma ṇī ni/ ༈bod pa gsum pa la yang 'di kho na dang 'dra ba las/ he bzhag go ༈ grā ma ṇī.am/ mtha' thung*/ am phyis/ grā ma ṇi/ grā ma ṇī au/ gong dang 'dra/ grā ma ṇi nī/ grā ma ṇī shas/ /dzas dang 'dra/ grā ma ṇī ni/ ༈ ṭā dā bukta puṃ skaṃ puṃ bdwā/ ṭā sogs la skyes par bshad pa'i skyes pa bzhin yang na'o/ /dbyangs rkyen rnams la sngar bshad pa'i/ se na nī la sogs pa/

grā ma ṇi pho rtags dang 'dra bar ma ning sgrub pa dang*/ ma ning rang nyid kyi lugs su bsgrub pa gnyis yod de/ skyes pa bzhin zhes pas skyes pa rang min pa'o/ /grā ma ṇī ṭā/ iy ru song*/ grā ma ṇyāḥ/ grā ma ṇā nge/ iy/ grā ma ṇye/ ༈ des rigs 'gre ste/ grā ma ṇī ngasi/ grā ma ṇyaḥ/ ༈ grā mā ṇī ngas/ grā ma ṇyaḥ grā ma ṇī/ os/ grā mā ṇyoḥ/ grā ma ṇī ām/ grā ma ṇyāṃḥ/ ༈ grā ma ṇī ngi*/ rkyen gyi i ām/ grā ma ṇyāṃ/ grā ma ṇī os/ grā ma ṇyoḥ/ grā ma ṇī nge*/ e y/ grā na ṇī sup/ grā ma ṇī ṣā/ zhes pa pho rtags dang mtshungs par sgrub tshul yin no/ ༈yang na grā ma ṇī ṭī num/ /mtha' thung*/ grā ma ṇi nā/ ༈grā ma ṇī nge/ num/ mtha' thung/ grā ma ṇi ne/ ༈ grā ma ṇī ngasi/ as num mtha' thung*/ grā ma ṇi naḥ/ ༈grā ma ṇī ngas num mtha' 'thung*/ grā ma ṇi naḥ grā ma ṇī os num mtha' thung grā ma ṇi noḥ/ grā ma ṇī am/ mtha' thung num drangs mtha' slar yang ring po'o/ /grā ma ṇī nā/ ༈ grā ma ṇī ngi*/ num/ mtha' thung*/ grā ma ṇi ni/ grā ma ṇī os/ num/ grā ma ṇi noḥ/ zhes pa rnams ma ning nyid kyi rtags kyi bsgrub tshul yin pas 'di gtso che'o/ / skabs 'dir bha ldan drug dang sup la pho rtags dang ma ning gi khyad par med do/ ༈ //so ma pā/ zhes pa'i sgra ma ning rtags la/ pha rol rnam dbye gang byung yang*/ rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gyur nges la/ dang po gsum dang gnyis pa gsum/ grā ma ṇī sogs dang 'dra ste/ so ma pā si/ rtags mtha' thung*/ si am du bsgyur/ am gyi a phyis/ so ma paṃ/ so ma pā au/ thung/ au ī/ a i e/ so ma pe/ so ma pā dzas/ thung*/ dzas shi num/ sh phyis/ so ma pan i byung*/ rtags mtha' slar ring po'o/ /drangs/ so ma pā ni/ ༈de bzhin du/ so ma pā am/ thung*/ a dbyi/ so ma paṃ/ so ma pā au/ ī/ thung*/ so ma pe/ so ma pā dzas/

thung*/ ྄shi/ num/ sh phyis/ so ma pan i byung*/ rtags mtha' slar ring po'o/ /drangs/ so ma pā ni/ ༈ de bzhin du/ so ma pā am/ thung*/ a dbyi/ so ma paṃ/ so ma pā au/ ī/ thung*/ so ma pe/ so ma pā/ shas/ thung*/ shi/ num/ slar ring po/ so ma pā ni/ ༈ṭā man chad/ pho rtags de ba'i skabs dang 'dra ste/ so ma be na/ so ma pā bhyāṃ/ bhis kyi bha ar bsgyur/ a i la e/ a e la ai/ so ma baiḥ/ ༈ so ma pā de ak ey/ mtshungs 'dra/ drangs/ so ma pā ya/ so ma pā bhyāṃ/ so ma pe bhyaḥ/ ༈ so ma pā ngasi/ so ma pāt/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ bzhi pa dag 'dra/ ༈ so ma pā ngas/ so ma pa sya/ so ma pā os/ rtags mtha' e ru song*/ e ay/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ so ma pa yoḥ/ so ma pā/ ām nuṭra/ thung ngu slar ring por log/so ma pā nāṃ/ ༈ so ma pāngi/ so ma pai/ so ma pā os/ drug pa dang 'dra/ so ma pa yoḥ/ so ma pā sup/ so ma pe ṣu/ ༈ u yig mtha' can ma dhu'i sgra la/ ma dhu pho rtags ni dpyid ka la 'jugam ning rtags ni sbrang rtsi'o/ /rnam dbye dbyangs thams cad la/ num ster ba kho na yin no/ /ma dhu si/ si dbyi/ ma dhu/ ma dhu au ī/ num/ ma dhu nī/ ma dhu dzas/ shi/ num/ ring po/ ma dhū ni/ ༈ ma dhu am/ a dbyi/ ma dhu/ ma dhu au/ ma dhu nī/ madhu shas/ dzas dang 'dra/ ma dhū ni/ ༈ ma dhu ṭā/ num/ ma dhu nā/ bhyāṃ bhiḥ/ ༈madhu nga*/ num/ ma dhu ne/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ madhu ngasi/ num/ ma dhu naḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ madhu ngas/ num/ ma dhu naḥ/ ma dhu os/ num/ ma dhu noḥ/ ma dhu ām num/ ma dhu nāṃ/ ༈ma dhu ngi*/ num/ ma dhu ni/ ma dhu os gong dang 'dra/ ma dhusap/ ma dhu ṣu/ ༈ /ai ma ning yig mtha' can las/ a ti rai zhes pa la/ ji skad du thung ngu ā de sha mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge la i yig u yig dag kyang ngo*/ /zhes 'byung*/ /rtags mtha' e dang ai ni/ thung ngu i dang*/ o dang au ni thung du u ru 'gyur te/

a ti rai/ si/ rtags mtha' ai i ru bsgyur/ si dbyi/ a ti rai au/ num/ thung ngu*/ au ī/ a ti ri ṇī/ a ti rai dzas/ thung ngu*/ dzas shi/ num/ thung ngu ring po/ a ti rī ṇi/ a ti rai am/ phyis/ a ti ri/ a ti rai au ā num/ a ti ri ṇī/ a ti rai shas/ rtags mtha' thung*/ shi thung ngu ring por/ a ti rī ṇi/ ༈a ti rai ṭā/ num/ a ti ri ṇā/ a ti ri bhyāṃ/ a ti ri bhiḥ/ ༈ des 'gre ste/ a ti ri ṇe/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈a ti ri ṇaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈a ti ri ṇaḥ/ a ti ri ṇoḥ/ a ti rī ṇāṃ/ a ti ri ṇi/ a ti ri ṇoḥ/ a ti ri ṣu zhes te/ a ti rai zhes pa la/ rai nor can/ a ti rai zhes pa shin du nor can no/ ༈ a ti nau zhes pa la/ nau ni gru yin/ a ti nau/ gru chus khengs la khang pa'i ming yin/ de la rnam dbye nyer gcig gang byin kyang o la ltos pa'i thung ngu u ru 'gyur bas/ a ti nau si/ a ti nu si/ si dbyi/ a ti nu/ a ti nau au/ a ti nu au/ num/ au ī/ a ti nu nī/ ༈ a ti nu dzas/ shi/ nu ring po/ a ti nū ni/ ༈ de dang 'dra ba la/ a ti nu/ a ti nu nī/ a ti nū ni/ ༈ de bzhin du/ bha ldan rnams la 'gyur ba med la/ sup ṣu/ ༈ dbyangs rkyen rnams la num rtag par 'jug pas/ a ti nu nā/ ༈ a ti nu neḥ/ ༈ a ti nu naḥ/ a ti nu naḥ/ a ti nū noḥ/ a ti nu nāṃḥ/ ༈ a ti nu ni/ a ti nu noḥ/ a ti rai dang a ti nau/ bod si ster/ si rkyang bzhin nam/ slar yang ai dang au log 'gro ji ltar 'os pa 'dam kar bya'o/ ༈ yang kha la pū zhes pa la/ dang po drug bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ kha la pu/ kha la pu nī/ kha la pū ni/ ༈ kha la pu/ kha la pu nī/ kha la pu nī/ lhag ma ṭā sogs gong ya ba lū dang 'dra'o/ ༈ ṛ yig mtha' la/ kart-i'i sgra ni/ dang po drug po de dang 'dra ba las/ ṣa ra ri las na ṇa ru 'gyur te/ kartṛ/ kartṛ ṇī/ kartā+-i ṇi/ ༈ kartṛ/ kartṛ ṇī/ kart+ṝ ṇi/ ༈ṭā la sogs pa la gdam nga ste/

ma ning rang lugs ltar na/ dbyangs kyi rkyen rnams la num ster/ na ṇar bsgyur/ sup dang bha ldan la num gyi bya ba mi dgos so/ /kartṛ ṇā/ kartṛ bhyāṃ/ kartṛ bhiḥ/ ༈kartṛ ṇe/ kartṛ bhyāṃ/ kartṛ bhyaḥ/ ༈ kartṛ ṇaḥ/ kartṛ bhyāṃ/ kartṛ bhyaḥ/ kartṛṇaḥ/ kartṛ ṇoḥ/ ām 'di la rtags mtha' ring*/ kart+ṝ ṇāṃ/ ༈ kartṛ ṇi/ kartṛ ṇoḥ/kartṛ ṣu ༈pho rtags dag mtshungs par sgrubs na/ ṛ r ru bsgyur bas/ kartṛṭā/ ṭ song*/ ṛ r/ r ā la drangs/ t ya drangs pas/ kart+rā/ ༈ kartṛ nge/ katre/ ༈ kartṛ nga si/ ṛt la nga u'o/ /a u ru song*/ kartuḥ/ ༈ kartṛ ngas/ de dang 'dra/ kartuḥ/ ka rtṛ.os/ kart+roḥ kartṛ.āmkartṛṇāṃ/ ༈ kartṛ ngi/ karta ri/ kartṛ os/ kart+ro/ kartṛ sup/ kartṛ ṣu/ de ltar na dbyangs mtha' ma ning gi rtags rnams bshad zin to/ ༈ da ni ha sa'i mtha' can te gsal byed mtha' can las dang por pho rtags rnams bshad par bya'o/ /ha sa so sor bsdu ba ni gsal byed kyi ming ste ha sa'i mtha' can ni gsal byed mtha' can no/ de la dang po/ h mtha' can la/ a glang gyu pa na ḍu h zhes pa la/ sā ba na ḍu haḥ/ a na ḍu h'i si la'o/ /a na ḍuh la dang po'i si byin na/ num ā ga ma ster/ gzhan las/ a na ḍuh yi ām ā ga pa lnga po rnams la'o zhes 'byung ba/ si au dzas/ am au ste lnga po'o/ / 'dir ām dang num gnyis ka ster dgos pa rnam dbye la mi ster bar ming la ster la/ ming gi yang gsal byed la mi ster/ dbyangs mtha' ma de la ster bas/ skabs 'dir/ a na ḍu dang*/ mtha' rten h srog med kyi bar du ster ro/ /a na ḍu h si brjod don/ ām de'i 'og tu num/ m gnyis phyis/ a na ḍu ān hrah s/ saṃ yo gānta sya lo baḥ/ rab sbyor mtha' la dbyi'o/ rab sbyor ni gsal byed dbyangs med 'dus pa ste/ skabs 'dir/ n srog med dang*/ h srog med do/ /de las tha ma h phyis/

de yang pha rol ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen yod pa dgos pa las/ 'dir si byung la/ ngo bo tshig mtha' yin pa cig dgos na/ de yang si byin pas tshig tu grub ste/ de'i phyir h dbyi/ ha se pa se lo pa/ ha sa īp la si dbyi'o/ /zhes pas si yang 'jiga.a na ḍu ā n zhes pa lus so/ / ub/ drangs pas/ a na ṭawā ṭwā n/ gru/ a na hu? au/ ām/ uw/ a na ḍa ྄ba ྄ ā hā/ au/ zhes 'byung*/ so sor drangs/ a na hau/ a naḍu hdzas/ ām/ ub/ a na haḥ/ ༈ dha wa m/ dhi la am'o/ /bod si byin na/ rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang gzhan 'dra ba la/ ām ring po mi ster bar am ā ga ma thung ngu ster ro/ /de la/ a na n zhes pa 'byung*/ he a na ḍān/ he a na hau/ he a na haḥ/ ༈a na ḍu h a m/ ub/ drangs/ a na haṃ/ a na hau/ a na ḍuhu? sha s/ sha song/ drangs/ a na ḍu haḥ ༈ de bzhin du/ a na ḍu ha ྄ṭā/ drangs/ a na ḍu hā/ ༈ des rigs 'gre ste/ dbyangs rkyen lhag ma rnams la/ a na ḍuh nge/ a na ḍu he/ ༈ a na ḍuh ngasi a na ḍu haḥ ༈ a na ḍuh ngas/ a na ḍu haḥ ༈ a na ḍuh os/ a na ḍu hoḥ/ a na ḍuh ām/ a na ḍu hāṃ/ ༈ a na ḍuh ngi/ a na ḍu hi/ a na ḍuh/ os/ a na ḍu hoḥ/ zhes so/ ༈ bha ldan dang sup khyad par gzhan yod de/ a na ḍuh bhyām zhes pa bzhagab s rnams kyi ra sa ba sāṃ ra se/ la'o/ /rnams kyi zhes mang tshig ni bs kyi sogs khongs na/ sraṃ sa/ mtshon snun dhwaṃ s/ 'joms pa bhraṃs/ a na ḍu h la sogs pa'o/ /ming gi pha rol du ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen yod pa'am/ tshig mtha' la yang 'gyur te/ 'dir bha dang sa gnyis ka ra sa'i khongs su gtogs pas/ ra sa pha rol can la h ḍ ru song*/ drangs/ a na ḍudbhyū/ an ḍudbhiḥ/ ༈an ḍudbhyū/ an ḍudbhyaḥ/ ༈a na ḍudbhyū༈ a na ḍudbhyaḥ/ ༈a na ḍuh sup/ ba s rnams kyi ra sa la'o zhes pas/ h d ru song*/ kha sa la tsa pa rnams dzha sa ru 'gyur zhes pas d t ru 'gyur bas/

a na ḍut+su/ yang h srog med kyi mtha' can yin yang*/ de dang cung zad mi 'dra ba la/ ba 'jo ba go du h zhes pa la ni/ go du h si bzhag/dā derghaḥ/ da la sogs pa'i gha'o/ /da la sogs pa la/ tshu rol byings yin na/ pha rol dzha sa so sor bsdu ba rkyen la yod pa dang*/ tshu rol ming yin na pha rol ra sa byung*/ so sor bsdu ba yod pa'i rkyen nam/ tshig mthar song ba yin na/ h srog med gh srog med du 'gyur ro/ /si dbyi ste/ skabs 'dir ming yin la/ si'i s ma phyis gong du ra sa'i rkyen yin pas gh ru 'gyur la/ phyis zin na ni h de tshig mthar song bas gha ru byed de/ gang ltar yang nges par gh ru bsgyur ro/ /go du gh bzhaga.ā di dza bā nāṃ dzha bhānta sya dzhasadhwauauḥ/ dza ba'i dang po rnams kyi dzha bha mtha'i dzha bha ste sa dhwa rnams kyi'o/ /dzha bha so sor bsdu ba ni dzha ḍha dha gha bha'o/ /dza ba so sor bsdu ba ni/ dza ḍa da ga ba'o/ /skabs 'dir dzha bha'i bzhi pa gh yin/ de'i dang po ste sngon ma ni/ d yin na/ d yig dza ba'i gsum pa yin la/ dha ni dzha bha'i gsum pa yin no/ /de la dha dang da gnyis sde pa gcig pas/ sde pa mtshungs pa'i yi ge yin la/ dzha bha'i gsum pa dang*/ dza ba'i gsum pa yin pas grangs mtshungs pa'i yi ge yang yin no/ /dzha bha'i gh srog med mtha' can gyi dang po na yod pa'i dza ba'i yi ge d yig de gh yig mthong bas d dang mtshungs yig dh yig tu 'gyur ro/ /go dhu gh/ d dang gh'i bar na srog u yod kyang*/ dh ru busgyur ba 'di gsal byed kho na'i 'gyur ba yin pas mi sgrib bo/ /'dir de ltar yin la/spyir byings la dzha bha'i mtha' yod pa la/ mtha'i dang po'am sngon ma dza ba yod pa rnams dza ba de rang dag mtshungs pa'i dzha bha ru 'gyur ro/ /de la pha rol du rkyen sa yig dang dhwa zhes pa'i sgra yod pa dgos la/ ming mtha' yin na/

de tshig mthar gyur pa'am/ yang na ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen pha rol du yod na yang*/ rtags mtha'i gsal byed kyi gong ma gsal byed gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i gsal byed/ dza ba de/ de yang dzha bha dang mtshungs pa'i yi ger 'gyur ro/ /godhugh/ bā ba sa ne/ gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /gnas med pa zhes pa ni/ dbyangs med pas gzhan la ltos pa'i phyir/ gsal byed mtha'i ming yin la/ de la yang rkyen rnam dbye byin pa dgos la/ de yang dang po'i yi ge mtha'i sngon ma dza ba ru yod pa de/ dzha bha dang 'phrad pas/ yi ge sngon ma dzha bha sde grangs mtshungs par gyur pa de yod pa'i nus pas rtags 'gyur 'gro ste/ tshu rol dza ba ru ma zad/ gzhan mtshan nyid de 'dra tshang ba'i dzha sa gang yod kyang*/ pha rol gsal byed mtha'i dzha bha de/ dzha bha kho rang dang sde grangs mtshungs pa dza ba ru 'gyur te/ skabs 'dir sde ba mtshungs pa ka sde nang phan tshun yin pa dang*/ grangs mtshungs pa/ dzha bha'i bzhi pa gh de dza ba'i bzhi pa g ru 'gyur la/ yang na'o zhes dzha bha de tsa pa ru bsgyur te/ de yang sde ba mtshungs pa ka sde/ grangs mtshungs pa dzha bha'i bzhi pa gha de/ tsa pa'i bzhi pa ka ru bsgyur ro/ /go dhug go dhu k zhes pa'o/ /gzhan dbyangs kyi rkyen rnams sgrubs sla ste/ go du h au/ pha rol/ go du hauḥ/ go du h dzas/ go du haḥ/ ༈go du h am/ go du hāṃ/ ༈go du/ h au/ go du hau/ go du h/ shas/ go du haḥ/ ༈ go du h ṭā/ go du hā/ ༈ go du h ngi*/ go du hi/ go du/ ngasi/ go du haḥ/ ༈ go du h ngas/ go du haḥ/ go du h os/ go du ho/ go du h/ ām/ go du hāṃ/ ༈ go du h ngi*/ go du hi/ go du h/ os/ go du hoḥ zhes pa'o/ /bod pa rnams kyang he thog mar sbyor ba ma gtogs rnam dbye dang po'i gsum po sgra ji bzhin pa'o/ ༈ bha ldan rnams la ni/ go du h bhyām/ da la sogs pa'i gha'o/ /zhes pas/ h gh ru bsgyur/

'di la rtags mtha'i gong gi gsal byed la ltos pa'i mtha' ma de dza ba'i nang gi da yig yin pas gha yig de dzha bha'i nang gi dha yig tu bsgyur/ dzha pe dza ba/ zhes pa'i mdos/ dzha bha gh yigadza ba g yig tu bsgyur/ na te bur ba'o/ drangs pas/ godhu gbaṃbhyā/ go dhu gbhiḥ/ ༈go dhu gbaṃbhyā/ go dhu gbahyaḥ/ ༈go dhu ghyaṃ/ go dhu gbhaḥ/ ༈go du ha ྄h gh ru bsgyur/ kha sa la tsa pa dzha sar 'gyur bas/ pha rol su ni kha sa yin pa de mthong bas tshu rol dzha sa gha de/ tsa pa lda las k ru 'gyur/ ku i la las/ su'i s ṣa ru bsgyur/ drangs pas/ k ṣa rab tu 'dus pa las kṣa zhes pas/ go dhu kṣu/ ༈ yang ma dhu li h sbrang rtsi len pa'i bung ba'o/ /zhes pa phal cher de dag dang 'dra yang khyad par cung zad yod de/ madhu li ha si bzhagaho ḍha/ ha yi ḍha'o/ byings mtha' la h yod pa/ dzha sa pha rol la ḍh ru 'gyur ba dang*/ ming mtha' la ra sa pha rol lam/ tshig mthar gyur ba'i gnyis ka yin pa las kyang ste/ rtags mtha'i h yig ḍh yig tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir ming mtha'i h/ ra sa pha rol si'i sa las ḍh yig tu 'gyur te/ de nas si phyis/ gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /zhes pas/ rtags mtha'i dzha sa ḍh yig de/ yang na dza ba ḍa yig tu bsgyur ba'am/ yang na tsa pa ṭra yig tu bsgyur ro/ /ma dhu liḍ/ madhu liṭra/ ma dhulih au/ pha rol drangs/ ma dhu li hauḥ/ des dbyangs rnams rigs 'gre /ma dhu li haḥ/ ༈he ma dhu liṭ/ he madhu liḍ/ he ma dhu li hau/ he ma dhu li haḥ/ ༈ma dhu li haṃ/ ma dhu li hau/ ma dhu li haḥ/ ༈ma dhu li hā/ ༈madhu li hai/ ༈ ma dhu li haḥ/ ༈ ma dhu li haḥ/ ma dhu li hoḥ/ ma dhu li hāṃ/ ༈ ma dhu li hi/ ma dhu li hoḥ/ ༈ ma dhu li ha bhym/ h'i ḍha'o/ h ḍh ru song/ dzha pe dza ba/ zhes pas ḍh ḍ ru bsgyur/ drangs/ ma dhu liḍaṃbyā/ ma dhu liḍbhiḥ/ ༈ ma dhu li ḍaṃbyā/ madhu liḍabyāḥ/ la sogs pa'o/

/ma dhu lih sup/ h yig ḍh ru song*/ kha sa las dzha bha tsa par 'gyur bas ḍabhyaru song*/ ma dhu liṭsu/ dru hā dī nāṃ gha twa ḍha twe bā/ dru h la sogs pa'i gh nyid ḍh nyid yang na'o/ /dru h la sogs pa'i h yig gh yig dang ḍh yig tu bsgyur ba gdam ka yin la/ gh ḍh gnyis po la so sor dza ba dang tsa pa gdam kha yin te/ de yang dang po'i si dang bod si de ltar bzhi yin la/ bha lngan rnams la dza ba kho na yin gyi /tsa pa ma yin pas gnyis gnyis so/ mi tra dru hi/ si/ hra'i ḍha'o grogs bshes la mkhu ba/ zhes pas/ ha ḍha ru song ba'am/ bh nyid dang ḍh nyid ces pas/ gh dh gang rung bya/ mi tra dru gh/ mi tra dru ḍh/ dza ba'i dang bo rnams kyi dzha bha mtha'i dzha bha te sadhwa rnams la'o/ /zhes pas/ dzha bha'i yi ge gha dang ḍha gang mthong yang*/ gong ma dza ba'i yi ge dru'i da ni dh ru te/ mi tra dhrugh/ mi tra dhru ḍh/ zhes pa'o/ /gnas med ba la yang na'o/ /zhes pas/ gh ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs la dza ba'i nang tshan g dang*/ tsa pa'i yi ge k'o/ /ḍhru bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ tsa pa'i yi ge ṭ dang*/ dza ba yi ge ḍa ྄ru 'gyur ro/ /mi tra dhru g /mi tra dhru k/ mi tra dhru ṭ/ mitra dhruḍ/ zhes pa yin no/ /mi tra dru hau/ mi tra dru haḥ/ ༈he me tra dhrug he mi tra dhruk he mi tra dhruṭ/ he mi tra dhruḍ he mi tra dru hau/ he mi tra dru haḥ/ ༈am sogs la/ mi tra dru haṃ/ mi tra dru hau/ mi tra dru haḥ/ ༈mi tra dru hā/ ༈mi tra dru he/ ༈ mi tra dru haḥ ༈mi tra druhaḥ/ mi tra dru hoḥ/ mi tra dru hāṃ/ ༈mi tra dru hi/ ༈mi tra dru hoḥ/ bha ldan/ ha gha'am dh ru bsgyur/ ḍha ḍ dang*/ gha g ru 'gro ste/ dru dhru ru bsgyur/ drangs/ mi tra dhru bbhyaṃ/ mi tra dhru gbaṃbhyā/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈mi tra druh sup/ h dh dang*/ dru dhru ru song*/

kha sa las dzha bha tsa par bsgyur te/ ḍh ṭ'o/ /mi tra dhruṭsu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ ta twa muh de kho na nyid la rmongs pa la sogs pa rnams la yang ngo*/ ༈bhār bā/ khur bkyed de bong bu zhes pa la/ dang po lnga la khyad med/ shas sogs la khyad yod/ de yang bhā ra bāh si/ ha yi ḍha'o/ /h ḍh ru song*/ de yang gnas med pa zhes pas/ dza ba'i ḍa 'am tsa pa'i ṭ gang rung du byas/ bhā ra bā ṭ/ bhā ra ba ḍ/ bhā ra bāha/ au/ /bhār bā hauḥ bhā ra bā ha/ ༈he bhā ra bāṭ/ he bhā ra bāḍ/ he bhā ra bā hau/ he bhā ra bā haḥ/ ༈bhā ra bā haṃ/ bhā ra bā hau/ bā ho bau sha sā dau swa re/ bā ha'i shas sogs dbyangs la bā'i au'o/ /bhā ra bāha/ shas/ bā yongs rdzogs au ru bsgyur/ ra'i srog a dang mtshams sbyar te/ drangs/ rau ru song*/ shas man chad ṭā sogs dbyangs kun la rau 'di rtag tu 'ong ngo*/ /bhā rau haḥ/ ༈ḍā la/ bhā rau hā/ la sogs pa/ bdun pa'i os la bhā rau hoḥ/ zhes pa'i bar gong ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ste go sla/ ༈bha ldan rnams kyang*/ bhā ra bāha/ bhyām/ h'i ḍha'o/ /ḍh gnas med/ ḍha ḍ ru 'gyur/ bhā ra bāḍaṃbhyā/ des 'gre/ ༈bhā ra bāha sup/ h ḍh/ ḍh ṭ/ bhā ra bāṭsu/ ༈yang*/ tu sā h'i brgya byin gyi rta rā sgra la/ sā heḥṣaḥsā ḍhi/ sā ha'i ḍha la sa ṣa'o/ /sā ha'i sgra la si dang bha ldan dang sub rnams byin pa na/ sāha zhes pa'i sa yig ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ si la tshig mtha' yin pa dang*/ gzhan la ming mtha' ḍha'i nus pa ste/ tu rā sā h si/ bzhagah'i ḍha'o/ /ḍha/ sā ha'i ḍha la sa ṣa'o/ /zhes pas/ sa ṣar song*/ tu rā ṣā ḍhsi/ zhes so/ /si dbyi/ ḍh ni gnas med sogs kyi ḍ'am ṭ ru bsgyur ro/ /tu rā ṣāṭ/ tu rā ṣāḍ/ tu rā sāh/ au/ pha rol drangs/ tu rā sā hau/ de bzhin du/ tu rā sā haḥ/ ༈tu rā sā haṃ/ tu rā sā hau/ tu rā sā haḥ/ ༈tu rā sā hā/ zhes sogs/

bdun pa'i os/ tu rā sā hoḥ/ zhes pa'i bar go sla/ ༈bha ldan la/ tu rā sā ha bhyāṃ/ ha ḍha/ ḍha'i nus pas sa ṣa ru song*/ tu rā ṣā ḍhbhyām/ dzha bha la dzab zhes pas ḍ ru bsgyur/ tu rā ṣāḍaṃbyā/ des gzhan la'ang 'gre/ ༈tu rā sāh supa/ h ḍh/ s ṣ/ gnas med/ ḍh ṭa ru song*/ tu rā ṣāṭsu/ grub/ ༈ re pha'i mtha' las/ tsa tur gyi sgra dper brjod na/ tsa tur grangs kyi don la rnam dbye bdun po'i mang tshig kho na 'jug gi gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig mi 'jug go /dngos po brjod pa'i don la ni gcig tshig sogs thams cad 'jug ste dbye ba shes par bya'o/ ༈ tsa tu rā mshau tsa/ tsa tur gyi ām shi la'o/ /tsa tur bzhi gyi sgra la dngos po brjod pa'i skabs/ si au dzas/ am au rnams te lnga po la/ ām ā ga ma ster te/ shi zhes pa ni lnga po de rnams te/ rnam dbye lnga po de dag pha rol na yod pa la'o/ /grangs brjod pa la si sogs mi ster yang*/ /dzas ni lnga po'i nang sel yin pas lnga pha rol ces pa'i mi 'gal lo zer/ m'i mtha' can 'di dbyangs kyi pha rol lo zhes bshad pas/ ming mtha'i gsal byed srog med kyi gong*/ dbyangs 'jug ma de'i 'og mtha' ām ā ga ma ster ro/ /tsa tur si/ ām byin/ tsa tu ām r si/ si 'jiga.ub/ r rnam bcad/ tsa twāḥ/ tsa tur.au/ ām/ ub/ drangs/ tsa twā rau/ tsa turdzas/ ām/ ub/ drangs/ tsa twā raḥ/ ༈tsa tur am/ ām ā ga ma/ u b/ tsa twā raṃ/ tsa tur au/ tsa twā rau/ zhes pa'o/ gzhan dbyangs rnams la/ tso tu r shas/ drangs/ s rnam bcad/ tsa tu raḥ/ ༈des mtshon te/ tsa tu rā/ ༈tsa tu re/ tsa tu raḥ/ tsa tu raḥ/ tsa tu roḥ/ tsa tu rāṃ/ tsa tu ri/ tsa tu roḥ/ zhes pa dang*/ ༈bha sa thog ma can la/ ra pha rol du drangs/ 'og ma bha rnams gnyis su byed pa'ang yin/ sa gnyis su mi byed do/ /tsa tu rbhiḥ/ tsa turbhibhaḥ/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ tsa turbhyāṃ/ gsum/ tsa turbhyaḥ/

gnyis/ tsa turṣu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈grangs kyi don ni/ tsa twā raḥ/ tsa tu raḥ/ tsa tu rbhiḥ tsa tu rbhyaḥ/ tsa tu rbhyaḥ/ ༈raḥsaṃ khyā yāḥ/ ra yi grangs kyi'o/ /tsa tu r gyi re pha'i mtha' nuṭ ster/ tsa tu r n ām/ zhes 'byung*/ n drangs/ nār mthong*/ ṇāṃ du song*/ ṇ nyis brtsegs su 'gyur/ tsa tu rṇ+ṇaṃ/ ༈tsa turṣu/ zhes pa mang tshig bdun po kho na'o// ༈ //n mtha' las/ rā dza n rgyal po gyi sgra ni/ rā dzan si/ na'i u pa dhā ring po'o zhes pas/ dzā ring po'o/ /nāmno no lo pa sha dhau/ ming gi na'i dbyi ba dhi min pa la'o/ /zhes pas n dbyi ste/ de yang dhi ma yin pa rnam dbye dang po'i si ni n mtha' can gyi ming mthar byin na/ mtha'i n dbyi ste/ 'grel par ā ga ma min pa zhes 'byung ste/ gdod ma'i ming mtha'i na yig dgos pa'i don no/ /pha rol du ra sa'i rkyen yod pa'am/ rang nyid tshig mthar song ba gang rung gcig dgos pa las/ 'dir si ma phyis gong du/ bsgyur na/ ra sa pha rol dang*/ sa phyis rjes su bsgyur na tshig mtha' 'o/ /si phyis/ rā dzā/ rā dza n/ au upa dhā ring po/ drangs rā dzā nau/ rā dzan/ dzas/ ring po/ rā dzā naḥ/ ༈dhi ma yin pa zhes pa'i khyad par gyi tshig gis/ bod si ni kho rang dbyi ba kho na las/ u pa dhā ring po dang rtags mtha'i na dbyi ba gnyis ka med de/ he rā dzan/ gzhan gnyis ni gong dang 'dra/ he rā dzā nau/ he rā dzā naḥ/ ༈am la/ rā dzā naṃ/ au la rā dzā nau/ rā dzan shas bzhag/ma ba rab sbyor min pa las shas sogs la at dbyi ste dbyangs la'o/ /zhes gong du 'byung bas/ dza'i srog gi a phyis/ sa tu ni sha tsu rnams las sha tsu'o/ /zhes gong du 'byung bas/ ta sde'i n ni gong gi tsa sde'i dza mthong bas tsa sde ny yig tu song*/ rā dznya as/ dza nyaurdzñaḥ/ dza nya dag gi dzñā'o/ /dz dang ny dag sdoms pa dzña ste/ de as la drangs/ rnam bcad/ rā dzñaḥ/ ༈de ma gtogs 'og gi dbyangs rkyen rnams la 'di kho nas rigs 'gre/

gsal byed thog ma can rnams la gong si'i skabs kyi ming gi na'i dbyi ba'o thob/ ༈u pa dhā ring po mi thob ste/ ṭā man chad la/ rā dzñā/ rā dza bhyāṃ/ rā dza bhiḥ/ ༈rā dzñe/ rā dza bhyāṃ/ rā dza bhyaḥ/ ༈rā dzñaḥ/ rā dza bhyāṃ/ rā dza bhyaḥ/ ༈rā dzñaḥ/ rā dzñoḥ rā dzñāṃ/ ༈gong du i ngi dag yang na'o/ /zhes pas yang na ba la u pa dhā dbyi ba'i phyogs dkyus bzhin yin/ rā dzñi/ mi dbyi na/ n i la drangs/ rā dza ni/ rā dzñoḥ/ ༈rā dza su/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ ya dzwan lha mchod mkhan/ a tma n nga bdag/ su dha rm+ma n lugs bzang*/ de la sogs pa n mtha' mang po phal cher/ rā dzan dang mtshungs kyang*/ atman dang*/ dharm+man gyi ma dang*/ ya dzwan gyi ba ste/ de rnams ma ba rab sbyor yin pas/ u pa dhā'i at mi dbyi'o/ /des na ya dzwan si/ ring po byed/ si 'jig /n dbyi/ ya dzwā/ ya dzwā nau/ ya dzwā naḥ/ ༈bod pa'i n mi dbyi/ ring po med/ he ya dzwan/ he ya dzwānau/ he ya dzwā naḥ/ ༈ya dzwā naṃ/ ya dzwā nau/ zhes pa rnams/ rā dzan dang 'dra/ ༈de nas shas sogs mi mtshungs te/ u pa dhā'i a ma phyis pas/ rtags mtha'i n srog med pha rol tu drangs pa kho nas chog ste/ ya dzwanaḥ/ ༈ya dzwa nā/ na min zhes pas n dbyi'o/ /ya dzwa bhyāṃ/ ya dzwabhiḥ/ ༈ya dzwa ne/ ya dzwa bhyāṃ/ ya dzwabhyaḥ/ ya dzwanaḥ/ ya dzwabhyāṃḥ/ ya dzwabhyaḥ/ ༈ya dzwa naḥ/ ya dzwa noḥ ya dzwa nāṃ/ ༈ya dzā ni/ ya dzā noḥ/ ya dzwa su/ zhes pa'o/ ༈shwa na khyi dang*/ yu ban lang tsho dang*/ ma gha ban brgya byin rnams la/ si au dzas/ am au lnga rnams rā dzan gyi skabs dang 'dra/ shwā/ shwā nau/ shwā naḥ/ ༈he shwān/ he shwa nau/ he shwa naḥ/ ༈shwā naṃ/ shwa nau/ zhes pa'o/ ༈shas man chad dbyangs la mi 'dra ste/ shwā de shtsa shwa sogs kyi yang ngo/ /shwan sogs la shas sogs dbyangs kyi rnam dbye byin na rtags mtha'i gong gi ba yig u ru 'gyur ro/ /shwan gyi skabs 'di dang*/ de phan dang*/

īp dang*/ ā yig las kyang de 'dra mang ngo/ shwan shas/ ba u/ shu naḥ/ ༈de dang 'dra ba kho nar ṭā sogs dbyangs la/ shu nā/ ༈shu ne/ ༈shu naḥ/ ༈shu neḥ/ shu noḥ/ shu nāṃ/ ༈shu ni/ shu naḥ/ ༈na mi na lo pa sha/ zhes n phyis pas/ shwa bhyāṃ/ shwa bhiḥ/ shwa bhyāṃ/ ༈shwa bhyaḥ/ ༈ shwa bhyāṃ/ shwa bhyaḥ/ ༈shwa su/ mtha'i n dbyi ba kho na'o/ ༈yu ban la ni dang po lnga 'dra/ yu bā/ yu bā nau/ yu bā naḥ/ ༈he yu ba n/ he yu bā nau/ he yu bā naḥ/ ༈yu bā naṃ/ yu bā nau/ zhes pa'o/ ༈shas man chad dbyangs la/ ba dbyangs dang bcas pa u ru 'gyur te/ u ni yu'i u dang mtshungs 'dra sbyar/ n drangs/ yū naḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ yū nā/ ༈yū ne/ ༈yū naḥ/ yū naḥ/ yū noḥ/ yū nāṃḥ/ ༈yū niḥ/ yū noḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈bha ldan dang sup la/ yu dang ba rang gnas dang mtha'i n dbyi ste/ yu ba bhyāṃ gsum dang*/ yu ba bhyaḥganyis dang*/ yu ba bhiḥ zhes pa dang*/ yu ba su/ zhes so/ ༈ma gha ban la yang*/ ba srog can u ru bsgyur/ u la o'o/ mtshams sbyar bas/ ma ghon zhes 'byung ba las/ dang por si sogs lnga rā dzan dang 'dra/ ma gha bā zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈shas sogs la yang*/ ma gho naḥ/ sogs dang*/ ༈ma gha ba bhyāṃ/ sogs/ ma gha ba su/ zhes pa'i bar 'gre'o/ ༈n mtha' las thin lam gyi sgra la/ i totpañtsa su/ itra kyi at lnga la'o/ /pa thin la sogs pa'i sgra rnams la/ si sogs lnga byin pa na/ thi'i srog gi i lta bu u pa dhā i yig at du 'gyur te/ de ltar lnga las si kho na'i bya ba la/ thā nu ṭ/ tha'i nu ṭ'o/ panthi sogs kyi pha rol/ si sogs lnga la tha yig sogs la nuṭ ā ga ma ster ro/ /ā sau/ ā si la'o/ /de'i rjes su bya ba la/ lnga'i nang nas si byin pa na/ ṭi ā ru 'gyur/ si rnam bcad do/ de yang pa thin si it kyi at lnga la'o/ / zhes tha'i srog gi i a ru bsgyur/ pa th an/ si tha la nuṭ ster de/ ḍit yin pas tha'i gong du byin/

ṭ rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ ban th an s si byin pa'i dus/ 'dir ḍit ni tha n gyi sroga.an te/ de ā ru bsgyur/ si rnam bcad/ panthāḥzhes pa grub/ pa thin au/ tha'i i at/ nu ṭ gong*/ n yi u pa dhā'o/ /zhes pas/ a padhā tha'i dbyangs ā ru song*/ n drangs/ panthā nau/ pa thin dzas/ au 'dra par bsgrub pas/ panthānaḥ/ ༈de kho na 'dra bar/ am dang au ste/ pa thin am/ panthā naṃ/ pa thin au/ panthā no/ zhes so/ ༈ panthāṃ ṭe/ pantha rnams kyi ṭi'o/ /shas sogs dbyangs la pa thin la sogs pa rnams kyi ṭi phyis te rnam dbye dang mtshams sbyor/ bha ldan dang sup la mtha'i n dbyi ba kho na'o/ /pa thin shas/ pa thin/ as/ pantha rnams kyi ṭi zhes pas/ thin'i in phyis/ th dbyangs med drangs/ pa thaḥ/ ༈pa thin ṭā/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/ pa thā/ pa thin bhyām/ pa thi bhyāṃ de bzhin du/ pa thi bhiḥ/ ༈pa thin nge*/ pa the/ pa thi bhyāṃ/ pa thi bhyaḥ/ ༈pa thin ngasi/ pa thaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ'adra/ ༈pa thin ngas/ pa thaḥ/ pa thin os/ pa thoḥ/ pa thin ām/ pa thāṃ/ ༈pa thin ngi*/ pa thi/ pa thin/ os/ pa thoḥ/ pa thin ྄sup/ n phyis/ ku i la s ṣa/ pa thi ṣu/ ༈de bzhin du/ ma thin srub pa dang*/ ṛ bhūkṣin brgya byin la sogs pa yang de kho na'o/ ༈danḍin ྄'i sgra la cung zad mi 'dra ba yod de/ i nāṃ shau sau/ in rnams kyi shi dang si la'o/ /in mtha' dang*/ han dang*/ puṣan dang*/ arya mn nyi ma sogs rnams la/ sha ste/ dza s shas dang*/ si'i rnam dbye dhi ma yin pa pha rol du byung na/ u pa dhā ring por 'gyur te/ daṃ ḍin si/ u pa/ dhā ḍa yi ī ring por gyur/ si phyis/ tshig mtha'i n srog med phyis te/ daṃ ḍī'am/ daṇḍī zhes pa grub po/ daṃ ḍa n au/ daṃ ḍi nau/ daṃ ḍi n dzas/ daṃ ḍi naḥ/ ༈de bzhin du gnyis pa gsum la/ daṃ ḍi naṃ/ daṃ ḍi nau/ daṃ ḍi naḥ/ ༈daṃ ḍi n/ ༈bod pa'i si byin/ si phyis/

ring po dang n phyi ba med/ ༈he daṃ ḍin/ he daṃ ḍi nau/ he daṃ ḍi naḥ/ ༈de bzhin du ṭā sogs la 'gre/ ༈bha dang sa la n dbyi/ daṃ ḍi nā/ daṃ ḍi bhyāṃ/ bhiḥ'adra/ ༈daṃ ḍi ne/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈daṃ ḍi naḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈daṃ ḍi naḥ/ daṃ ḍi noḥ/ daṃ ḍi naṃḥ/ ༈daṃ ḍi ni/ daṃ ḍi noḥ/ daṃ ḍi ṣu/ ༈daṇḍin kho na dang 'dra bar/ ka lin cha shas can dang*/ ka pā lin thod pa can dang*/ mu sha lin gtun shing can dang*/ danti n glang po dang*/ mā lin 'phreng ba can dang*/ dha ni nor can n la sogs pa yang ngo*/ ༈ han gyi dbang du byas na/ brahma han tshangs pa gsod pa zhes pa lta bu la/ brahma han la si/ si phyis/ ha ring po/ n yang dbyi/ brahma hā/ zhes gong dang 'dra/ /de bzhin du/ au la sogs pa la/ ṣa ra ṛ na ṇa ru bsgyur ba dgos/ gzhan 'dra/ /brahma ha ṇau/ brahma ha ṇaḥ/ brahma ha ṇaṃ/ brahma ha ṇau/ ༈ha no ghni/ han'i gha na la'o/ han gyi mtha' can la/ shas sogs dbyangs kyi rkyen byung na/ ha yig de gha yig dbyangs med du 'gyur la/ n as la drangs/ de la gh drangs/ s rnam bcad byas pas/ brahma ghnaḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ brahma ghna/ bha sa la n dbyi ste/ brahma ha bhyāṃ/ brahma ha bhiḥ/ ༈brahma ghne/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈brahma ghnaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈brahma ghnaḥ/ brahma ghnoḥ/ ༈brahma ghni/ brahma ghnoḥ/ brahma ha ṣu/ ༈pu ṣan la dang po lnga brahma han dang 'dra ste/ pū ṣā/ pū ṣa nau/ pū ṣa ṇaḥ/ ༈pū ṣa ṇaṃ/ pū ṣa ṇau/ shas sogs kyang phal cher 'dra/ pu ṣa n shas/ ṣa yi a phyis/ ṣa dang n a s la drangs/ pūṣṇaḥ ༈pūṣṇā sogs dang*/ puṣa bhyāṃ sogs/ ༈ngi'i skabs su/ pū ṣan gyi ngi la ṭi dbyi ste/ 'ga' zhig tu yang na'o/ zhes bshad pa/ pū ṣas n ngi*/ a phyis pa shas sogs dang 'dra bar byas na/ puṣṇi/ yang na n i la drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ las n ṇ/ pu ṣa ṇi/ yang na ṭi dbyi ste/ ṣa ṇ gyi an phyis/ ṣ i la drangs/ pu ṣi/ zhes pa gsum po gdam nga'o/

/pū ṣṇoḥ/ pu ṣa su/ ༈ary+yam n gyi sgra la/ ary+ya mn si/ in rnams kyi shi dang si la'o/ /zhes/ u pa dhā mn gyi ā ring por 'gyur/ si phyis/ tshig mtha'i n yang dbyi'o/ /ary+ya mā/ zhes so/ ary+ya ma ṇau/ ary+ya ma ṇaḥ/ ༈ary+ya ma ṇaṃ/ ary+ya ma ṇau/ ༈he ary+ya mn/ he ary+ya ma ṇau/ he ary+ya ma ṇaḥ/ shas sogs dbyangs la u pa dhā phyis/ bha sa la mtha'i n phyis pas/ ary+yamṇaḥ/ ༈ary+yamṇā/ ary+ya ma bhyāṃ/ ary+ya ma bhiḥ/ ༈ary+yamṇe/ ary+ya ma bhyāṃ/ ary+ya ma bhyaḥ/ ary+yamṇaḥ/ ary+ya ma bhyāṃ/ ary+ya mabhyaḥ/ ༈ ary+yamṇaḥ/ ary+ya ma ṇoḥ/ ary+ya mṇāṃ/ ༈ary+ya mi/ zhes sam/ ary+yamṇi/ ary+ya ma ṇoḥ/ ary+ya ma su/ ༈grangs kyi don du/ pañtsan gyi sgra la/ mang tshig gi mtha' kho na te/ de yang paṃ tsa bhū ma yaṃ/ mo rtags kho na dang*/ paṃ tsa pu ru ṣa/ pho rtags dang*/ pañtsa ku laṃ/ mi ning gi rtags te/ ku la paṃ tsa kho na las rkyen gyis bsgyur ba med pas/ rang bzhin gyi rtags gsum pa zhes zer la/ de yang paṃ tsan dzas bzhagadzashsha so rluk/ dzas shas dag dbyi 'jig go/ grangs kyi don ṣ mtha' dang n mtha' la/ dzas sha s ni lu ga zhes pa 'jig pa ste/ skabs 'dir n mtha' la dzas dbyi 'jig ste/ de yang spyir rkyen dbyi ba la rkyen gyi bya ba yod la/ 'jig pa la ni bya ba med pa nyid do/ 'dir yang ste/ dzas phyis tshig mtha'i na yang phyis pas/ paṃ tsa zhes pa kho na'o/ /༈pañtsa n shas/ shas 'jig paṃ tsa/ ༈bha sa la n dbyi/ paṃ tsa n bhis/ pañtsabhiḥ ༈paṃ tsa bhyaḥ/ ༈ṣṇaḥ/ ṣa na'i'o/ grangs kyi ṣ mtha' n mtha' la ām gyi skabs su nuṭ ster ba las/ 'dir n mtha' yin/ paṃ tsan/ n ām/ no pa dhā ya/ zhes pas tsa ring po/ n mtha' phyis/ paṃ tsā nāṃ/ paṃ tsa su/ ༈de kho na ltar/ saptan/ na ban/ da shan rnams de dang mtshungs par sgrub po/ ༈aṣtan la ni khyad par cung zad yod de/ aṣta no bā ḍau/ aṣtan las ḍau yang na'o/ /aṣtāl ni dza s dang shas byin na/

dzas shas nyid ḍau ru 'gyur ba yang na ba ste/ ḍ rjes 'brel la ṭi dbyi'o/ / aṣta n dzas/ dzas ḍau ru song*/ ḍ rjes 'brel/ ṭi an dbyi/ drangs/ aṣtau/ ༈yang na paṃ tsan gyi skabs ltar dzas 'jig tshig mtha'i n phyis/ aṣta/ ༈aṣtan shas ḍau an phyis/ drangs/ aṣtau/ yang na shas 'jig n phyis/ aṣta/ ༈bā su/ 'di rnams la ā yang na'o/ /bā ā yang na/ a sub 'di rnams la/ b phyis gzhan rnams 'dra ba mtshams sbyor ba'o/ ༈aṣta n bhis/ n phyis/ aṣta bhiḥ/ aṣtanbhis/ u pa dhā ring po/ n phyis/ aṣta bhiḥ/ ༈des 'gre ste/ aṣta bhyaḥ aṣtā bhyaḥ/ zhes dang*/ aṣta bhyaḥ/ aṣtā bhyaḥ zhes so/ ༈ām la gdam ka mi byed de gzugs gcig nyid do zhes bshad/ de yang ring por bsgyur ba kho na te/ aṣtan ām/ aṣtā nāṃ/ ༈yang kha cig gdam nga byed kyang*/ sngon ma ring por mi bsgyur ba'i phyogs la'ang*/ rtags mtha'i n phyis/ nuṭ byin/ nām la ring por byas pas/ aṣtā nāṃ/ zhes pa ka yod pas/ cho ga mi 'dra yang gzugs gcig go zer ro/ /sup la gong bzhin/ aṣta su/ aṣtā su// ༈ //m yig gi mtha' can i dm gyi sgra la/ i dm si/ i da mo3 yaṃ puṃ si/ skyes pa la i da m gyi a yaṃ mo/ i dm la pho rtags kyi sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir/ i dm si dang bcas pa a ya m du bsgyur/ a yaṃ/ i dm au/ da sya maḥ/ da'i ma'o/ /da zhes pa tyad sogs kyi nang nas mtha' rten da yod pa'am/ yang na 'dir i dm gyi da kho na ma ru bsgyur ba'o/ /de la 'grel par/ tyad sogs la ṭi'i mtha' dbyi ba'am a ru 'gyur bar bshad pas/ dm gyi am a ru bsgyur ba'am/ m dbyangs med phyis/ i da au/ da'i ma'o zhes pas/ i da'i da ma ru bsgyur/ i ma au/ drangs/ i mau/ i dm dzas/ ṭi phyis/ da'i ma'o/ /sarba'i skabs su/ dzas ī'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ī ru bsgyur/ a i la e'o/ /i me/ ༈tyad sogs la bod tshig mi 'byung ngo*/

/i dm am/ ṭi phyis/ da ma/ drangs/ i maṃ/ de bzhin du/ i mau/ i dm/ shas/ skyes pa la s na'o/ shas kyi s n ru bsgyur/ ṭi phyis/ da ma/ shas la'o/ zhes pas ma ring po'o/ /am sha s dag gi a'o/ /zhes shas kyi a phyis/ i mān/ ༈ a na ṭau soḥ ṭā os dag la a na'o/ /i dm la ṭā dang*/ drug pa dang bdun pa'i aus byin na/ mgyogs par byed na/ i dm nyid a nar bsgyur ba'am/ thob thang du byas na ṭi dbyi/ da ma byed dgos te gnyis po de si sogs sup kyi bar thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /des im/ /ā/ im/ a na ru bsgyur/ a na'i na srog can no/ /ṭā yi ā i na ru byas/ mtshams sbyar bas/ a ne na/ ༈sbabhyaḥ/ sabhya la a'o/ sup dang bha ldan gyi rkyen la/ im ni a ru 'gyur ro/ /i dm bhyām/ ṭi a im a/ bha la a'o/ /zhes pas/ i dm 'gyur ba'i thung ngu'i a de ring po ā ru gyur/ ā bhyāṃ/ bhi sbhiḥ/ bhis bhis so/ i dm dang a das la/ bhis phyis nas yang bhis nyid du byed do/ /'grel par bhis las mi 'gyur yang bhis snga ma phyis pa'i dgos pa ni/ bhi'i bha a'o/ /zhes dang*/ a yig bhis la e yig yang na'o/ zhes pa'i don dgag pa'i phyir yin par bshad do/ /'on kyang bha sa mang po nyid la ni e'o/ /zhes pas e ru bsgyur te/ de yang idam bhis/ phyis/ bhis bcos/ ṭi.a i ma a ru a de yang e ru/ bsgyur/ e bhiḥ/ ༈i dm nge/ i dm/ a ru bsgyur ba'i bar gong bzhin/ smaṭ byin/ a e la ai/ asmai/ ā bhyāṃ/ gong dang 'dra/ i dm bhyas/ idam/ a/ a e/ e bhyaḥ/ ༈i dm ngasi bzhaga.a ru bsgyur ba gong bzhin/ ngasi āt/ smaṭ/ 'dra ba'i yi ge/ asmāt/ ā bhyāṃ/ e bhyaḥ/ ༈i dm ngas/ a gong bzhin/ ngas sya'o/ /asya/ i dm os/ gong bzhin a na ru bsgyur/ os la'o zhes pas a na'i srog e ru bsgyur/ e a y/ drangs/ a na yoḥ/

i dam/ ām/ i dm a'i bar du bsgyur pa dang*/ a e ru byed/ suṭ byin/ i s ā ma zhes so/ ku i la las ṣa zhes pas s ṣ ru song*/ drangs/ eṣāṃ/ ༈idam ྄ngi*/ i dam a ngi smin du bsgyur/ a smin/ i dam os/ ṭā os la a na ru 'gro ste gong bzhin/ an yoḥ/ i dm sup/ i dm a'i bar du bsgyur/ a de yang e song*/ ku i la las sṣa/ e ṣu/ ༈ ma'i mtha' can kim gyi sgra la/ tyad sogs rnams kyi si sogs la ṭi a ru byed de/ rnam dbye nyer gcig po kun la yin no/ /kim si/ ka'i srog i yig m srog med dang bcas pa a ru 'gyur te/ drangs pas ka srog can du song*/ si s rnams bcad/ kaḥ/ kim au/ kim ka ru 'gyur/ kau kim dzas/ kim ka dzas ī/ a i e/ ke ༈kim am/ ༈ka am gyi a phyis/ drangs༈ kaṃ kim au/ ka o au/ kau kimshas/ s n ka shas la'o/ zhes pas kā ring po/ kān/ ༈kim ṭā/ ka in/ ke na/ kim bhyām/ ka bhal a'o/ /zhes pas kā ring po/ kā bhyāṃ/ kim bhis/ ka bhi yibha a'o/ /zhes pas/ ka a is/ a i e/ e ai/ drangs/ s rnam bcad/ kaiḥ/ ༈kim nge*/ kasmaṭ/ e ai/ ka smai/ bhyām gong dang 'dra/ kā bhyāṃ/ bhyas la bhas mang po zhes pas rtags mtha' e/ ke bhyaḥ/ ༈kim ngasi/ kasmaṭ/ at/ ka sma.at/ mtshams sbyar/ kasmāt/ bhyaṃ/ bhyaḥ/ gong dang 'dra/ ༈kim ngas/ ka ngas sya/ ka sya/ kim os/ ka os la'o/ /zhes pas ke/ e ay/ ka yoḥ/ kim ām/ ka suṭ kas ām/ drangs/ ka sām/ sām gyi sa byung bas bha sa mang po la e/ ke ku i la la sa zhes pas s ṣ ru song*/ keṣāṃ/ ༈kam ngi*/ smin/ kasmin/ kim os/ ka ke ay/ ka yoḥ kim sup/ ka bha sa mang po nyid la e/ ke ku i la sogs/ ke ṣu/ de dag phal cher sarba'i skabs bzhin bsgrubs pa'o// ༈ /ngha yig mtha' la/ ta twa budha de kho na nyid de rtags pa/ zhes pa'i sgra la/ ta twa budha si/ dza ba'i dang po rnams kyi dzha bha'i mtha'i dzha bha ste/

sa dhwa rnams kyi'o/ zhes pa/ dza ba'i nang tshan bu yig ni/ dbyangs med pa dzha bha'i nang tshan dhra mthong bas/ rang dang sde grangs mtshungs pa'i bhu yig 'gyur te/ ta twabhudha/ zhes pa'o/ de nas gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /zhes gong dza ba dzha bhar song ba'i nus pas/ 'og ma dzha bha srog med de dza ba'am tsa pa ru 'gro ste/ dza ba ltar na sde grangs mtshungs pa'i ḍ ru 'gyur/ tsa pa ltar na sde grangs mtshungs pa'i ṭ ru 'gyur ro/ ta twa bhu ḍ/ /ta twa bhuṭa/ lhag ma dbyangs rkyen rnams la gsal byed pha rol la 'dren pa kho na te/ ta twa bu dhau/ ta twa bu dhaḥ/ ༈ta twa bu dhaṃ/ ta twa bu dhau/ ta twa bu dhaḥ ta twa bu dhā/ ta twa bu dhe/ ༈ta twa bu dhaḥ/ ༈ta twa bu dhaḥ/ ta twa bu dhoḥ/ ta twa bu dhāṃ/ ༈ta twa bu dhi/ ta twa bu dhoḥ/ he tatwa bhuḍ/ he ta twa bhuṭ/ he ta twa bu dhau/ he ta twa bu dhaḥ/ ༈bha sa la/ dza ba dang po sogs kyi/ ba bha ru bsgyur/ dzha bha la dza ba rnams so/ /zhes dha yig d yig tu song ste drangs gnas med sogs/ ta twa bhuḍaṃbhyā/ ta twa bhubbhyaḥzhes so/ /ta twa bu dhā sup/ dza ba dang po sogs/ bu bhu/ kha sa la tsa pa dzha sa zhes pas/ dh yig t yig tu bsgyur bas/ ta twa bhut+su/ zhes pa ste phal cher go dhu hra zhes pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /dza mtha' can la/ samrādz zhes pa dper brjod do/ /tsha sha ṣa rā dzā deḥṣaḥ/ tsha sha ṣa rā dz la sogs pa'i ṣa'o/ /tsh mtha' dang sh mtha' dang ṣ mtha' dang rā dz la sogs pa ste/ rā dz// ya dz lha mchod/ sṛdz/ bhradz/ la sogs pa mang po dag ste/ de rnams la si byin na/ mtha'i tsha sh ṣ dz rnams ṣa yig tu 'gyur la/ ṣo ṣa yi ḍa'o/ /ṣ yig de ḍ yig tu 'gyur te/ ṣa ru byed pa dang*/ ḍa ru byed pa gnyis ka byings rkyang pa'i mtha' yin pa dzha sa pha rol dang ming mtha' la ra sa pha rol can/ bha sa'i rkyen dang si phyis pa'i tshig mtha' la'o/ /ṣ nyid ṣ ru byed pa mi 'thad do snyam na/

ṣ mtha' ḍ yig bsgyur ba dgag pa'i don ni/ /thog ma nas ṣa yin na ḍa ru 'gro la/ phyis bsgyur ba'i ṣa yig la mi dgos pas so/ /dper na/ dwe ṣ ṭi la/ dwe ṭī byas na ches mi bde bas/ dweṣti zer dgos pa'i ched do/ /de yang samrādz si/ si phyis/ tsha sha ṣa rādz la sogs pa'i ṣa'o/ /zhes dza yig ṣa yig tu bsgyur/ ṣ yi ḍa'o zhes ṣ de yang ḍa yig go /gnas med sogs kyang 'jug pas/ yang na tsa pa ste ṭ ru byed do/ / samrā ḍ/ samrāṭ/ lhan ma dbyangs rnams la pha rol du 'dren/ bha sa la/ tsha sha ṣa rā dza la sogs pa'i ṣa'o/ /zhes rtags mtha' ṣa dang*/ khyad par du bha ldan la ṣa'i ḍa'o'am/ dzha bha las dza ba zhes pas/ ṣ de ḍa ྄ru song 'dren/ sup la khyad par du/ kha sa la tsa par bsgyur te/ ḍ ṭ ru bsgyur ba'o/ /sa mrā dzau/ samrā dzaḥ/ ༈he samrāḍ/ he samrāṭ/ he samrā dzau/ he sa mrā dzaḥ/ ༈sa mrā dzaṃ/ samrā dzau/ samrā dzaḥ/ ༈samrā dzā/ samrāḍaṃbyāṃ/ samrā ḍbhiḥ/ ༈samrā dze/ bhyāṃ 'dra/ samrāḍabyaḥ/ ༈samrādzaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ'adra/ ༈samrā dzaḥ/ samrādzoḥ/ samrā dzāṃ/ samrā dzi/ samrā dzoḥ/ samrā ṭsu/ zhes so/ / bi rā dzā la sogs pa'ang de kho na dang 'dra'o// ¿༈ d'i mtha' can ni/ tyad yad ye tad la sogs pa'o/ /'di dag sarb+ba sogs kyi nang tshan yin pa ltar spyir btang de'i sgrub tshul dang 'dra/ gsal byed mtha' can gyi bya ba cung zad mi 'dra ste/ tyad/ si/ tyad sogs rnams si sogs la ṭi a ru 'gyur bas d phyis tya zhes pa'o/ /si sogs zhes pa rnam dbye nyer gcig thams cad la ste/ 'dir ni/ staḥ/ ta'i sa'o/ /tyad kyi tya si mthong na/ ya btags rang sor bsdad/ ta ni s ru 'gyur bas sya/ si rnam bcad/ syaḥgrub/ ta sa ru bsgyur ba ni/ si kho na la yin gyi/ dbyangs rkyen rnams lta ci smos/ bha sa la yang ma yin no/ /tyad ྄tya ru song ba gzhir bzhag nas/ tya au/ tyau/ tya dzas/ ī/ a i e/ tye/ ༈tya am/ a dbyi/ tyaṃ/

tya au/ tyau/ tya shas/ s n ru/ shas la'o/ /rtags mtha' ring po/ shas kyi a phyis/ tyān/ ༈tyaṭā/ in/ tye na/ tya bhyām/ bha la a'o/ zhes/ tyā bhyāṃ/ tya bhis/ bhi yi a'o zhes/ tyaiḥ/ ༈tya nge*/ smaṭ/ tyasmai/ tyā bhyāṃ/ tya bhyas/ bha sa mang po zhes pas/ tye bhyaḥ/ ༈tya ngasi/ āt/ smaṭ/ tyasmāt/ tyā bhyāṃ/ tye bhyaḥ/ ༈tya ngas/ tya sya/ tya os/ /os la'o zhes pas/ rtags mtha' e/ e ay/ tya yoḥ/ tya ām su ṭ/ bha sa mang po zhes tye/ ku i las s ṣ ste/ tye ṣāṃ/ ༈tya ngi/ tyasmin/tya os/ gong bzhin/ tya yoḥ/ tya su p/ bha sa mang po zhes pas rtags mtha' e/ ku i la sogs sa ṣa ru song ste/ tye ṣu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈tad kyi sgra la cho ga 'dra yang*/ gzugs 'gyur la the tshom mi 'jug pa'i phyir zur tsam smos na/ tad si/ d phyis/ ta sa ru bsgyur/ rnam bcad/ saḥ/ zhes pa grub/ gzhan yang tad ta ru song ba gzhir byas te/ des mtshon nas/ tau/ te/ taṃ/ sogs tyad dang 'dra'o/ ༈yad si/ d phyis/ ta yig ma yin pas na/ ya ni sa ru bsgyur mi dgos/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ rnam bcad/ yaḥzhes so/ /de bzhin du/ yau/ ye sogs so// ༈e tadsi/ d phyis/ ta sa ru song*/ ku i la sogs sa ṣa ru song*/ rnam bcad/ e ṣaḥ/ e rtau/ e te sogs 'dra ba las/ e tad kyi cho ga slar yang brjod pa/ gnyis pa rnams dang*/ ṭā os rnams la e na yang na'o/ /zhes gzhan las bshad pas/ e tad kyi don/ 'di ni zhes pa yin pa la/ 'di ni khyed la bcol lo zhes smras na/ 'di su zhes pa la/ slar yang e na zhes pa'i don/ 'di zhes ngos sbyor ba'i tshig la/ e tad kyi sgra e na/ zhes bsgyur nas bya ba byed de/ de yang dbyangs rkyen la yin gyi/ bha sa la min te/ ༈etad am/ d phyis/ e ta/ e na ru bsgyur/ am gyi a phyis/ e naṃ/ e ta/ e na ru ma bsgyur na/ e taṃ/ nyid do/ ༈de bzhin du/ e tā n/ e nā n/ la sogs pa dang*/

༈e tā bhyāṃ/ e taiḥ/ e te bhyaḥ/ e te ṣu zhes pa'i bar tyad dang 'dra'o/ ༈ tsha mtha' las/ ta twa brā tsh de kho na nyid la dri ba/ zhes pa'i sgra la/ ta twa prā tsh si/ tsha sha ṣa rā dz la sogs pa'i ṣa'o/ /zhes tsha ṣa ru song*/ ṣa'i ḍ'o/ zhes pas ṣḍ ru 'gyur/ gnas med sogs kyi yang na tsa pa'i ṭ ru bsgyur/ tatwaprāḍ/ tatwa prāṭ/ tatwa prātsh au/ ta twa prā tshau/ ta twa prā tshaḥ/ he ta twa prāḍ/ he ta twa prāṭ/ heta twa prā tshau/ he ta twa prā tshaḥ/ ༈ta twa prā tshaṃ/ ta twa prā tshau/ ta twa prā tshaḥ/ ༈ta twa prā tshā/ tatwa prātsh/ bhyām/ tsh ṣ ru song*/ ṣ ḍ ru gyur/ ta twaprā ḍaṃbhyā/ ta twa prā ḍibhaḥ/ ༈ta twa prā tshe/ ta twa prāḍaṃbhyā/ ta twa prā ḍaṃbhyāḥ/ ༈ta twa prā tshaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ'adra/ ༈ta twa prā tshaḥ/ ta twa prā tsho/ ta twa prā tshāṃ/ ༈ta twa prā tshi/ ta twa prā tshoḥ/ ta twa prātsh sup/ bhyāṃ dang 'dra ba las/ ḍ yig ṭ yig tu bsgyur/ ta twa praṭsu/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ th yig mtha' la/ agni ma th me srubs pa zhes pa ste/ igni mth si/ gnas med zhes pas/ th dbyangs med d'am tr song*/ si phyis/ agni mat/ agni md/ agni ma th au/ agni ma thau/ agni ma thaḥ༈he agni mat/ he agni md/ ༈agni ma thaṃ/ agni ma thau/ agni ma thaḥ/ ༈agni ma thā/ agni maḍaṃbhyā agni maḍibhaḥ/ ༈agni ma the/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈agni ma thaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈agni ma thaḥ/ agni ma thoḥ/ agni ma thāṃ/ ༈agni ma thi/ agni ma thoḥ/ agni mat+su/ ༈tsa yig mtha' la/ pra tyats zhes pa'i sgra'i dbang du byas na/ pratyatssi/ ats yi lnga po la num ā ga ma'o zhes 'byung ba'o/ /dbyangs mthar num ster dgos pas/ pratya dang tsa'i bar du ste/ pratya numts si/ zhes dang*/ pratyan tss/ zhes pa'o/ /sa tu ni sha tsu rnams la sha tsu'o/ /zhes ta sde n dbyangs med tsa sde ts dang 'phrad pas/ tsa sde'i sde pa mtshungs pa nya yig tu song*/ rab sbyor gyi mtha' dbyi bas tsa phyis/

tsoḥkuḥ/ tsa yi ku'o/ /de yang tsa sde ka sder 'gyur te/ byings la dzña sa pha rol dang*/ ming la tshig mtha' 'am/ ra sa pha rol can yin na'o/ /tsa sde ka sder 'gro tshul/ grangs ji ltar ba bzhin te/ tsa sde'i dang po/ ka sde'i yang dang po dang*/ tsa sde'i lnga pa ka sde'i yang lnga par 'gyur ba'i bar ro/ /des na 'dir tsa sde'i lnga pa nya yig de ka sde'i lnga pa ng yig tu 'gyur/ si phyis pas/ pratyad zhes pa grub bo/ /pra tyats au num/ pra tyan ྄ts au/ sa tu ni sha tsu rnams la sha tsu'o/ /zhes n ny/ pra tyanya ྄tsa ྄au/ rim pas drangs/ pra tyañtsau/ dzas la/ pra tyañtsa ཿ/ as dang au khyad ma gtogs cho ga 'dra'o/ ༈si dang bod si 'dra/ /he pra tyad au dzas kyi bod pa'ang 'dra/ ༈am la/ pra tyañtsaṃ/ au la/ pra tyañtsau/ a tse ra lo bo dīrghashtsa/ ats'i dbyi zhing ring po'o/ /pra tyats/ shas bzhag ats'i pha rol du shas sogs dbyangs rkyen rnams dang*/ de phan dang īp dang ī yig byung na/ ming gi mtha'i dbyangs a phyis la de'i gong ma rings por 'gyur ro/ /de yang pra ti ats zhes pa mtshams sbyar bas/ pra tyats yin/ so sor phral na/ prat i atsa ྄as zhes so/ /de nas ti'i i ni y dbyangs med pa ru song*/ ats'i a de ni y la bcug pa yin pas so sor phral na/ pra ta ྄atsa ྄as zhes pa'o/ /shas mthong bas mtha' ma'i dbyangs ats'i a phyis/ lugs can/ med pas lugs kyang med par 'gyur te/ dang po i yig de bar skabs su y dbyangs med du bsgyur mkhan a med par song tsa na/ y de yang y la mi gnas par sngar lus i nyid du slar ldog ste/ prat its.as/ zhes pa'o/ der a phyis shul gyi gong ma i de ring po ī ru 'gyur zhing*/ ts as kyi a la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ pra tī tsaḥ/ ༈des rigs 'gre ste/ ṭā sogs dbyangs la/ pra tī tsā/ ༈pra tī tse/ ༈pra tī tsaḥ/ ༈pra tī tsaḥ/ pra tī tsauḥ/ pra tī tsāṃ/ ༈pra tī tsi/

pra tī tsoḥ/ ༈bha ldan la/ pratyats zhes ts ni bha rkyen mthong bas ka ru 'gro /k g ru gyur te/ pra tya gbhaṃyā/ zhes pa la sogs pa bha ldan drug 'dra/ ༈sup/ tsk ru bsgyur/ ku ྄i la sogs/ sup kyi s ṣ ru bsgyur/ drangs/ k ṣ sbyor ba kṣa ste/ pra tyakṣu/ ༈de bzhin du/ tirya ts zhes pa'i sgra la'ang*/ dang po lnga/ pra tyats dang sgrub tshul gcig ste/ tiryad/ tiryañtsau/ tiryañtsaḥ/ ༈bod pa gsum la yang he 'jog༈am dang e la/ tiryañtsaṃ/ tiryañtsau/ ༈ tir shtsā da yaḥ/ ti rashtsa la sogs pa'o/ /sogs pa'o zhes pa ni/ 'og tu 'chad 'gyur/ mu dats la sogs pa mang po yod pa la dgongs pa'o/ /tiryats/ ti rashtsa ru byed pa ni tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa ste/ de yang tarya ts la shas sogs dbyangs rkyen byin na/ ti rashtsa ru bsgyur dgos la/ de phan dang īp dang*/ ī yig las kyang 'gyur te/ ti rashts yi ts de ni dang po nas srog med do/ /yang na sngon la dbyangs bcas su bsgyur/ phyis dbyangs phyis kyang rung ste/ ts dbyangs med la bya ba byed kyi/ dbyangs bcas la min no/ /de yang tirya ts shas/ sha phyis/ ti rashts ru bsgyur/ ti rasha ྄ts.as drangs/ rnam bcad/ ti rashtsaḥ/ ༈cho ga de kho nas lhag ma rnams kyang sgrub ste/ ti rashtsā/ ༈ti rashtse/ ༈ti rashtsaḥ/ ༈ti rashtsaḥ/ ༈ti rashtsoḥ/ ti ra shtsāṃ/ ༈ti rashtsi/ ti rashtsoḥ/ zhes so/ ༈tirya ts bhyām/ tsk ru bsgyur/ k g ste/ tirya gaṃbhyā yā/ tiryagbhiḥ/ ༈tirya gbahyaḥ/ ༈tiryats sup/ ts k ru/ ku i la sogs/ su ṣu ru song*/ drangs/ kṣa 'dus pa kṣa/ tiryakṣu/ ka ṣa 'dus pa kṣa ru 'gyur zhes pa/ rgya yig la k ṣa ma 'dres par brtsegs pa tsam dang*/ 'dres pa kṣa la gzugs dang brjod pa gnyis ka nas khyad chen po yod pas dmigs kyis bkar ba'o/ /des na k ṣa 'dus pa nyid kṣa yin gyi/ sngon la 'dus nas rjes la kṣa ru 'gro rgyu rang gcig med dam snyam pa mi bya'o//

༈ //u dats'i sgra la/ pra tya ts dang*/ tiryats'i bya ba dang phal cher 'dra ste/ dang po lnga dang bod pa gsum rnams la/ u dng*/ udañtsau/ udañtsaḥ/ ༈u dañtsaṃ/ u dañtsau/ ༈he u dng*/ he u dañtsau/ he u dañtsaḥ/ ༈kun la num ster/ n ny ru/ si phyis/ de rjes ts dbyi'o/ ༈shas sogs dbyangs la/ u da ts ni/ u dī ts ru bsgyur te/ gzhan tiryats'i skabs bzhin te/ u dī tsaḥ/ ༈u dī tsa:/ u dī tse/ ༈u dī tsaḥ/ ༈u dī tsaḥ/ u dī tsoḥ/ ༈u di tsāṃ/ ༈u dī tsi/ u dī tsoḥ/ ༈u dātsbhyām/ ts k k g u dagbaṃhyā la sogs pa'o/ ༈u da ts sup/ ts k sa ṣa/ drangs/ u dakṣu/ ༈ /sa mya ts yang de kho na ltar sbyor te/ u dī tsa yi tshab du/ mī ts sa yang dag pa ru bsgyur pa'o/ /samyad/ samyañtsau/ samyañtsaḥ/ ༈samyañtsaṃ/ samyañtsau/ saṃ mī tsaḥ/ ༈sa mī tsā/ ༈sa mī tse/ ༈sa mī tsaḥ/ ༈sa mī tsaḥ/ ༈sa mī tsoḥ/ sa mī tsaṃḥ/ sa mī tsiḥ/ sa mī tsoḥ/ ༈bha sa la/ samya gbaṃhyā sogs dang*/ samyakṣu/ /༈ta yig mtha' can gyi/ ma rut kyi sgra la/ ma ruhsi/ si ha sa'i mtha' la phyis/ t de nyid du gnas pa'am/ d ru bsgyur te/ ma rut/ ma rud/ ma ru tau/ ma ru taḥ/ ༈ ma ru taṃ ma ru tau/ ma ru taḥ/ ༈ma ru taṃ/ maru tau/ ma ru taḥ/ ༈ma ru tā/ ma ru dbhyāṃ/ ma ru dbhiḥ/ ༈ma ru te/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ma ru taḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ma ru tḥ/ ma ru toḥ/ ma ru tāṃ/ ༈ma ru ti/ ma ru toḥ/ ma ru t+su/ zhes te/ samya ts dang ma rut kyi bod pa'ang dang po dang 'dra'o/ ༈ma tuta kyi sgra bzhin du/ agni tsit kyi la'ang 'dra'o/ ༈t mtha' la/ u rjes 'brel/ ma ha t zhes pa lta bu ste/ ma ha tu zhes h ni mtha' yin/ de'i u rjes 'brel gyi rkyen yin/ bris ma thag tu dbyi bas ta srog med nyid mtha' yin no/ /braṃ to num/ u dang ṛ dag gi num'o/ /rtags mtha' rkyen u yig ṛ yig rjes 'brel la/ si sogs lnga dhi dang bcas pa la/

num ā ga ma ster/ nsamma ha to dhau dīrghaḥshau tsa/ nsa ap ma hat kyi dhi min pa la ring po ste shi la'ang ngo*/ /'og tu 'chad pa'i nsa'i mtha' dang*/ ap kyi mtha' dang*/ 'dir ma ha t te/ 'di rnams la dhi sbangs pa'i si sogs lnga byin pa na/ rtags kyi tha ma'i dbyangs ring por 'gyur la/ rab sbyor gyi mtha' ni dbyi'o/ /sa ni 'jig cing*/ gzhan bzhi la/ n t phar drangs/ ma hāntau sogs dang*/ t drangs/ n nga ro/ ma hāṃ tau/ zhes sogs te/ n nga ror byed dam/ 'dren pa gang rung zhig bya'o/ /mahat si/ u ṛ dag gi num zhes/ num/ dbyangs kyi mtha' ste/ ha dang ta yi bar du ster/ nsa ap ma ha t kyi ring po/ zhes ha ring por bsgyur/ mahā n t s/ si phyis tshig mtha'i t yang phyis/ ma hān/ ༈he ma han te bod si la ring por mi byed do/ /ma hat au num ring po/ t drangs/ n nga ro/ ma hāṃ tau'am/ ma hāntau 'dra/ des 'gre/ ma hāntaḥ/ ༈ma hāntaṃ/ mahāntau/ zhes so/ ༈shas sogs la/ num mi ster/ ring po med/ ma ha taḥ/ ༈ma ha tā/ ma ha t bhyām/ dzha bha las dza ba'o zhes/ t d'o/ ༈ma hadbhyāṃ/ ma ha dbhiḥ/ ༈ma ha te/ ma ha dbhyāṃ/ ma hadbhyaḥ/ ༈ma ha taḥ/ ma hadbhyāṃ/ ma hadbhyaḥ༈ ma ha taḥ/ ma ha toḥ/ ma ha tāṃ/ ༈ma ha ti/ ma ha toḥ/ ma hat+su/ ༈u rjes 'brel t mtha' bha ba t la/ bha ba tu zhes pa'i rjes 'brel u phyis/ bha ba/ t si/ a twa soḥsau/ a tu dang si'i si la'o/ /pha rol du dhi min pa'i si byung na/ a tu'i mtha' dang*/ sa mtha' can gyi u pa dhā ring por 'gyur ro/ /u dang ṛ dag gi nu m'o/ 'dir u pa dhā ni ba'i srog gi a ste de ring po ā ru 'gyur ro/ /si phyis/ rab sbyor yang dbyi/ bha bān/ bha bt au/ num/ t drangs/ n nga ro'am drangs/ bha baṃ tau/ bha bantau/ de dang 'dra bar/ bha bantaḥ/ ༈bha bantaṃ/ bha bantau/ ༈he bha bante 'di la u pa dhā ring por bsgyur ba med/ gzhan dang po'i si dang 'dra/

gnyis tshig mang tshig 'dra ༈shas sogs kyang gong dang 'dra ste/ bha ba taḥ/ ༈bha ba tā/ bha badbhyāṃ/ bha badbhiḥ/ ༈bha ba te/ bha badbhyāṃ/ bha badbhyaḥ/ ༈bha ba taḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ'adra/ ༈bha ba taḥ/ bha ba toḥ bha ba tāṃ/ ༈bha ba ti/ bha ba toḥ/ bha bat+su/ ༈ta mtha' ṛ yig rjes 'brel/ bha ba tṛ lta bu ste/ ṛ rjes 'brel dbyi/ bha bt 'di la si'i skabs u pa dhā ring po mi byed/ bha bt si num/ si phyis/ tshig mtha' t yang dbyi/ bha ban/ he bha ban/ bha bantau/ bha bantaḥ/ thams cad gong ma dang 'dra/ ༈yang ṛ rjes 'brel/ pa tsa tṛ la ṛ rjes 'brel/ ba tsat si num/ ring po med/ si phyis/ rtags mtha' yal/ patsan/ ༈he pa tsan/ gzhan rnams kyang rigs bha ba tṛ dang 'dra/ pa tsaṃ tau/ pa tsantau/ gang byas kyang 'dra/ pa tsantaḥ/ ༈pa tsantaṃ la sogs pa bha bt dang 'dra/ ༈sha mtha' la/ bish'i sgra ni*/ bish si/ tsha sha ṣa rā dz sogs kyis sh yig ṣ yig tu bsgyur/ si phyis/ ṣ'i ḍ'o/ ṣ ḍa ru bsgyur/ gnas med ces pas/ yang na ḍ yang ṭ ru bsgyur/ biḍ/ biṭ/ bi sh au/ drangs/ bi shau/ bish/ dzas/ bi shaḥ/ ༈he bi ṭ/ gzhan rnams 'dra/ ༈bish bhyāṃm/ shṣ/ ṣ ḍ/ bi ḍaṃbhyā/ bha gzhan des 'gre/ ༈bi sh sup/ sh ṣ/ ṣ ḍ/ kha sa la tsa par 'gyur zhes pas/ ḍṭ ru song*/ biṭsu/ ༈ṣ mtha' can/ ṣa ṣ la/ grangs kyi don la mang tshig bdun po nyid do/ /dzas pañtsan gyi skabs dang 'dra bar rtags gsum ka la rnam 'gyur so so med do/ /dzas shas dag 'jig go / zhes pas/ dzas rtsa ba nas 'jig ṣa'i ḍa'o/ ḍ ru bsgyur te/ gong du ṣa mtha' ṣ ru bsgyur nas ḍ ru mi byed pa na skabs 'gar yin gyi rtag tu min no/ /ṣ ḍ skabs 'gar gnas med ces/ ḍ yang ṭ'o/ ṣṭ/ ṣḍ/ ༈ṣa ṣ shas/ dzas dang 'dra/ ṣṭ/ ṣḍ/ ༈ṣaṣ bhis/ ṣḍ ru/ ṣaḍbhiḥ/ ༈bhyas gnyis 'dra/ ༈ṣaṣ ām nuṭ/ na mthong bas ṣ ḍ ru song*/ ṣa ḍ n ām/ zhes so/

/n āml drangs/ nām zhes/ ḍaṇaḥ/ ḍa yi ṇa'o/ /nāṃ mthong pas ḍ ṇ ru 'gyur/ ṣa ṇ nām/ tshu rol ṇ mthong bas pha rol na yang ṇa ru 'gyur ba'i don te/ ṣaṇṇām/ drangs bas/ ṣaṇṇāṃ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ṣa ṣ sup/ ḍ ru song*/ khas la sogs ḍṭ// ṣuṭsu// ༈'ga' zhig tu tshig mtha' min pa la yang tshig mtha'i bya ba'o/ /zhes 'grel par 'byung ba ni/ sup kyi mtha' gcod de/ ṣ ṭ ru byed pa sogs tshig mtha'i rnam 'gyur du bshad pa yod kyang*/ tshig mtha'i min pa la'ang bya ste/ don gyis thob pa'i phyir dang*/ grub pa'i mtha' ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ do ṣāṃ raḥ/ doṣ rnams kyi ra'o/ ṣ mtha'i nang tshan/ do ṣ lag pa la sogs pa rnams kyi pha rol si dang po dang*/ bod pa gang byung na'ang rtags mtha'i ṣa yig ra yig tu 'gyur ro/ /do ṣ si/ ṣ r ru song*/ si phyis/ r rnam bcad/ doḥ/ ༈he doḥ/ ༈bha ldan dang sup la/ ṣ r ru song pa phar 'dren/ bhya nyis rtseg dngos sam yid la bzhag/dorbhyāṃ/ dorsu/ ༈dbyangs rkyen thog ma bzhi po la ṣ yig phar sbyor ba ste/ do ṣo/ do ṣaḥ/ ༈do ṣaṃ/ do ṣau/ ༈shas sogs dbyangs rkyen la rkyen mthong bas/ n mthar 'gyur te ji ltar 'gro snyam na/ ṣa n ru mi 'gro bar/ n dbyangs med gcig rtags mthar gsar du skye'o/ /doṣ shas bzhagasha dbyi/ gzhan las shas sogs dbyangs pha rol la n mtha' nyid yang na'o/ /zhes bshad pa la/ ṣ ni ṣn ru song*/ de ṣn ྄as/ zhes 'byung*/ n 'dir sbyor mtha' 'dra ba gcig byung na'ang*/ gsar skyes yin pas rab sbyor mtha' dbyi ba mi thob/ n a la drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ la sogs n ṇ/ ṣ drangs/ rnam bcad/ doṣṇaḥ/yang na zhes na mtha' mi byed na/ do ṣaḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈des mtshon te/ do ṣa ྄ṭā ā/ doṣ/ doṣṇā/ zhes pa nas/ ༈do ṣa ྄os/ do ṣoḥ/ ༈do ṣṇoḥ/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ ༈do ṣ la sogs pa zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas/ sa dzuṣ// se ba g.yog nang zan lta bu'i bri ti ste snying nye ba'i ming ngo*/

/ā shiṣ/ shis brjod/ ha biṣ sreg rdzas kyi khyad par dkar gsum lta bu'o/la sogs pa ste/ de dag kyang sgrub tshul/ do ṣ'i cho ga de kho na dang 'dra ba las/ sa dzu ṣ da'ang*/ ā shi ṣ'i ra sa la ring po ste/ tshig mtha' la'o/ /zhes gzhan las 'byung bas 'dir tshig mtha' ni si byin pa phyis pa'i skabs te de dang*/ tshig mtha' min yang*/ ra sa/ bha sa rnams la rtags kyi dbyangs mtha' ma ring por byed pa khyad par te/ sa dzuṣ si/ si phyis/ dzu ring po/ dzū ṣ ni r/ r rnam bcad/ sa dzuḥ gzhan sa dzu ṣau/ sa dzu ṣaḥl sogs pa dang*/ ༈he sa dzuḥl sogs pa dang*/ ༈bha sa la/ ṣ ḍ/ sa dzū ḍaṃbhyā/ sa dzūṭsu/ ༈sa mtha' can las/ puṃs'i sgra la/ puṃs si/ puṃ so a sung/ puṃs la a su ng'o/ /puṃ s'i sgra la pha rol tu/ si au dzas am au/ ste rnam dbye lnga po de dag gang byung yang*/ rtags mtha' a sung du bsgyur/ sung ྄gi ng ni mtha' brjod pa'i don te dbyi/ mtha' brjod pa'i go don/ ng yig dang 'brel bar brjod pas/ rtags yongs rdzogs sam yi ge du ma bsgyur ba ma yin gyi/ mtha'i yi ge gcig kho na bsgyur pa'o/ /su'i u ni brjod don yang yin/ u dang ṛ rjes 'brel gyi rtags mtha' la/ num thob pa'i phyir yin pas dbyi'o/ swa re maḥ/ dbyangs la ma'o/ kha cig mdo 'di dbyangs can ma'i gsung la med zer/ gang ltar yang don la dgos 'dra/ pu gyi nga ro m yig nyid du byas gral la sgrigs/ pum ྄as/ zhes pa 'byung*/ m drangs/ u dang ṛ dag gi num'o/ /zhes pas num ā ga ma ster ro/ /num de puṃs la ster bas dbyangs mtha' ru yin te/ ma dang s yig gi bar du'o/ /pum ns si zhes pa'o/ /na sa ap ma ha t kyi dhi min pa la ring po ste/ zhes pas ma thung du ring bor song*/ rab sbyor mtha' s yig dbyi/ si yang dbyi/ pu mān/ lhag ma bzhi la/ a sung du bsgyur ba dang*/ nga ro m ru bsgyur ba dang*/

num dang ring po rnams de dang 'dra bar byed/ rab sbyor gyi mi dbyi/ n yig ni ma ring po'i klad skor du byed do/ / puṃs au/ s a sung du/ nga ro m ru/ u dang ng phyis/ m a la drangs/ num/ pum ns ྄au/ zhes pa bzhag/ma ring po/ sa drangs/ pu māṃ sau/ zhes grub/ de bzhin du/ dzas sogs la/ pu māṃ saḥ/ ༈pu māṃ saṃ/ pu māṃ sau/ zhes so/ ༈bod si la ni gzhan thams cad gong si dang 'dra ba las/ n s ap ma hat gyi dhi min pa la zhes dhi la ring por mi 'gro bar bshad pas ma ring por mi 'gro'o/ he pu mn/ bod pa phyi ma gnyis la 'dra ste/ he pu māṃ sau/ he pu māṃ saḥ/ ༈lhag ma shas sogs dbyangs la 'di ltar/ puṃs shas/ sha dbyi/ drangs/ puṃ saḥ/ de kho nas rigs 'gre/ ༈puṃ sā/ ༈puṃ se/ ༈puṃ saḥ/ ༈puṃ saḥ/ puṃ soḥ/ puṃ sāṃ/ ༈puṃ si/ puṃ soḥ/ zhes so/ ༈bha ldan rnams la rab sbyor phyis pa kho na te/ puṃs bhyām/ s phyis/ puṃ bhyāṃ/ puṃ bhiḥ/ puṃ bhyāṃ/ sup la de dang 'dra bar rab sbyor phyis na/ puṃ su/ ma phyis par drangs na/ puṃ ssu/ zhes pa gdam ka ni/ sgra gzhung kho na'i lugs dang*/ ༈sdeb sbyor dang rig byed la tshig phrad sgrub pa ni/ a saṃ bha be puṃ saḥkakso/ mi 'byung ba la puṃ sa'i kak te sa la'o/ /mi 'byung ba ni mi thob pa ste/ puṃ s ni skyes bu rang nyid te/ rang ni gcig pu kho na las gnyis dang mang por med pas/ sup kyi mang tshig mi thob po zhes/ rig byed mtha' pa la sogs pa smra na/ de ni sup kho nar ma zad gnyis tshig mang tshig kun la 'dra mod/ 'dir rang dngos gcig yin kyang rigs dngos du ma yod pas/ /bdun pa'i mang tshig sa yi rkyen la rigs kyi don du kak ā ga ma ster ro/ /de yang rkyen la mi ster ming la ster te/ mtha' brten k rjes 'brel/ a brjod don/ puṃ s k su/ zhes pa'o/ /skor rā dyoshtsa/ sa ka dag gi la dang po dag gi yang ngo*/

/skabs 'di'am/ 'di rigs la/ ā ga ma'i k dbyangs med dang*/ s dbyangs med gnyis 'dzom pa las gang 'dzom pa'i dang po ste thog ma dbyi ba las/ 'dir s dang por byung bas s yig dbyi'o/ /de nas ka mthong bas su ṣu ru song*/ k ṣ la drangs/ kṣu/ puṃ kṣu grub po/ 'phags ma'i gsungs 'dis/ a nu bhū ta ā tsarya'i dbugs phyung ba yin no/ ༈ /da ni bi dwas'i mkhas pa sgra la/ bi dwas si/ u dang ṛ dag gi num zhes pas/ num ā ga ma/ na s ap ma ha t kyi dhi min pa ring po zhes pas/ dwā ring po/ si dbyi/ rab sbyor phyis/ bi dwān/ bi dwas au bzhag /num ring po/ n rjes su nga ro/ s drangs/ bi dwāṃ sau/ bi dwas dzas num au dang 'dra/ bidwāṃ saḥ/ ༈bi dwas am/ num/ bi dwā saṃ/ bi dwas au/ num/ bi dwāṃ sau/ ༈bod pa gsum gyi dang po/ si dngos dang 'dra ba las ring po med/ gzhan gnyis 'dra/ he bi dwan/ he bi dwāṃ sau/ he bi dwāṃsaḥ/ ༈ba sorba u/ ba sa'i u'o/ ba s'i mtha' can ni mang mod/ 'dir dwas zhes/ dwa zhes pa'i w zur ni ba sgra ste de dang*/ s dbyangs med 'dus la'o/ /des na bs la shas sogs dbyangs byin pa mthong ba na/ dbyangs tha ma ba dang bcas pa de u ru 'gyur te bs de us su 'gro bas/ bi dwas zhes pa de/ bi dus su song*/ bi dus as/ s ni nā mi'i pha rol dang*/ ku i la sogs ṣ ru song*/ drangs/ s rnam bcad/ bi du ṣaḥ/ bs mtha' la/ shas sogs dbyangs rkyen dang*/ de phan dang*/ īp dang*/ ī yig rkyen las/ b dbyangs bcas u ru 'gyur ba las 'dir dang po'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ bi du ṣā/ ༈bi du ṣe/ ༈bi du ṣaḥ/ ༈bi du ṣaḥ/ ༈bi du ṣoḥ/ bi du ṣāṃ/ ༈bi du ṣi/ bi du ṣoḥ/ bhas la/ bs rnams kyi ra sa la'o/ /zhes pas/ rnams ni mang tshig ste/ sraṃs la sogs pa rnams la yang ste/ s yig d yig tu 'gro/ drangs pas/ bi dwa daṃbhyā/ bi dwa dbhiḥ/

bi dwa dbhyaḥ/ bi dwas sup la/ kha sa la tsa pa sogs/ d t/ bi dwat+su// ༈su ba tsas legs smra ba kyi sgra la/ su ba tsas si/ a tu dang sa'i si la'o/ zhes pas/ tsa ring por song*/ si phyis/ s rnam bcad/ su ba tsāḥ/ su ba tsas/ au/ su ba tsa sau/ su ba tsas dzas/ su ba tsa saḥ/ ༈bod pa la ring po med/ he su ba tsaḥ/ gnyis po 'dra/ ༈su ba tsa saṃ/ su ba tsa sau/ su ba tsa saḥ/ ༈su ba tsa sā/ ༈su ba tsa se/ ༈su ba tsa saḥ/ su ba tsa saḥ su ba tsa soḥ/ su ba tsa sāṃ/ ༈su ba tsa si/ su ba tsa soḥ/ ༈bha sa la/ su ba tsas bhyām/ s r dag gi rnam bcad ces/ s rnam bcad hab la'o zhes/ a dang ha ba'i bar du rnam bcad u'o/ u o/ su ba tso bhyāṃ/ su ba tso bhiḥ/ su ba tso bhyaḥ/ su ba tsa ssu/ ༈de bzhin du/ tsā nd+ra mas zla ba kyi sgra'ang de dang 'dra'o/ ༈u sha nas'i pa sangs sgra la/ u sha na sāṃ/ u sha nas rnams kyi'o/ /rnams kyi zhes pas/ pu ru daṃ shas dang*/ a ne has rnams kyang bsdu ste/ dhi min pa'i si ni u sha nas kyi pha rol tu gyur na/ si'i s/ ḍā'i yi ger 'gyur/ de ḍit yin pas/ nas kyi as dbyi/ ḍa yig ṭi phyis pa'i don te dbyi/ drangs/ u sha nā/ u shanas au/ drangs/ u sha na sau/ u sha na saḥ/ ༈u sha nas bod si/ u sha nas kyi dhi la n mtha' nyid dang at mtha' nyid la yang na'o zhes/ u sha nas te s mtha' can ni gdod ma yin la/ tshig phrad kyis/ n mtha' u sha nan dang*/ at mtha'i u sha na zhes pa'ang yod pas/ u sha nas/ si'i s/ ha se ra she sogs phyis/ rtags mtha'i s rnam bcad/ he u shanḥ/ de la s n ru bsgyur/ u sha nan/ si phyis/ he u sha nan/ u sha na'i s ar gyur pa la yang*/ si phyis/ he u sha na/ zhes pa'o/ gzhan yang*/ ༈ u sha na saṃ/ ༈ u sha na sau/ u sha na saḥ/ ༈ u sha na sā/ ༈ u sha na se/ ༈ u sha na saḥ/ ༈ u sha na saḥ/ u sha na soḥ/ u sha na sāṃ/ ༈u sha na si/ u sha na soḥ༈ bha sa la/ rtags mtha'i s rnam bcad sogs/

su ba tsas dang 'dra/ a sha no bhyāṃ/ bhiḥ /bhyaḥ/ u sha nassu/ ༈ a das kyi sgra la/ a das si bzhag/tyad sogs rnams kyi a kho nar bsgyur ba'am/ mtha'i gsal byed kho na dbyi ba gang rung bya/ rjes gzugs la khyad med/ 'di rnam dbye nyer gcig kun la sbyor/ a da si/ sau saḥ/ si la sa'o/ a das a da ru song ba des/ pha rol si mthong bzhin pa la yang*/ da yig sa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /si la zhes pas 'di rnam dbye gzhan la ma yin no/ /as s/ se rau/ si yi au'o/ /de nas si'i s dbyangs med de/ au ru bsgyur/ au la au ru song*/ drangs/ a sau/༈ a das au/ ṭi a/ da'i ma'o zhes pas/ a da'i da yig ma yig tu bsgyur/ 'di yang si las gzhan pa'i rnam dbye nyi shu kun la 'gre/ au la rtags mtha' au/ a mau/ mā du/ ma las u dag go /de ya a das/ a ma ru gyur pa'i skabs/ ma'i srog gi a phral nas/ tshu rol ma'i nus pas/ pha rol dbyangs de 'gyur 'gro ste/ de yang dbyangs thung ngu yin na u thung ngu dang*/ ring po yin na u ring por 'gyur ro/ a mu dang*/ a mū ru 'gyur/ 'di yang mang tshig rnams ma gtogs phal cher la 'jug go /u dag ces pas ū ring po dang thung ngu gnyis bstan no/ /'dir a das/ a ma ru song*/ ma yig rkyen au dang 'brel bas mau ste/ a au/ zhes pas srog au ni ring po yin te/ mtshams sbyor yi ge la thung ngu med pas so/ /de phyir u ru bsgyur pas/ a mū grub/ a das dzas/ ṭi a/ da'i ma/ sarb+ba sogs la/ dzas ī/ a i la e/ a me/ zhes so/ e rī ba hu twe/ e'i ī mang po la'o/ mang tshig la a das kyi rtags mthar e byung na ī ru bsgyur ro/ a mī/ ༈ a das am/ ṭi a/ da'i ma/ ma las srog u ru/ am gyi a phyis/ a muṃ/ a das/ au/ gong dang po'i gnyis tshig bzhin/ a mū/ a das shas/ 'di sarb+ba sogs dang pho rtags yin pas/ shas kyi s n/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ma las u ste/ mu shas la'o zhes pas mu ring po/

shas kyi a phyis/ a mun༈ a das ṭā/ ṭi a/ da yi ma/ ma las u/ ṭā nā ru bsgyur/ a mu nā/ a das bhyāṃm/ ṭi a/ da ma/ bha la ā ta'o/ /zhes ma ring po/ ā ring po de u ring por song*/ a mū bhyāṃ/ a das bhis/ ṭi a/ da ma/ bhis bsgyur nas bhis bha e ru mi bsgyur pa'i phyir yin/ bha sa mang po nyid la ni e'o/ zhes pas/ a me/ e yi ī mang po la'o/ /zhes pas/ a me ni/ /a mī ste/ a mī bhiḥ/ ༈ a das nge/ ṭi a/ da ma/ sma ṭ byin/ e la ai/ smai/ ma las u/ mu/ ku i las smai/ ṣmai ru song*/ a mu ṣmai/ a mu bhyāṃ/ gong dang 'dra/ a mī bhyaḥ bhiḥ dang 'dra'o/ ༈ a das ngasi/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ngasi/ āt/ smaṭ/ 'dra ba ring po/ smā ta ma las u/ ku i las a muṣmā ta/ a mū bhyāṃ/ a mī bhyaḥ ༈ a das ngas/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ngas sya/ ma las u/ ku i la/ a mu ṣya/ a das os/ ṭi a/ da ma/ os la'o zhes rtags mthar e/ ey/ drangs/ ma las u/ a mu yoḥ/ a das/ ām/ ṭi a/ da ma/ su ḍ/ ām/ suṭ/ ām/ sa bha mang po nyid la ni e zhes pas/ mer e'i ī mang po la'o zhes pas/ a mī/ s drangs/ ku i la/ a mī ṣāṃ/ ༈adas ngi*/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ngi smin/ ma las u/ a muṣmin/ a das os/ ṭi a/ da ma/ os la e/ e a y/ a mu yoḥ a das sup/ ṭi a/ da ma/ sa bha mang po/ a me/ e yi ī/ a mī/ ku i la/ a mū ṣu/ ༈adas kyi 'gyur ba gzhan sgrub pa la/ sā mā n+ye a dasaḥkaḥsyā di batstsa/ mtshungs pa la a das kyi ka ste si sogs bzhin no/ /rgya skad sā mā na zhes pa spyi'am mtshungs pa zhes pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba med pa'i spyi ming ste/ ga ge zhig che ge zhig gcig de zhes pa lta bu'i thun mong gi don gyi adas la/ ka rkyen du 'byung ste/ de yang si sogs bya ba 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ a das ka/ ṭi a/ da ma/ ma'i u ste/ a mu ru bsgyur thub nas/ ka nyid rtags mthar sbyar te rang gnas su gnas pas/

a mu ka ste che ge mo zhes pa sgrub po/ /de ni sarb+ba sogs kyi khyad par tyad sogs yin yang*/ rtags mthar gnas pa'i rkyen gyi dbang gis/ rnam dbye'i bya ba phal cher a thung mtha' can/ sarb+ba lugs ci rigs su sbyor te/ a mu ka si/ a mu kaḥ/ a mu ka au/ a mu kau a mu ka dzas/ dzas ī/ a mu ke ༈ a mu ka am/ a mu kaṃ a mu ka au/ a ma kau a mu ka shas/ a mu kān/ ༈a mu ka ṭā/ a mu ke na/ a mu ka bhyām/ bha la āt zhes pas/ a mu kā bhyāṃ/ a mu ka bhis/ bhi'i bha a'o/ /zhes pas/ a mu kaiḥ/ ༈a mu ka te/ smaṭ/ a mu ka smai/ a mu kā bhyāṃ/ sa bha mang po nyid la ni e zhes pas/ a mu ke bhyaḥ/ ༈a mu ka ngasi/ āt ru bsgyur/ smaṭ/ a mu ka smāt/ a mu kā bhyāṃ/ a mu ke bhyaḥ/ ༈a mu ka ngas/ sya ru song*/ a mu ka sya/ a mu ka os/ os la'o zhes rtags mtha' e ru song*/ ay/ a mu ka yoḥ/ a mu ka ām/ suṭ/ sa bha mang po nyid la e/ a mu ke ku i la las ṣa sa/ a mu ki ṣāṃ/ ༈a mu ka ngi*/ smin/ a mu ka smin/ a mu ka os/ a mu ka yoḥ/ a mu ka sup/ sa bha mang po nyid kyis ke ku i la sogs/ su ṣu ru song*/ a mu ke ṣu/ zhes pa'o/ /de dag gis ha sa mtha' can pho rtags rnams rdzogs so/ ༈ /de nas ha sa'i mtha' can bud med kyi rtags rnams bshad par bya ste/ de la dang por mo rtags h mtha' can ni/ u pa na h'i sgra la/ u pan hsi bzhagan ho dhaḥ/ na h yi dha'o/ /nah yi mtha' can gyi pha rol ra sa'i rkyen byung ba dang*/ rang nyid tshig mtha'ar gyur ba la mtha'i h yig dha yig tu 'gyur ro/ /ra sa pha rol ni 'og tu bha ldan dang sup yin la/ 'dir ni tshig mtha'o/ /de yang si phyis/ tshig mthar song*/ h dh ru bsgyur/ gnas med pa zhes pas/ dza ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dha d ru'am/ tsa pa'i dbang du byas na/ dh d dang*/ d t ru 'gro /u pa na t/ u pa na d/ ༈au sogs dbyangs rkyen la/

dbyangs med pha rol sbyaur ba kho na yin la/ ༈bha ldan la/ na h'i dha'o zhes pas h dh/ dzha bha las dza bzhes pas/ dh d ru song*/ drangs/ ༈supub la de dang 'dra ba las kha sa la/ tsa ba la sogs/ da ྄t ru bsgyur ba yin no/ ༈u pa na hau/ u pa na haḥ/ ༈he u pa na t/ he u pa na d/ he u pa na hau/ he u pa na haḥ/ ༈u pa na haṃ/ u pa na hau/ u pa na haḥ/ ༈u pa na hā/ u pa na dbhyāṃ/ u pa na dbhiḥ/ ༈ u pa na he/ u pa na dbhyāṃ/ u pa na dbhyaḥ/ ༈u pa na haḥ u pa na dbhyāṃ/ u pa nadbhyaḥ/ ༈u pa na haḥ/ a pa na hoḥ/ u pa na hāṃ/ ༈u pa na hi/ u pa na hoḥ/ u pa nat+su/ zhes pa'o/ ༈b yig mtha' can la/ di b kyi sgra ste/ di b au sau/ di b yi au si la'o/ /di b kyi si la au'o byas na go bde/ di b'i sgra la/ si byin pas/ b yig au ru/ ā de sha bya'o/ /di b si/ di b yi au si la'o/ /zhes pas b au ru song*/ di aus/ di'i i phral/ i y ru bsgyur/ d y au la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ dyauḥ/ di b la au sogs/ di bau/ di baḥ/ ༈he dyoḥ/ he di bau/ he di baḥ/ ༈di b am/ bā mi/ am la ā yang na'o/ /di b la am pha rol tu byung na b ni ā ri 'gyur te/ yang na zhes pas/ yang na b a ru mi 'gyur am la sbyor zhes pa ste/ di a/ am/ i y/ dy a am/'dra ba la ring por drangs pas dyāṃ/ yang na di baṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /di bau/ di baḥ/ ༈di bā/ u ra se/ ra sa la u'o/ ra sa'i rkyen pha rol tu byung na/ mo rtags b mtha'i b u yig tu bsgyur ba ste/ sa bha can ni ra sa yin no/ di b bhyām/ b u/ i y/ d y u/ drangs/ dyu bhyāṃ/ ngyu bhiḥ/ ༈di be/ dyu bhyāṃ/ dyu bhyaḥ/ ༈di baḥ/ dyu bhyāṃ/ dyu bhyaḥ/ ༈di baḥ/ di boḥ/ di bāṃ/ ༈di bi/ di boḥ/ sup la bha ldan dang 'dra ba las/ ku i la sogs/ ngyu ṣu/ ༈ re pha'i mtha' can la/ grangs brjod pa mo rtags tri sgra dang*/ mo rtags tsa tur gyi sgra ste/

'di la'ang mang tshig kho na te/ tri tsa tu roḥst+ri yāṃ ti sṛ tsata sṝ ba t/ tri tsa tur dag gi bud med la ti sṛ tsa ta sṝ 'dra'o/ /mo rtags kyi tri sgra dang tsa tur gyi sgra la/ dzas sogs rkyen bdun po gang byung yang*/ tri ni/ ti sṛ mo gsum dang*/ tsa tu r mo bzhi ni tsa ta sṛ ru bsgyur dgos la/ tsa ta sṛ thung du yin mod*/ sṝ 'dra ba zhes pa'i ṝ smos bas/ ṝ ring po dang 'dra ba'i don te/ de gnyis dngos su ṛ thung yin yang*/ ṝ ring po dang 'dra bas/ sa tṛ dag gi ar'o/ /zhes pa'i mdo 'jug pa med pa'o/ /de'i go don ni/ ṛ de ar du byed dgos pa 'dra cig 'dug kyang*/ mi byed par ṛ de r ru bsgyur ba'o/ /tri dzas/ tsa tu r dzas/ tri ti sṛ dang*/ tsa tu r/ tsata sṛ ru bsgyur/ ti sṛ asra/ tsa ta sṛ as/ zhes 'byung*/ ṛ yig gis a mthong*/ r ru song*/ drangs/ s rnam bcad/ ti sraḥ/ tsa ta sraḥ/ ༈/de kho na bzhin du shas la 'ang ste/ ti sraḥ/ tsa ta sraḥ/ ༈bha ldan la ti sṛ dang*/ tsa ta sṛ ru bsgyur ba las gzhan rnam 'gyur med/ ti sṛ bhiḥ/ tsa ta sṛ bhiḥ/ ༈ti sṛ bhyaḥ/ tsa ta sṛ bhyaḥ/ zhes bzhi pa dang*/ ti sṛ bhyaḥ/ tsa ta sṛ bhyaḥ/ lnga pa'o/ ༈ām gyi skabs 'dir sdeb sbyor las/ rtags mtha' ring po dang thung ngu gdam ka yin la/ sgra gzhung rang lugs la ring po'o/ /tri ām/ tsa tu r/ ām/ nuṭ ste/ bsgyur/ ti sṛ n āmā?/ tsa ta sṛ n ām/ ring por byed na/ nām la'o/ zhes pas/ ti sṛ n ām/ tsa ta sṛ na ྄ām/ drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs/ ti sṝ ṇāṃ/ tsa ta sṝ ṇāṃ/ ti sṝ ṇāṃ/ tsa ta sṛ ṇāṃ/ ༈sup la/ ti sṛ dang*/ tsa ta sṛ ru bsgyur/ ku i la sogs/ ti sṛ ṣu/ tsa ta sṛ ṣu/ smra ba/ ༈r mtha' can gi r gyi sgra la/ yborbi ha se/ i u dag ra ba la dang ha sa la'o/ /i dang*/ u ni/ i kā ra dang*/ u kā ra tshig sdud kyis bsdus pa yin pas/

i thung kho na dang u thung kho na yin par bshad do/ re pha'i byings yin pa'i ming la mtha'i sngon ma it dang ut gang rung yod pa la si byin/ it/ ī dang*/ ut u ru 'gyur te/ u yig 'og tu 'byung*/ 'di i ste/ gir si/ gi de gī ru song*/ si phyis/ r rnam bcad/ gīḥ/ ༈he gīḥ/ ༈lhag ma au sogs pha rol du drangs ba kho nas chog pa las bha ldan la bha ldan la bha nyis 'gyur du 'dod do/ gi rau/ gi raḥ/ ༈gi raṃ/ gi rau/ gi raḥ/ ༈ gi rā/ gī rbhaṃbhyā/ gīrbhibhaḥ/ ༈gi re/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈gi raḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈gi raḥ/ gi ro/ gi rāṃ/ ༈gi ri/ gi roḥ/ girṣu/ ༈ de kho na dang 'dra bar/ pur dhur sogs kyang ste/ pūḥ/ pu rau sogs/ pu rbaṃhyā/ pūrṣu sogs so/ ༈dhūḥ/ dhūrau/ dhūrbhyāṃ/dhurṣu/ ༈dh'i mtha' can/ sa mi dhayam shing 'i? sgra la/ /sa mi dh si/ si dbyi/ tshig mtha' la dh d ru song*/ gnas med sogs yang na t'o/ /sa mid/ sa mit/ ༈he sa mid/ he sa mit/ ༈bha ldan la/ dh d/ sup la d yang t ru 'gro /dbyangs rnams la pha rol du drangs/ sa mi dhau/ sa mi dhaḥ/ ༈he sa mi dhau/ he sa mi dhaḥ/ ༈s-i mi dhaṃ/ sa ma dhau/ sa mi dhaḥ/ ༈sa mi dhā/ si midbhyāṃ/ si mi dbhiḥ/ sa mi dhe/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈sa ma dhaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈sa ma dhaḥ/ sa ma dhoḥ/ sa mi dhāṃ/ ༈sa mi dhi/ si mi dhoḥ/ sa mit+su/ ༈ bh mtha' ni/ ka ku bh yul phyogs lta bu ste/ ka ku bh si/ si phyis/ gnas med sogs/ bh ni b ru 'gyur ba'am yang na p ru song*/ ka ku b/ ka kup/ ༈hre ka ku b/ he ka ku p zhes so/ ༈ /bha ldan la dzha pa sogs kyis b dang*/ sup la kha sa la sogs kyis p ru 'gro // ༈dbyangs la pha rol tu 'dren pa kho na'o/ ka ku bhau/ ka ku bhaḥ/ ka ku bhyāṃ/ ka ku bhau/ ka ku bhaḥ/ ka ku bhā/ ka ku bhyaṃ/ ka ku bbhiḥ/ ༈ka ku bhe/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ka ku bhaḥ/ bhyāṃ bhyaḥ/ ༈ka ku bhaḥ/
