ka ku bhoḥ/ ka ku bhāṃ/ ka ki bhi/ ka ku bhoḥ/ ka kupsu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈da yig mtha' las tyad sogs rnams so/ /de rnams la tyad sogs la mtha'i ṭi phyi ba yin kyang*/ dbyangs mi dbyi ste/ gsal byed kho na dbyi'o/ /yang de'i dbyangs mtha' rten pa a ru yod pa dang*/ bud med la a la āp'o/ /zhes pas/ mo rtags skabs 'dir tyad sogs la rtags kyi a yig la āb kyi rkyen ster/ āp kyi p rjes 'brel dang*/ si phyi pa'i don no/ /rtags kyi a dang āpra'i ā mtshungs 'dra ring po bya/ gzhan mo rtags sarb+ba'i bya ba dang phal cher mtshungs/ ngit la sogs pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ gaṅgā dang yang 'dra'o/ /de yang*/ tyad si/ ṭi'i d phyis/ āp byin p phyis/ 'dra ba ring po/ ta'i sa'o/ /zhes pas/ tyā yi t s ru bsgyur/ si dbyi/ syā/ tyad/ au/ d dbyi/ ā p/ 'dra ring*/ au ī/ a i la e/ drangs/ tye/ tyad dzas/ d phyi/ āp/ ring po/ dzas kyi a 'dra ba/ rnam bcad/ tyāḥ/ ༈tyad am/ d phyi/ /āp/ am gyi a 'dra ba'i/ tyāṃ/ au gong bzhin/ tye/ shas dzas bzhin/ tyāḥ/ ༈tyad ṭā/ d dbyi/ āp/ ṭā os dag la e/ e a y/ drangs/ tya yā/ tyad bhyām/ d phyis/ āp/ tyā bhyāṃ/ de dang 'dra bar/ tyā bhiḥ/ ༈tyad nge*/ d phyi/ āp/ ngit rnams kyi ya ṭra'o/ /ya ṭra las a t yang ngo*/ /zhes pas so/ tyā kyi srog ā ring po a t du song zhing*/ ya ṭra kyi gong du suṭra ā ga ma ster/ tya s y e/ zhes so/ /ya'i a ai/ tyasyai/ tyā bhyāṃ/ tyā bhyaḥ/ ༈tyad ngasi/ d phyis/ āp/ ya ṭra/ yaṭra la et yang ngo*/ /zhes pas/ suṭra rtags mtha' ni sngar ring po yin pa thung ngur song*/ tya s ya ās/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ tyasyāḥ/ tyā bhyāṃ/ tyā bhyaḥ/ ༈tyad ngas/ ngas sya'o mi 'jug kyang*/ ngasi dang 'dra/ tya syāḥ/ tyad os/ d phyis/ āp/ 'dra ba/ ṭā os dag gi e/ e a y/ tya y os/ drangs/

tya yoḥ/ tyad ām/ d dbyi/ āp/ yang na thog mar suṭ byin/ de'i rjes su āp/ tyās ām/ drangs/ tyā sāṃ/ ༈tyad ngi*/ d phyis/ āp/ ngi ām du 'gro /tyā ām/ zhes so/ ya ṭ/ suṭ/ mtha' thung*/ tya s y ām/ drangs/ tya syāṃ/ os gong dang 'dra/ tya yoḥ/ tyad sup/ d dbyi/ āp/ tyā su/ ༈des mtshon te/ tad dang*/ yad dang*/ e tad sogs kyi mo rtags kyang cho ga 'di kho nas sgrub ste/ lus 'gyur la the tshom mi 'jug pa'i phyir mgo smos na/ tad si/ d āp/ ta yi sa'o/ /zhes pas/ ta sa ru bsgyur/ si phyis/ sā/ zhes pa grub/ au ī ru bsgyur bas/ te/ de bzhin du/ tāḥ/ ༈tāṃ/ te/ tāḥ/ ༈ṭā os dag la e'o/ ta yā/ tā bhyāṃ/ tā bhiḥ/ ༈tad de/ ngit rnams kyi? ya ṭ'o/ /ya ṭ la a t yang ngo*/ /zhes pas nga ldan la yaṭ/ suṭ/ thung ngu rnams te/ ta syai/ tā bhyāṃ/ tā bhyaḥ/ ༈de dran par byas te/ ta syāḥ/ tā bhyāṃ/ tā bhyaḥ/ ༈ngas ngasi 'dra/ ta syāḥ/ ṭā os dag pa e/ ta yoḥ/ su ṭ byin/ tā sāṃ/ ༈ngi ām/ ya ṭ/ su ṭ/ tu syāṃ/ drug pa'i gnyis pa dran/ ta yoḥ/ tā su/ zhes so/ ༈yang la ta yig med pas si la sa ru 'gro rgyu med/ gzhan 'dra/ yā/ ye/ yāḥ/ ༈yāṃ/ ye/ yāḥ/ ༈ya yā/ yā bhyāṃ/ yā bhiḥ/ ༈ya syai/ yā bhyāṃ/ yā bhyaḥ/ ༈ya syāḥ/ yā bhyāṃ/ yā bhyaḥ/ ༈ya syāḥ/ ya yoḥ/ yā sāṃ/ ༈ya syāṃ/ ya yoḥ/ yā su/ zhes pa'o/ ༈e tad la si'i skabs su/ d phyis/ ta s ru song*/ ku i la sogs/ nā mi e las sa yig ṣa yig tu 'gro gzhan 'dra ste/ e ṣā/ e te/ e tāḥ/ ༈e tāṃ/ e te/ e tāḥ/ ༈e ta yā/ e tā bhyāṃ/ e tā bhiḥ/ ༈e ta syai/ e tā bhyāṃ/ e tā bhyaḥ/ ༈e ta syāḥ/ e tā bhyāṃ/ e tā bhyaḥ/ ༈e ta syāḥ/ e ta yoḥ/ e tā sāṃ/ ༈e ta syāṃ/ e ta yoḥ/ e tā su/ ༈de bzhin du kim gyi sgra la/ pha rol du rnam dbye nyer gcig po gang byung yang*/ ṭi a ru bsgyur bas ka 'ba' zhig tu song*/

gzhan tyad sogs kyi mo rtags yin pas 'dra/ kā ke kāḥ/ ༈kāṃ ke kāḥ/ ༈ka yā/ kā bhyāṃ/ kā bhiḥ/ ༈ka syai/ kā bhyāṃ/ kā bhyaḥ/ ༈ka syāḥ/ kā bhyāṃ/ kā bhyaḥ/ ka syā/ ka yoḥ/ kā sāṃ/ ༈ka syāṃ/ ka yoḥ/ kā su/ zhes so/ ༈da ni mo rtags i dm gyi sgra'i dbang du byas nas/ thun mong ba rnams tyad dang 'dra/ i yaṃ st+ri yāṃ/ bud med la i yam mo/ /i dm si/ i brjod don/ mo rtags la/ i dm s dang bcas pa i yam du bsgyur ro/ /zhib mor na/ ṭi a dang*/ d ma ru song*/ āp byin/ mā ring po/ i mās dang bcas pa i yam mo/ de bzhin du/ 'og ma thams cad la yang*/ ṭi a/ i dm/ i da ru song*/ da'i ma'o zhes da ma ru song*/ āp byin/ mā ring por song bas/ i mā ru bsgyur zin pa gzhir bzhag byas nas sgrub dgos na/ au sogs la sngar/ i mau la sogs par 'gro ba bzhin mi byed par/ bshad ma thag pa'i tyad sogs mo rtags bzhin byas pas/ i me/ i māḥ/ ༈i māṃ/ i me/ i māḥ/ zhes so/ ༈i mā ṭā/ i mā ṭā os la a na zhes pas/ i mā a na du song ṭā os dag la e zhes pa'ang 'juga.a ne ā byung*/ e a ya/ drangs/ a na yā/ pho rtags a ne na dang mi 'dra bar rtags mtha' e dang e a yar byed pa'o/ ༈bha sa la a'o zhes i ma ni a ru bsgyur/ āp byin/ ā 'di bha ldan dang sup kyi skabs thams cad la mdos zin/ gzhan la min yang 'di man chad thams cad la sbyor dgos pa nyid du dran par bya'o/ /ā bhyāṃ/ ā bhiḥ/ ༈ya ṭ/ suṭra/ thung ngu*/ a syai/ ā bhyāṃ/ ā bhyaḥ/ ༈a syāḥ/ ā bhyāṃ/ ā bhyaḥ/ ༈a syāḥ/ a na ru song*/ a e ru song*/ e a y/ drangs/ a na yoḥ/ suṭ/ a sāṃ/ ༈ngi ām/ ṭa/ suṭ/ thung ngu/ a syāṃ/ a na yoḥ/ ā su/ ༈mo rtags ts mtha' las/ twa tspags pa 'i sgra la/ twa ts si/ tsu'i ku'o zhes pas ts k ru song*/ gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /zhes/ k nyid du gnas pa'am/

g ru bsgyur/ si phyis/ twak/ twa g/ twa ts/ au/ drangs/ twa tsau/ de gnyis kyis mtshon te/ bha sa si dang 'dra la/ dbyangs rkyen au dang 'dra ste/ twa ts dzas/ twa tsaḥ/ ༈he twa k/ he twa g he twa tsau/ he twa tsaḥ/ ༈twa tsaṃ/ twa tsau/ twa tsaḥ/ ༈/twa tsā/ ts k ru/ dzha bha las dza ba sogs/ twa gaṃbhyā/ twagbhiḥ/ ༈twa tse/ twagaṃbhyā/ twagaṃbhyāḥ/ twa tsaḥ/ twagaṃbhyā/ twagabhyaḥ/ twa tsaḥ/ twa tsauḥ/ twa tsāṃ/ ༈twatsi/ twa tsoḥ/ k ru bsgyur/ ku i la sogs/ ṣu drangs/ k ṣ 'dus pa kṣa/ twakṣu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ de bzhin du/ ṛ rig byed kyi tshig rkang la sogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ bā ts/ bāk la sogs pa'i 'gyur ba thams cad twa ts dang 'dra ste de sogs mang po'o// ༈p yig mtha' can/ ap chu'i ming lta bu ste/ 'on kyang 'di la mang tshig kho na 'jug go ap dzas/ n s*/ ap ma had kyi dhi min pa la ring po ste zhes pas ap kyi a ring po ste ā ru bsgyur/ p drangs/ s rnams bcad/ ā paḥ/ ༈ ap shas/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ a ba bhi da pāṃ/ ap rnams kyi bha la da'o/ /ap bhis bzhaga.a p rnams zhes ap la sogs pa mang po'i don te/ pha rol bha ldan la/ rtags mtha'i p dbyangs med d ru 'gyur te/ ad bhiḥ/ drangs/ adbhiḥ/ ༈adbhyaḥ/ ༈adbhyaḥ/ ap/ ām/ a pāṃ/ ༈ap sup/ apsu/ ༈ sh yig mtha' la/ di sh'i rtags ni/ di sha ྄si/ di shāṃ kaḥ/di sh rnams kyi ka'o/ /rnams kyi zhes pas/ dṛ sh lta ba/ spra sh-i? reg pa/ mṛ sh na rdzu la sogs mang po zhig di sh phyogs dang bya ba gcig pa'i don no/ /'di rnams la pha rol du ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rkyen bha sa byung ba dang*/ tshig mthar*/ gyur pa si phyis rjes lta bu la/ rtags mtha'i sh yig k ru bsgyur ba ste/ 'dir si phyis/ sh k ru song*/ di k/ yang na/ gnas med sogs/ k g ru bsgyur te/ dig dbyangs rkyen rnams la drangs pa kho nas chogadi shau/ di shaḥ di shaṃ/ di shau/

di shaḥ༈di shā/ di sh bhyām/ kdzha bha la sogs kyis g/ digaṃbhyā/ di gabhyaḥ/ ༈di she/ digaṃbhyā/ digabhyaḥ/ ༈di shaḥ di gbhaṃyā/ digbhayaḥ/ ༈di shaḥ/ di shoḥ di shāṃ/ di shi/ di shoḥ/ sub la sh kra dang su ṣu/ drangs pas kṣu/ di kṣu/ ༈he dikra/ he digra/ /he di shau/ he di shaḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ ṣ yig mtha' ni/ twa ṣ lta bu mdzes pa bkod pa legs pa lta bu'o ste/ twiṣsi/ ṣa'i ḍa'o/ ṣ yig ḍa ru song*/ gnas med sogs/ ḍ ṭ ru byas kyang rung*/ twiḍ/ twiṭ/ twi ṣau/ twiṣaḥ/ ༈twiṣaṃ/ twi ṣau/ twiṣaḥ/ ༈twi ṣā/ bha sa la ṣ ḍ ru song*/ bha la drangs/ twi ḍaṃbhyā/ twiḍbhiḥ/ /༈twi ṣe/ twi ḍaṃbhyā/ twi ḍabhyaḥ/ ༈twiṣaḥ twi ḍaṃbhyā/ twi ḍabhyaḥ/ ༈twiṣaḥ/ ༈twi ṣoḥ/ twi ṣāṃ/ ༈twiṣi/ twiṣoḥ/ twiḍa sup/ kha sa la sogs ḍaṭ ru bsgyur/ twiṭsu/ ༈ṣ yig mtha' ā shiṣ la/ ā shi ṣ si/ do ṣ rnams kyi ra'o/ zhes pas/ ṣ r ru song*/ si phyis/ sa dzu ṣa'i dang*/ ā shiṣ'i ra sa la ring po ste tshig mtha' la yang ngo*/ /zhes pas/ shī ste ring por gyur/ r rnam bcad/ ā shīḥ dbyangs rkyen rnams la ṣ yig phar drangs/ ā shi ṣau/ ā shi ṣaḥ/ ༈he ā shīḥ/ he ā shi ṣau/ he ā sha ṣaḥ/ ༈ā shi ṣaṃ/ ā shi ṣau/ ā shi ṣaḥ/ ༈ ā shi ṣā/ bha ldan la doṣa rnams kyi ra'o zhes pas/ ṣ ra ru/ ra sa la ring po zhes pas/ shī ring po/ ā shīrbhyāṃ/ ā shi rbhiḥ/ ༈ā shi ṣe/ ā shīrbhyaṃ/ ā shī rbhyaḥ/ ༈ ā shi ṣaḥ/ ā shī rbhyāṃ/ ā shī rbhyaḥ/ ༈ ī shi ṣaḥ/ ā shi ṣoḥ ā shi ṣāṃ/ ༈ ā shi ṣi/ ā shi ṣoḥ/ ṣa ra ṛ la sogs/ ā shīrṣu/ ༈yang na bha ldan la ṣ'i ḍ'o/ /zhes ṣ yig ḍ yig tu/ sup la ḍ ṭ ru bsgyur ba ste 'di sa dzu ṣ dang gcig par bshad par ltar na'o/ ༈ da ni me rtags su 'gyur pa'i a das la/ a das yi/ si la sa'o zhes pas/ da sa ru song*/ a sas/ si yi au/ zhes pas/ si'i i phyis sa au ru bsgyur/

de ḍit kyi ming can yin pas/ ḍit la ṭi dbyi bas/ sa gong ma'i dbyangs dang*/ sa 'og ma dbyangs med sbrags pa phyis/ as/ au byung as pha rol au la drangs/ a sau/ zhes pa grub ste pho rtags dang 'dra'o/ au man chad kun la/ tyad sogs la ṭi a ru bsgyur/ a da/ da'i ma'o zhes pas/ a m/ bud med la a la āp zhes pas/ āp/ 'dra ring*/ a mā/ zhes pa dang por grub par bya/ kun la a mā kho na bzhagam las u dag go zhes pa'ang kun la 'byung ba blo la bzhaga.a mā au/ o au la au'o/ a mau/ ma la ū ring po/ a mū/ a mā dzas/ 'dra ba ring por song zin/ ma la ū/ a mūḥ/ ༈a mā am 'dra ba las a phyis/ ma las ū/ a mū/ au la gong bzhin/ a mū/ shas kyang ngas dang 'dra/ a mūḥ/ yang na am shas kyi a dbyi'o gzhan 'dra/ ༈amā ṭā/ ṭā os dag la e/ a me/ ā e a y/ ma las u thung*/ a mu yā/ a mā bhyām/ ma las ū ring/ a mū bhyāṃ/ a mū bhiḥ/ ༈a mā nge*/ ngit la yaṭ/ zhes pas/ yaṭ/ yaṭ las kyang ngo*/ /zhes pas/ suṭ te yaṭ kyi gong du byin zhing*/ mā ni thung ngu ma ru song ngo*/ /drangs/ am s ya e/ zhes byung*/ e ai la ai'o/ zhes pas/ yai/ drangs/ syai/ ma las u thung*/ ku e la las sa ṣa/ u mu ṣyai/ ngas dang*/ ngi la yang de'i skabs 'di dran par bya'o/ /a mū bhyāṃ/ a mū bhyaḥ/ ༈a mā/ ngasi/ yaṭ/ suṭ/ thung ngu/ ai'i tshab la mtshungs pa ring po/ drangs/ ma las u/ ku i la/ a mu ṣyāḥ/ a mū bhyāṃ/ a mū bhyaḥ/ ༈a mā ngas/ yaṭ/ suṭ/ thung ngu/ 'dra ba'i/ ma las u thung*/ ku i/ a mu ṣyāḥ/ a mā os/ ṭā os dag la er/ a me/ e a y/ ma las u thung*/ a mu yoḥ/ a mā ām/ suṭ/ a mās/ ām/ zhes so/ /drangs/ ma las ū ring*/ ku i la/ a mū ṣāṃ/ a māngi*/ ngi ām/ yaṭ/ suṭ/ thung ngu/ a m s ya ām/ ya ām/ 'dra ba'i/ drangs/ ma las u/ ku i la/ a mu ṣyāṃ/ a mā os/ gong bzhin/ a mu yoḥ/

a mā sup/ ma las/ ū ring*/ ku i la/ a mū ṣu/ /zhes so/ de ltar na ha sa'i mtha' las mo rtags rdzogs so/ /༈ de nas gsal byed mtha' can ma ning gi rtags bshad de/ de la ra yig mtha' can gyi sgra las/ bār si/ ma ning la si am 'jigas r dag gi rnam bcad/ bāḥ/ bā r au/ au ī drangs/ bā rī/ bārdzas/ dzas shi/ sh song*/ drangs/ bā ri/ ༈ bā r am ma ning la si am phyi/ r rnam bcad/ bāḥ/ au gong dang 'dra/ bā rī/ shas kyang dzas dang 'dra*/ bā ri/ 'di ni r yig mtha' ma can te/ ra ni ya ma so sor bsdud pa'i yi ge yin pas/ /ya ma la num mi thob po/ ༈ bā r ṭā/ drangs/ bā rā/ bār bhyām/ r phyis/ bā bhyāṃ/ bā bhiḥ/ ༈de dag gis mtshon te/ bā re/ bā bhyāṃ/ bā bhyaḥ/ ༈bā raḥ bā bhyāṃ/ bā bhyaḥ/ ༈bā raḥ bā roḥ bā rāṃ/ ༈bā ri/ bā roḥ bārṣu/ ༈tsa tur gyi rtags la yang mang tshig kho na ste/ tsa tur dzas shi/ tsa tur gyi shi la ā?m/ m phyis/ tsa tur ār i zhes pa byung*/ u b'o/ ā la drangs/ tsa twā r/ i la drangs/ tsa twā ri/ ༈bod pa'ang 'di dang 'dra ste/ he tsa twā ri/ shas kyang dzas dang 'dra/ tsa twā riḥ༈ bha ldan la r drangs/ tsa turbhiḥ tsa turbhyaḥ tsa turbhyaḥ tsa tur.ām nuṭ n gnyis su bya drangs/ ṣaraṛ las n ṇ nyis rtseg r drangs/ tsa turṇ+ṇūṃ/ ༈tsa tu r sup/ ku i la tsa turṣu/ de yan chad dmigs gsal med pa la bod pa thams cad rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra'o/ /༈ n mtha' ahan gyi sgra la/ ahan saḥ/ a han gyi sa'o/ahan gyi pha rol du si am bha sa gang 'byung na yang*/ n yig s yig tu 'gyur ro/ ༈a han si/ si phyis/ han gyi n s ru song de rnam bcad ahaḥ/ ahan au au ī e de dag la yang na'o/ /zhes pa las skabs 'dir ī yin te/ au ī ru bsgyur ba de'o/ /de la u pa dhā'i dbyangs dbyi ba dang mi dbye ba gdam ka ste/ phyis a han ī 'dir rab sbyor mi dbyi ste/

pha rol dbyangs yin pas h n gnyis ka ī la drangs a hnī/ u pa dhā ma phyis na n kho na drangs a ha nī/ a han dzas shi/ na yi u pa dhā'o zhes pas hā ring po a hā ni/ ༈de bzhin du/ a han am si/ a m 'jiga.a ha n gyi s'o/ /zhes pas mtha'i n s ru de rnam bcad/ a haḥ au la gong bzhin/ au ī dang*/ u pa dhā dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba'i bye brag gis/ ahnī/ a ha nī/ shas kyang dzas dang 'dra/ a hā ni/ ༈a han ṭā/ up dhā phyis a hnā/ dbyangs rkyen kun des 'gre/ a ha n bhyām/ a han gyi sa'o/ /n s ru s rnam bcad a dang ha ba'i bar du rnam bcad u*/ a u la o/ a ho bhyāṃ/ bha ldan thams cad de dang 'dra/ a ho bhiḥ༈a han nge a ha ne/ a ho bhyāṃ/ a ho bhyaḥ༈ a han ngasi ahnaḥ/ a ho bhyāṃ/ a ho bhyaḥ a han ngas/ a hnaḥ/ a ha n os a hnoḥ/ ahan/ ām/ ahnāṃ/ ༈ī ngi dag la yang na'o/ zhes pa las 'dir ni ste/ u pa dhā phyi ba dang mi phyi ba'i dbye bas/ a hni/ a ha ni zhes pa'o/ /a ha n/ os/ a hnoḥ a han supa/ a han gyi sa'o/ /n s/ drangs/ a ha ssu/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ na lo paḥ na dbyi'o/ ma ning gi rtags brahman la sogs pa la ra sa pha rol dang tshig mtha' la/ n dbyangs med dbyi ste/ brahman si si phyis/ tshig mthar song bas n phyis/ brahma/ brahman au au ī drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ las n ṇ/ brahma ṇī/ brahman dzas shi n yi u pa dhā'o/ /mā ring po/ brahmā ṇi/ ༈sgrub tshul de gsum kho na dang 'dra bar/ am au shas la/ brahmaṃ/ brahma ṇī/ brahmā ṇi zhes so/ /༈'dir bod pa la si'i skabs su yang na/ n mi dbyi ste/ he brahman/ he brahma/ he brahma ṇī/ he brahmāṇi/ zhes te phyi ma gnyis dang po'i phyi ma gnyis dang 'dra'o/ /༈de bzhin du dbyangs la drangs/ bha la n dbyi/ brahma ṇā/ brahma bhyāṃ/ brahma bhiḥ/ ༈bra hma ṇe/ brahma bhyāṃḥ/ brahma bhyaḥ/ ༈brahma ṇaḥ brahma bhyāṃ/

brahma bhyaḥ brahma ṇaḥ brahma ṇoḥ brahmaṇāṃ/ ༈brahma ṇi/ brahma ṇoḥ brahma ṣu/ ༈brahman sogs pa ni/ tsa rman pags p/ ka rman las/ wa rman go cha'am gsor/ sha rman ngo tsha'am skyid ba la sogs pa ste/ cho ga 'di kho na'o/ ༈ nānta da dantā tstshanda si ngi shyorbā lo pa/ n mtha' at ngi shi dag gi yang na dbyi ba sdeb sbyor la'o/ /'di ni kha cig 'grel par mdo gzhan gyi lung drangs pa mdo 'dir bcug pa yin zer/ kha gcig dbyangs can nyid kyi mdo yin yang zer ro/ /gzhan las kyang/ sdeb sbyor las ni ā ga ma dang ā ga ma ma yin pa dag gi dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba'o༈ zhes bshad pas/ ma ning n mtha' dang a thung mtha' la rig byed dang de'i yan lag sdeb sbyor las ngi dang dzas shas kyi shi la yang na zhes n dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba gdam nga'i don/ ā ga ma'i n dbyi ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i n mi dbyi ba'o/ de yang*/ pa ra me byo mn sarbā bhū tā ni/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ pa ra me byo mn ngi/ ngi phyis/ tshig mtha'i n ni mi dbyi/ a han/ brahman sogs la bshad pa bzhin/ byo ma ni zhes/ n ngi la 'dren pa sgra'i lugs yin yang*/ rig byed skabs su/ 'di ā ga ma lta bu gsar byung min pas gdod ma'i yi ge de 'dra brjod pa bde na mi dbyi'o/ /sarba dzas shi num rtags mtha' ring po/ bhūta/ dzas/ shi/ num/ rtags mtha' ring*/ bhū tān/ i drangs/ bhū tā ni/ de nas rig byed lugs la shi dbyi bas/ sarba'i rnam dbye dbyi ba na shi kho na phyi ba ma yin par n yang dbyi ste/ 'di ā ga ma yin pas brjod pa bde na dbyi ba skabs su bab bo/ n dbyi yang sarba'i ring po mi dbyi ste/ de n'i stobs las byung yang*/ rtags mtha' kho na'i 'gyur ba yin gyi/ pha rol gyi yi ge la mi the bas so/ zhes pa rig byed lugs la skabs 'di'i don yin gyi/ gnas skabs thams cad du nges pa ni ma yin no/ /sgra rig kho na'i lugs la/

sarb+bā ni bhū tā ni/ zhes ba kho na'o zer/ ༈tyad sogs la si dang am dbyi ste/ de gnyis la ṭi ar sgyur ba med/ rnam dbye gsum pa phan chad sarb+ba'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /tyad si/ si 'jig gnas med sogs kyi/ d yig ta ru bsgyur ba'am d yig rang la 'jog pa gdam nga yin/ tyat/ tyad/ tyad/ au au ī/ ṭi a/ tya ī/ a i la etya/ tyad dzas/ shi/ ṭi a/ num/ n'i u pa dhā sogs kyis ring po/ drangs/ tyā ni/ ༈tyad am si a m phyis/ gnas med tyad tyat/ tyad au/ ṭi a/ ī tye/ tyad shas/ ṭi a/ shi num ring po/ tyā ni/ ༈de bzhin du/ tyad tya du bsgyur ba thams cad la sngon du 'gro bas/ ṭā i na/ tye na/ tyā bhyāṃ/ tyaiḥ/ tyasme/ tyābhyāṃ/ tye bhyaḥ/ ༈tya smata/ tyā bhyāṃ/ tye bhyaḥ/ ༈tya sya/ hya yoḥ tya ṣāṃ/ ༈tya smin/ tya yoḥ tyaiṣu/ ༈cho ga de kho na tad la'ang sbyar bas/ tad/ t tā te/ tā ni/ lan gnyis/ ༈te na/ tā bhyāṃ/ taiḥ/ ༈tasmai/ tā bhyaṃ/ te bhyaḥ/ tasmā t*/ tā bhyaṃ/ te bhyaḥ/ tasya/ ta yoḥ te ṣāṃ/ ༈tasmin/ ta yoḥ te ṣu/ ༈de bzhin du yad la'ang ste/ yad yat ye/ yā ni/ lan gnyis/ ༈ye na/ yā bhyāṃ/ yaiḥ/ ༈ya smai/ yā bhyāṃ/ ye bhyaḥ/ ༈yasmāt/ yā bhyāṃ/ ye bhyaḥ/ ༈ya sya/ ya yoḥ yai ṣāṃ/ ༈yasmin/ ya yoḥ ye ṣu/ ༈de dang 'dra bar/ e tad la e td e tat/ e te/ e tā ni lan gnyis/ ༈e te na/ e tā bhyāṃ/ e taiḥ/ ༈e ta smai/ e tā bhyāṃ/ e te bhyaḥ/༈e ta smāt/ e tā bhyaṃ/ e te bhyaḥ/ e ta sya/ e ta yoḥ e te ṣāṃ/ ༈e ta smin/ e ta yoḥ e te ṣu/ ༈kim yang 'dra ste/ kim la si dang am phyi/ kiṃ kho na yin/ lhag ma tyad sogs la ṭi a byas na/ ka yang na kim nyid ka ru/ ā de sha byas kyang chog ste/ ka ru bsgyur pa kho na la rnam 'gyur byas kyang rung ngo*/ kiṃ ke/ kā ni lan gnyis/ ༈ke na/ kā bhyāṃ/ kaiḥ༈ kasmai/ kā bhyāṃ/ ke bhyaḥ༈ kasmāt/ kā bhyāṃ/

ke bhyaḥ/ ༈kasya/ ka yoḥ ke ṣāṃ/ ༈kasmin/ ka yoḥ ke ṣu/ zhes so/ ༈i dm la yang*/ i dm si dang am phyi gzhan med/ lhag ma rnams la/ ṭi a/ nga'i ma'o zhes i mar bsgyur zin pa kho na la bya ba bsgrub ste༈ i daṃ/ i me/ i mā ni/ ༈i daṃ/ i me/ imā ni/ ༈ṭā os dag la a na'o/ ṭā i na/ a ne na/ bha sa la a'o/ zhes dang*/ bha la ā'o/ zhes pas/ ā bhyāṃ/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o/ /e bhiḥ/ ༈'di man la bha sa min pa la yang a ru bsgyur te/ āsmai/ ā bhyāṃ/ e bhyaḥ/ ༈asmāt/ ā bhyāṃ/ e bhyaḥ/ ༈asya/ ṭā os dag la a na'o/ /a na yoḥ e ṣāṃ/ ༈a smin/ a na yoḥ e ṣu/ gsum pa la sogs pa/ ṭā man chad kun du sngar i daṃ la bshad pa'i bya ba dang mtshungs pa'o/ /pra tyats la/ pratya tsa/ si phyis tsu'i ku'o/ /ts k ru song*/ gnas med sogs kyis yang na kra gra ru song*/ pra tyak pratyag pratyats au/ ī/ pratya ats/ so sor phye/ a phyis/ y i ru loga.i de ring po/ ī ru song*/ ts drangs/ pra tī tsī/ pratyats/ dzas/ shi num/ tya dang tsa'i bar du'o/ /pra tyantsa ྄i n rjes su nga ro/ pra tyaṃ tsi/ ༈am dbyi au ī/ shi/ num rnams kyi cho ga sbyar bas/ pra tyak pra tī tsī/ pra tyaṃ tsi/ ༈de bzhin du ṭā sogs la/ pra tī tsā/ ༈pra tī tse/ ༈pra tī tsaḥ/ ༈pra tī tsaḥ/ pra tī tsoḥ/ pra tī tsāṃ/ ༈pra tī tsi/ pra tī tsoḥ/ zhes pa rnams au'i skabs kyis rigs 'gre/ ༈bha ldan la tsk ru k g ru song*/ pra tyagaṃbhyā la sogs pa dang*/ sup la pratyakṣu/ zhes te ṭā phan chad pho rtags dang 'dra'o/ ༈dza ga t kyi sgra la/ dza gt si phyis/ dza gt/ dza gd/ dza ga tī/ dza gaṃ ti/ ༈dza ga t/ dza gd/ dza ga tī/ dza gaṃ ti/ ༈ dza ga tā/ t d ru song*/ dza gadbhyāṃ/ dza gadbhiḥ/ ༈ dza ga te/ dza gadbhyāṃ/ dza gadbhyaḥ/ ༈dza ga ta/ dza gadbhyāṃ dza gadbhyaḥ/ ༈ dza ga taḥ dzag toḥ/ dza ga tāṃ/ ༈dza ga ti/ dza ga toḥ dzag t+su/ ༈de bzhin du/ ma ha t/

ma tad/ ma ha tī/ ma hāṃ ti/ ༈ma hat/ ma ha d/ ma ha tī/ ma hāṃ ti/ 'dir hāṃ zhes ring po 'byung ba ni/ n s ap sogs kyis yin la/ thams cad du num ni rtags kyi dbyangs mthar yin gyi/ gsal byed mthar min no/ /ma ha tā/ ma hadbhyāṃ/ ma hadbhiḥ/ ༈ma ha te/ ma hadbhyāṃ/ ma haṭhkabhyāḥ/ ༈ma ha taḥ ma hadbhyaṃ/ ma hadbhyaḥ ༈ ma ha taḥ ma ha toḥ /ma ha tāṃ/ ༈ma ha ti/ ma ha toḥ ma hat+su/ zhes so/ ༈pratyats la am ma gtogs dbyangs rkyen kun la/ pra ti ats so sor 'phral/ a phyis/ tī ring por byed pa khyad par dang*/ ma ha la dzas shas skabs/ n'i u pa dhā ring po'i khyad par yod/ gzhan pratyats dang dza ga t dang ma ha t rnams sgrubs tshul 'dra'o/ /༈ s mtha' la/ pa yas kyi sgral si am 'jiga.au gnyis la ī/ dzas shas la ma hat dang 'dra/ gzhan dbyangs la phar 'dren/ ༈bha ldan la s rnam bcad/ rnam bcad dbyangs dang ha ba'i bar du u/ u o/ sup la rnam bcad byed dam phar 'dren pa gdam ka'o/ /pa yaḥ pa ya sī/ pa yāṃ si/ n s sogs kyis ring po'o/ /lan gnyis/ ༈pa ya sā pa yo bhyāṃ/ pa yo bhiḥ/ ༈pa yo se/ pa yo bhyāṃ/ pa yo bhyaḥ/ ༈pa ya saḥ pa yo bhyāṃ/ pa yo bhyaḥ/ ༈pa ya saḥ pa ya soḥ pa ya sāṃ/ ༈pa ya si/ pa ya soḥ pa yassu pa yaḥsu/ ༈de bzhin du/ te dzas/ odzas/ ba tsas la sogs pa'ang ste/ te dzaḥ te dza sī/ te dzāṃ si la sogs pa dang*/ ༈ba tsaḥ ba tsa sī/ ba tsāṃ si la sogs pa'o/ ༈ha bi ṣ'i sgra la/ ha bi ṣ si/ si phyis/ ṣ r ru song*/ r rnam bcad/ ha biḥ/ gzhan pa yas dang 'dra/ ha bi ṣī 'di yang ṣ dang s mtshungs pas n s sogs kyis ring pa'o/ /ha bīṃ ṣi*༈ha biḥ ha biṣī/ ha bīṃ ṣi*༈ ha bi ṣā/ ha biṣ bhyām ṣ r/ ha birbhyāṃ/ ha birbhiḥ/ ༈ha bi ṣe/ ha birbhyaṃ/ ha birbhyaḥ/ ༈ha bi ṣaḥ ha birbhyaṃ ha birbhyaḥ/ ༈ ha bi ṣaḥ ha bi ṣoḥ ha bi ṣāṃ/ ༈ha bi ṣi/ ha bi ṣoḥ ha birṣu/ ha biḥṣu/ ha biṣṣu/ zhes so/ ༈a das ma ning la/

a das si phyis/ s rnam bcad a daḥ/ am la'ang de dang 'dra/ gzhan rnams la a das a ma ru bsgyur ba sngon dang 'dra ba'am/ ṭi a ru bsgyur mtshams rkyen gyi bya ba byas/ de nas da ma du bsgyur/ dbyangs u ru byed par yang bshad pas ci bde bar bya'o/ /dper na a das/྄ au ī/ ṭi a/ ad ī byung*/ a i la e/ a de/ da ma/ ma las ū/ a mū/ zhes pa'am/ ṭi a/ da ma/ a i la e a me/ ma las ū/ a mū zhes pa'o/ / dzas shas shi num n'i u pa dhā a mū ni/ ༈a ma ṭā/ a das a mu ru song*/ ṭā nā/ i u'i mthar/ ṭā nā 'ong ba thog ma a mu ru song ba dgos so/ /a mu nā/ bha la a'o/ /a mā ma las ū/ a mū bhyāṃ/ gsum ka 'dra/ bhas dang bhyas gnyis la bha sa mang po la e/ a me a'i ī mang po la'o/ /zhes pas/ a mī ste/ a mī bhiḥ/ ༈a mī bhyaḥ/ de dang 'dra bar a mī ṣāṃ/ ༈a mī ṣu/ ༈os gnyis po la/ os la'o zhes/ a me/ e ay/ ma mu ru bsgyur/ a mu yoḥ/ ༈gzhan u mu ṣyai/ ༈a muṣmā t/ ༈a mu ṣyaḥ༈ a mu ṣmin rnams kyang sngon dang 'dra'o/ /zhes pa ha sa mtha' can gyi ma ning rtags rnams rdzogs so/ ༈ /da ni rnam dbye nyer gcig dang 'brel ba zur bkol rnams bshad par bya ba las/ yuṣmad/ aṣmad gnyis kyi bya ba bshad ni/ 'di ni brjod pa'i rtags zhes bya ba/ yul pho mo ma ning gsum po gang la yang 'jug tu rung ba la/ dngos su pho mo ma ning gi rnam 'gyur med pa zhig ste/ des na rtags logs par bzhag go de yang yuṣmād si/ asmad si/ twam haṃ sinā/ si yis twaṃ a ham'o/ /yis zhes/ byed pa po'i sgra sbyar ba ni/ byed po dang las phyogs gcig pa'i don te/ si dang ming lhan cig tu bsgyur ba'i go byed do/ /des na si dang yuṣmad lhan cig twam/ si dang asmad lhan cig a ham du bsgyur/ twa a ham/ yuṣmadzhes dang asmad zhes pa'i snga phyi'i go rim ltar twam dang a ham grangs bzhin sbyar ro/

༈yu bā bau dwi ba tsa ne/ gnyis tshig la yu ba ā ba dag go /yuṣmad asmad la pha rol tu gnyis tshig gi rnam dbye byung na/ go rim bzhin yu ba dang*/ a ba dag tu bsgyur dgos/ 'di ni rtags kho na yin gyi rnam dbye dang bcas pa min no/ /des na bar skabs der/ yuṣmad au/ asmad au zhes pa de yu ba au/ a ba au zhes par 'gyur ro/ /ā mau/ au ām'o/ /yuṣmad asmad kyi pha rol tu byung ba'i rnam dbye au ni āṃ ring por 'gyur bas/ yu ba ām/ a ba ām/ sngar yuṣmad yu ba dang*/ asmad a ba zhes par gyur pa'i mtha'i a dang ām gyi ā 'dra ba ring po byas pas yu bāṃ a bāṃ/ ༈ yū yaṃ ba yaṃ dza sā/ dzas kyis yū yaṃ ba yaṃ mo/ /kyis zhes byed pa po'i sgras rnam dbye dang bcas par bsgyur ba ste/ yuṣmad dzas asmad dzas/ zhes bzhagayuṣmad dzas/ yū yaṃ du bsgyur/ asmad dzas/ ba yaṃ du sgyur/ yū yaṃ/ ba yaṃ༈ tānma de ka twe/ gcig nyid la twad mata ngo*/ dang po'i gcig tshig ma gtogs pa'i gcig tshig gi rkyen pha rol du byung na/ yuṣmad twat zhes dang*/ asmad mat/ zhes par bsgyur ba las/ skabs 'dir gnyis pa'i gcig tshig yuṣmad am/ asmad am/ twat/ am/ mat am/ āmsaubha/ am sa bhi la ā'o/ /'dir am dang 'og tu 'chad pa sa dang bhis la/ tshur rol ṭi ā ru 'gyur te/ 'dir twā am/ mā am zhes pa'o/ /'dra ba ring po/ pha rol dbyi/ twāṃ māṃ༈ gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au ni/ dang po'i gnyis tshig au dang 'dra ste/ yu bāṃ/ ā bāṃ/ ༈ sha so no/shas kyi na'o/ /'di mdo dngos min lung 'dren yin zer ba yod na'ang/ shas kyi bya ba ston byed gzhan med pas mdo rang yin pa 'thad do/ / shas la ni yuṣmad shas asmad shas ṭi a/ shas nyid kyi s n ru bsgyur ba las gzhan rnam 'gyur gsar ba khyad chos gang yang med/ 'dra ba ring po yod*/ yuṣmān/ asmān/ ༈ e ṭā dyoḥ/ ṭā ngi dag la e'o/

/'dir ṭā dang 'og tu ngi la rtags mtha' e 'gyur ro zhes pa ste/ yuṣmad ṭā/ asmad ṭā/ gcig tshig la twata/ mat du bsgyur/ de dang de'i ṭi.at gnyis po e ru 'gro /drangs pas twe ā me ā/ e a y/ drangs/ twa yā/ ma yā/ ༈bhyām rigs gsum ka gnyis tshig yin pas yu bar bsgyur/ yu ba bhyāṃ/ a ba bhyāṃ/ spyi 'gro bha la a'o/ zhes pas rtags mtha' ring po/ yu bā bhyāṃ/ a bā bhyāṃ/ ༈yuṣmad bhis asmad bhis ṭi a/ am sa bhis la ā ro zhes pas/ ṭi'i a thung ring por song*/ yuṣmā bhiḥ/ asmā bhiḥ/ ༈tu bhyaṃ ma hyaṃng yā/ nge yis tu bhyaṃ mahya mo/ yuṣmad nge asmad nge de dang lhan cig yuṣmad ྄tubhyaṃ du bsgyur/ asmad ma hyaṃ du bsgyur dgos te/ yis zhes pa'i tshig zur las so/ /tu bhyaṃ/ ma hyaṃ/༈gnyis tshig yu bā bhyāṃ/ a bā bhyāṃ/ 'dra༈bhyas sha bhyam/ bhyas sha bhyam'o/ /bzhi ba'i bhyas ni/ sha bhyam du bsgyur te/ de yang yuṣmad bhyas/ asmad bhyas/ ṭi a/ bhyas sha bhyam du bsgyur sha yig sngar thog mabhyas yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ bha sa mang po nyid la e zhes pa dgag pa dang*/ phyis bhyam thung ngur song ba ltar na yang gnyis tshig bhyām ring po dang cha 'dra pas/ bha la a zhes 'jug par dogs pa dgag pa'i don du byung ba tsam yin gyis gzhan don med pas phyis te/ yuṣma bhyaṃ/ asma bhyaṃ/ ༈nga si bhya soḥ shtuḥ/ nga si bhyas dag gi shtu'o/ lnga pa'i gcig tshig ngasi dang mang tshig bhyas ni shtu ru bsgyur ba ste/ dang por gsum pa'i gcig tshig dang 'dra bar/ yuṣmad twat dang*/ asmad mat ru bsgyur/ twat as/ mat as zhes pa bsgyur bas/ twat/ shtu/ mat shtu zhes so/ /sha ni thams cad 'gyur ba ste/ as yongs rdzogs t ru bsgyur ba'i rtags don yin pas phyis/ u brjod don/ gong rtags mtha'i t yang dbyi ste/ ṭi a'o/ twa dang ma rkyen gyi t dbyangs med dang sbyar twat

mat༈gnyis tshig yu bā bhyāṃ/ a bā bhyāṃ/ 'dra'o/ ༈yuṣmad bhyas/ asmad bhyas ṭi/ a/ yuṣma bhyas a sma bhyas bhyasshtu ru bsgyur/ yuṣma shtu/ asma shtu/ sha dang u phyis yuṣmat asmat/ ngasi skabs kyi twat ma t dang lnga pa'i mang tshig gi yuṣmatra asmad zhes mtha' rten 'di rnams rkyen gyi lus 'gyur ro/ ༈ta ba ma ma nga sā/ ngas kyis ta ba ma ma'o/ /yuṣmad ngas dang lhan cig ta ba/ asmad ngas dang lhan cig ma ma ru bsgyur/ yang na drug pa'i gcig tshigs la thog ma rtags kho na twat mat du bsgyur nas/ de rjes twat mat rnam dbye dang bcas pa ta ba dang ma ma ru bsgyur kyang 'dra zhes zer/ ta ba/ ma ma/ ༈yuṣmad os/ asmad os gnyis tshig la yu ba dang a ba ru gong bzhin bsgyur/ spyi 'gro os la'o zhes pas/ /rtags mtha' e a ya drangs/ yu ba yoḥ/ a ba yoḥ/ ༈yu ṣmad ām ṭi aṭ ster/ yuṣmas/ ām asmas ām 'byung*/ sā mā kaṃ/ sām ā kam mo/ sām zhes suṭ kyi s ām la drangs pa ste suṭ ām dang bcas pa ā kam du bsgyur/ 'dra ba ring po yuṣmā kaṃ/ asmā kaṃ/ ༈yuṣmad*/ ngi asmad ngi/ twat/ matṭā ngi dag la e'o/ /twe i/ me i zhes so/ / e a y drangs pas/ twa yi/ ma yi/ ༈gnyis tshig yu ba yoḥ a ba yoḥ gong drug pa bzhin/ ༈yuṣmad sup asmad sup am sa bhis la a'o/ /zhes pa las 'dis sa ste ṭi ā ru song*/ yuṣmāsu/ asmā su/ zhes pa'o/ ༈da ni 'di bshad de/ de dag las slar yang khyad par gzhan du 'gyur tshul ni/ ā de sha la yang*/ ā de sha gzhan bskyar nas byed pa'o/ /yuṣmad sma toḥṣaṣthī tsa tu rthī dwi tī ya bhi ste me bannau bs na sau/ yuṣmad asmad dag la drug pa bzhi pa gnyis pa rnams kyis te me bam nau bs nas dag go ༈de yang dper na/ drug pa'i gcig tshig la yuṣmad twat du song twa t dang ngaskyi as sngoms pa ta ba ru song ba de/

te zhesapar gyur pa dang*/ asmad mat ru bsgyur de as dang bcas pa/ ma ma ru song ba de/ slar/ me zhes bar bsgyur ba dang*/ ༈drug pa'i gnyis tshig la yuṣmad yu ba yoḥdang*/ asmad ā ba yoḥru song zin pa de/ yu ba yoḥbam dang*/ a ba yoḥnau ru bsgyur ro/ ༈drug pa'i mang tshig la yuṣmad/ yuṣmā kaṃ du bsgyur/ asmad asmā kaṃ du bsgyur zin pa de/ yuṣmā kaṃ bs dang*/ asmā kaṃ nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈de bzhin du bzhi pa la tu bhyaṃ te dang*/ mahyaṃ me ru 'gro zhing*/ ༈yu bā bhyāṃ/ bam dang*/ a bā bhyāṃ/ nau ru 'gyur la/ ༈yuṣma bhyaṃ bs dang asmabhyaṃ nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈yang gnyis pa la twāṃ māṃ dmigs gsal can de 'gyur ba dang*/ yu bāṃ bam/ a bāṃ nau ru 'gro zhing*/ ༈yū yaṃ bs dang*/ ba yaṃ nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈drug pa bzhi pa gnyis pa zhes pa dngos su yin la/ go rim zlog par bstan pas 'os shing 'dod na tshig phrad kyi lugs la gzhan la'ang sbyar te/ dang po la twam te dang*/ a ham me zhes par 'gro zhing*/ yu bāṃ bam dang*/ a bāṃ nau zhes par 'gyur la/ ༈yu yaṃ bs dang ba yaṃ nas zhes par bsgyur ro/ ༈gsum pa la/ twa yā te ma yā me ༈yu bā bhyāṃ bam/ a bā bhyāṃ nau ༈yuṣmā bhiḥbas/ asmā bhiḥ nas/ ༈lnga pa la twat te mat me ༈yu bā bhyāṃ bam/ a bā bhyāṃ nau/ ༈yuṣmat bs asmat nas/ ༈bdun pa la/ twa yi te/ ma yi me ༈yu ba yoḥbam/ a ba yoḥnau/ ༈yuṣmā su bs/ asmā su nas zhes pa rnams su'ang res 'ga' zhig na kun du bstan par bya'o/ ༈twā mā ma/ am gyis twā mā'o/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig am dang bcas pa'i yuṣmad asmad ni twā dang mā ru bsgyur te/ yuṣmad am twāṃ dang*/ asmād am māṃ du song ba de slar yang 'dir twāṃ twā dang*/ māṃ mā ru bsgyur ro/ ༈de ltar na te me bam nau bs nas twā mā ste/ ā de sha brgyad po 'di/

drug pa bzhi pa gnyis pa rnams la byed pa mang la/ ༈dang po gsum pa lnga pa bdun pa rnams la spyir btang la mi byed pa kho na yin yang*/ tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa la skabs 'gar srid do/ dngos su smon pa dang shugs la lugs zlog gi rim pa'i brdas bstan pa'i dgos pa ni de yin zhing*/ ༈twaṃ dang a ham nas yuṣmā su dang asmā su bar du 'gyur ba ni nges pa yin la/ ā de sha ni mi byed pa'i skabs kyang mang mod/ ā de sha byas na tshig gi bya ba rdzogs par 'dod do zhes gzhan las 'chad do/ ༈yuṣmad rnam dbye'i rkyen bcas rnam 'gyur ni/ /twaṃ dang yu bāṃ yū yaṃ dang po ste/ ༈ /twāṃ dang yu bāṃ yuṣman gnyis pa'o/ ༈ twa yā yubā bhyāṃ dang yuṣmābhiḥ/ ༈tu bhyaṃ yu bā bhyāṃ dang yuṣma bhyaṃ/ ༈ /twat dang yu bā bhyāṃ dang yuṣmat dang*/ ༈ ta ba yu ba yoḥdang yuṣmā kaṃ ༈ twa yi yu ba yoḥ dang yuṣmā su// ༈ asmad rkyen bcas rnam par 'gyur ba ni/ a haṃ ā bāṃ ba yaṃ dang po'o/ /༈ māṃ dang ā bāṃ asmān gnyis pa'o/ /༈ /ma yā a bā bhyaṃ dang asmābhiḥ/ ༈ ma hyaṃ a bā bhyaṃ dang*/ asmā bhyaṃ ༈ mat dang a bā bhyāṃ dang asmat gsum/ ༈ /ma ma a ba yoḥdang asmākaṃ༈ /ma yi a ba yoḥdang asmā su/ ༈ /dang po'i gcig tshig mang tshig dang*/ ༈ /bzhi pa lnga pa'i gcig tshig rnams/ /rtags dang rnam dbye lhan cig bsgyur/ ༈ /gsum lnga drug bdun gcig tshig ni/ /twat dang matra la bya ba sgrub/ ༈ /gnyis tshig kun la yu ba dang*/ /ā bar bsgyur nas bya ba byed/ ༈slar yang shin dubasgyur ba ni/ /twāṃ ni twā ru 'gyur ba ste/ /māṃ yang mā ru bsgyur bar bya/ ༈ /tu bhyaṃ ta ba te yin te/ /ma hyaṃ ma ma me ru 'gyur/ ༈ /yu bāṃ dang ni yu bā bhyāṃ/ /yu ba yoḥrnams bam du 'gyur/ ༈ /ā bāṃ dang ni a bā bhyāṃ/ /a ba yoḥrnams nau zhes bya/ /yu yaṃ yuṣma bhyaṃ dang ni/ /yuṣmā kaṃ rnams bs zhes bya/ ༈ ba yaṃ asma bhyaṃ dang ni/

/asmā kaṃ rnams nas zhes bya/ ༈ /rnam dbye dgu la ā de sha/ /rnam pa brgyad po de dag ni/ /drug bzhi gnyis pa rnams la yod/ /tshig phrad la ni gzhan yang 'dod/ /zhes bya ba nyer mkho sngoms kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ nā do/ dang po la ma yin no/ /tshig re re'i dang po ste thog ma la/ ta ba mam sogs rnam 'gyur thog ma kho na byed kyi/ te me la sogs pa'i ā de sha phyi ma mi byed do/ /'dir dper brjod tshigs bcad 'grel bar 'byung ba ni/ sā mī te sa sa mā ya taḥ/ swā mī me sāṃ pra taṃ ga taḥ/ na ma ste bha ga bānbhū yo/ de hi me mokṣa ma bya yaṃ/ khyod kyi rje de legs 'ongs sam/ /bdag gi rje bo da lta byon/ /zhes drug pa'i dang po dang*/ bcom ldan khyod la yang yang 'dud*/ /mi bzad thar pa bdag la stsol/ /zhes pa bzhi pa'i dang po ste/ rkang pa dang po'i yi ge gsum pa la te dang*/ gnyis pa'i gsum pa la me ni/ khyod kyi dang bdag gi zhes drug pa'i gcig tshig yin no/ /gsum pa'i gsum pa la te dang*/ bzhi pa'i gsum la me ni/ khyod kyi ched don la dang*/ bdag gi ched don la zhes pa'i don gyi khyed la dang bdag la ste bzhi pa'i dang po'o/ ༈swā mī bānsa dza hā sau tstsai/ rdṛ ṣt+wā nau dā na yā tsa nāṃ/ ༈rādzā baṃ dāsya te dā naṃ/dzñā naṃ nau ma dhu sū da naḥ/ ༈jo bo khyed dag gi bzhad gad*/ /nged kyi sbyin khrom 'khrugs 'chos mthong*/ /rkang pa dang po'i yi ge gsum pa ban ni bam ste/ khyed dag gi zhes drug pa'i gnyis tshig dang*/ gnyis pa'i yi ge gsum pa nau na nged cag gi zhes sam bdag cag dag gi zhes drug pa'i gnyis tshig go ༈khyed dag la sbyin rgyal pos byin/ /nged la ye shes sbrang rtsi dgras/ rkang ba gsum pa'i yi ge gsum pa baṃ ni khyed dag gi ched du zhes pa dang*/ bzhi pa'i yi ge gsum pa nau ni nged cag gi don la zhes bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig go /de la dza hā sa gad mo/

utstsai mthon po ste bzhad gang yin/ khrom 'khrugs 'chos pa ni/ sbyin pa gtong pa la hab thob byed pa'i khrom 'khrugs pa la khrom 'chos pa'i phyir brdeg pa ste/ dā na yā tsa na zhes pa'o/ /༈de bo bā ma pa tādbi ṣṇurna ra kāetnau dza nārd+da naḥ/ ༈swāmī bo ba la bān rā dza swā mī nau sau dza nārd+da naḥ༈'jug sel lha yis khyod dag la'ang ste/ /dmyal las bdag cag srungs shis skye bos mchod/ /rkang pa dang por bam khyed dag la zhes dang*/ gnyis par nau zhes pa 'di dang bdag dag la zhes pa gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig go/ ༈stobs ldan rgyal bo khyed cag rnams kyi rje/ 'gro bas mchod de bdag cag rnams kyi rje/ zhes te/ /gsum par/ bo zhes pa ni/ bs kyi s rnam bcad ha ba la u/ u o zhes pa'o/ /bzhi par nau ste/ khyed rnams kyi dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi zhes pa drug pa'i mang tshig go /na mo bo bra hma bi dzhe bhyo dzñā naṃ no dī ya tāṃ dha naṃ/ ༈sā naṃ dātpaḥpra pa shyā mo naḥ pa shyā mo naḥsu duḥkhin/ ༈rab mkhyen tshangs pa khyod rnams la 'dud do/ /bdag cag rnams la ye shes sbyin pa stsol/ ༈ khyod rnams la ni kun dgar rab tu mthong*/ /rab tu sdug bsngal bar mthong bdag rnams la'o/ ༈rkang pa dang po'i bo zhes pa bs te/ khyod rnams kyi don la zhes dang*/ gnyis pa'i no ni bdag cag rnams kyi ched la zhes bzhi pa'i mang tshig dang*/ ༈gsum pa'i baḥ ni bs te khyed rnams la zhes dang*/ bzhi pa'i naḥ ni nas te bdag rnams la zhes gnyis pa'i mang tshig go ༈pa shyā mi twā ma dā lī ḍhaṃ/ pashyā mā ma da bhe da kaṃ/: khyod la bltas na myos pas dregs/ /nga la myos pa 'jig par mthong*/ /rkang ba dang po twā ni khyod la zhes dang*/ gnyis pa'i mā ni nga la zhes pa ste/ rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig go ༈rkang ba so so'i thog ma la/ te me sogs su mi bsgyur ba'i dper brjod ni/ ta ba ye sha tra bo rā dzan/ ma ma te bya te sha tra ba/

༈ ta ba mi trā ṇi yā ni su rma ma mi trā ṇi tā n+ya pi/ ༈rgyal po khyod kyi dgra bo gang*/ /bdag gi yang ni shin du dgra/ ༈khyod kyi gnyen bshes gang yin pa/ /bdag gi bshes kyang de yin no/ /rkang pa so so'i thog mar ta ba ma ma zhes pa yod kyi te me med pa dang*/ ༈ru dro pi shwe shwa ro de po/ yuṣmā kaṃ ku la de ba hā/ sa e ba bha ga bānnā tho/ asmākaṃ pā pa na sha naḥ/ sna tshogs dbang phyug lha drag po/ khyed cag rnams kyi rigs kyi lha/ ༈ /de 'dir mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag rnams kyi sdig ba 'joms/ /rkang pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i thog mar/ yuṣmā kaṃ dang*/ asmākaṃ yod kyi bs nas med pa bzhin no/ ༈de bo ྅smā n+yā hi nra ha re/ biṣṇau3smātkṣa sarba dā/ saṃ bho da na pa dā da gre/ na saṃ bha ba ti ba sā da yaḥ/ bod pa'i tshig gi rjes thogs la/ bs sogs 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /kye lha bdag skyongs mi'i seng ge /rtag par bdag srung khyab 'jug kye/ /zhes te/ de bo bs sogs mi 'byung*/ de ba asmad/ biṣṇu asmad zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ ༈tshig rkang gi dang po ma yin na 'gyur ste/ pāṃ tu po nṛ si dha syan kha lāṃ gal ko ṭa yaḥ/ hi ra ṇya ka shi porba kṣaḥkṣe trā sṛ kkarda mā ru ṇaḥ/ skyongs shig khyed rnams mi yi seng ge yis/ /sen mo'i gshol khyi rtse mos 'dro skyong bu/ /gser can gyi ni lto ba'i ngos dral ba'i/ khrag gi 'dam rdzab 'char ka'i dmar bo 'dzin/ /zhes te/ pāṃ tu sngon la song bas bo ste bs yod pa bzhin no/ ༈tsā di bhishtsa/ tsa la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang ngo*/ /'og tu 'chad ba'i tsa la sogs pa lnga dang sbyor ba'i tshigs la yang*/ ā de sha brgyad bo de mi bya ste/ ta ba tsa ma ma tsa mai trī tsand+ra le khe ba sardha te/ khyod dang nga yi byams 'dris ni/ /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ te tsa/ me tsa/ mi zer bar ta ba tsa/

ma ma tsa zer ba lta bu'o/ /tsa la sogs pa lnga ni/ tsa pā a ha e ba e waṃ zhes so/ /de dag gi yuṣma d dang asmad kyi rnam 'gyur phal cher bshad zin to/ /༈ /da ni mi zad pa'i sde rags rim du bstan par bya ste/ tsā dirni pā taḥ/ tsa la sogs pa ni pā ta'o/ /ming gcig gis don du ma ston pa ni/ a bya yi te mi zad pa zhes sam/ ni pā ta zhes bya'o/ tsa la sogs pa ni 'di dag yin te/ tsa dang yang*/ bā yang na dang 'dra ba aha tshig gi kha skor smras pa e ba 'di zhes nges pa e baṃ bzhin nas mtshungs/ nū naṃ nges pa pṛ tha k so so bi nā spangs pa nā nā sna tshogs swa sti bde legs/ a sti yod pa do ṣā mtshan ma naktaṃ/ mṛṣā mi brdzun thyā brdzun ma thas gsang ba dang 'dres pa gnyis a tha de nas bkra shis a tho bar mtshams med dang phyis nas hya s las shwa s sang nyin u tstsais mtho ba nī tsais dma' ba swa r mtho ris aṃ tar bar mtshams pra ta ra zhogs pa pu nar slar bhu yas mang po a ho ngo mtshar swi tra rnam rtog u t mtho ba dang de ring sa ha bcas ṛ te spangs a nta re ṇa spangs a ntar bar stongs na mas 'dud a laṃ rgyan kṛ tam byed pa dgag tshig gi sgra a mā no nā bzhi dang*/ i ṣatra chung ngu ki la gtam kha lu tshig rgyan bai spangs pa hi rgyu/ ā rā t thag ring thung gnyis ka bhṛ shaṃ phul byung ṛ taṃ bden pa sā kaṃ mthun sārd+daṃ mthun/ yat tat/ de ltar lnga bcu nga gsum par a la sogs pa dbyangs rkyang pa ming du gyur pa dang*/ bod pa dang don gsal bar byed pa rnams kyang ngo/ ༈gzhan yang tat la sogs pa rnam dbye'i don can te/ rtags rnam dbye can bsgyur ba mang po la yang*/ ni pā ta yod de/ tat/ yat/ ku tra/ ku ha/ kwa/ ta dā/ ya dā/ e ka dā/ an+ya dā/ ka dā/ ta thā/ ya thā/ ka thaṃ/ itthaṃ/ ta taḥ/ ya taḥ ku taḥ a taḥ i taḥ/ la sogs pa'o/ /de yang tasmin zhes pa ta tra/ yasmin zhes pa ya tra/

kim gyi ka smin zhes pa ku tra dang*/ ku ha dang*/ kwa zhes pa gang rung du bsgyur te/ de dag bdun pa'i sgra dkyus ma yin la/ ༈dus dang 'brel ba'i bdun pa yin na/ ta smin zhes pa ta dā/ yasmin zhes pa yadā/ e ka'i sgra la e ka dā/ an+ya smin la a n+ya dā/ kim gyi kasmin ka dā/ la sogs pa dang*/ ༈gsum pa'i don la/ te na zhes pa pra ka ra ston byed la/ ta thā/ ye na zhes pa ya thā/ kim gyi ke na la ka thaṃ/ i dm gyi a ne na la/ itthaṃ la sogs pa dang*/ ༈lnga pa'i don la ta tra kyi tasmāt zhes pa/ ta taḥ/ yat la yasmāt zhes pa ya taḥ/ kim gyi kasmāt zhes pa ku taḥ/ i dm gyi asmāt zhes pa a taḥ/ e tad la e tasmāt la i taḥ/ la sogs par bsgyur zin pa rnams mi zad pa'o/ /༈ sārb+babi bhakti kastas i tye ke/ rnam dbye thams cad pa la tas zhes pa gcig pu rnams so/ kha cig tshig 'di lung 'dren yin yang zer ro/ tas kyi rkyen rnam dbye thams cad la sbyor du rung*/ 'on kyang de'i don ni gcig pu'i don la sbyin te/ gcig pu don ni gcig kho na dang*/ ches gtso bo kho na la 'jug go tas kyi mtha' can yang ni pā ta'o/ ༈sarb+ba la tas zhes pa byin pas/ sarba taḥzhes pa lta bu ming po la 'jug go /༈yang purb+basmin zhes pa pu rastāt/ adhar smin zhes pa a dha stāt/ pa rasmin zhes pa pa re ṇa zhes par bsgyur ro/ /༈yang dakṣiṇa dang 'brel ba'i i ta ra de rigs dma' ba la/ a hi zhes pa'i rkyen tha mar sbyar na yang mi zad pa'i rtags te/ dakṣi ṇā hi ba saṃ ti tsanḍa laḥ/ lho phyogs thag ring ba na gnas par byed gdol pa'o/ /zhes par 'gyur/ gdol pa rnams grong khyer phyi rol lho phyogs na yod pa'o/ /a hi zhes pa dakṣi ṇa dang 'brel bas gnas gzhi'i don dang rgyang ring ba gnyis ka ston no/ ༈kimaḥsā mā n+ye tsi dā diḥ/ kim las spyi sgra la tsit sogs so/ /kim gyi sgra la gong du bshad pa'i pho mo ma ning rtags ci yin yang rung*/

rnam dbye nyer gcig gang byung kyang rung ste/ tsit rkyen sbyin du rung zhing*/ byin pa na mi thad pa/ ni bā ta yin no/ /tsit sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas tsan'i rkyen sogs kyang ste/ dper na ka dā tsitā la sogs pa dang*/ ༈kaḥzhes pa la tsit btags pas/ kashtsit la sogs pa dang*/ ༈kwatsit/ kwatsan/ kut tsit/ kuha tsit la sogs pa thams cad la sbyar ro/ ༈ ta da dhī na kārt+sn+ya yorbā sat/ de'i g.yog 'khor dang tshogs mtha' dag 'dus pa la sāt yang na'o/ /g.yog 'khor gyi don la sāt ster te/ dper na rā dzhā dhi na/ rgyal po'i g.yog 'khor zhes/ sāt rkyen ma byin pa dang*/ de la sāt byin na/ rā dzñā/ rā dza ru loga.a dhi na phyis te/ sāt nyid gnas pas/ rā dza sāt zhes par 'gyur yang don de mi 'gyur bar de ka la gnas pa lta bu'o/ ༈sarbaṃ bhasma thams cad thal ba zhes pa/ de la sāt byin pas/ sarbaṃ phyis bhasma sāt zhes pa ste/ kun 'dus pa'i don la sāt do/ ༈smras ba'i tshig la don bzhin sgrub pa sogs mtshan ma bzung ba'am/ mang po las gcig bzung ba'i don la/ ū rī u ra ri u ra rī/ zhes pa rnams kyang ni bā ta yin zhing*/ ༈sarba'i sgra dus kyi don/ sadya la sogs pa ste/ sadya sa pa ti de ma thag gam 'phral du a dya de ring a dhu nā da ni i dā nāṃ da lta saṃ pra ti da lta sāṃ pra taṃ da lta pu rb+be dyuḥsang*/ ba re dyuḥganangs*/ a n+ya dyuḥgazhes dgus sogs/ ya di dus gang la/ yarhi/ dus gang la/ ta di de'i dus tarhi/ ā su mgyogs po shīghraṃ/ mgyogs po dzhaṭi ti mgyogs pa turṇā/ rnams kyang mi zad pa'o/ /pra di ru ba sargaḥ/ pra la sogs pa nyer bsgyur ro/ /pra la sogs pa ni/ pra/ pa rā/ a ba/ sam/ a nu/ a ba/ na r/ du r/ bi/ āng ni/ adhi/ a bi/ a ti/ su/ ut/ a bhi/ pra ti/ pa ri/ u pa/ zhes pa ste nyer bsgyur nyi shu dang*/ nyer sgyur dang phyogs mtshungs pa ā bi ste nyer gcig/pragdhātoḥ/

byings la thog ma'o/ /nyer bsgyur rnams phal cher byings kyi thog mar rab tu sbyor rgyu'o/ /ta da bya yaṃ/ de mi zad pa'o/ /tsa la sogs pa nas pra sogs kyi bar la mi zad pa zhes bya'o/ ༈kt+wādyaṃ taṃ tsa/ kt+wa la sogs pa yang ngo*/ /de ltar na tsa nas ā bi bar du ma zad/ ka twā la sogs pa ches mang po zhig kyang mi zad pa'o/ /'og tu yang 'chad par 'gyur mod/ mtshon pa tsam ni/ ḍukṛny byed pa la'o/ /ḍu dang ny phyis/ kṛ bzhagakt+wā yi rkyen byin/ kṛ ma phyis par bzhag na/ kṛ'i ri yon tan ar du byed dgos pa las/ 'dir k phyis pas k nyid la gnas nas/ kṛ tā byas nas/ de bzhin du/ ga phyin nas twa/ na twa phyag 'tshal nas/ stu twa bstod pa byas nas/ da tt+wa byin nas/ dṛ ṣt+wa bltas nas/ ma twa shes nas/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ḍukṛny/ kṛ tum zhes pa'i rkyen byin/ ṛ yon tan ka rtuṃ byed pa'i don du'am byed pa la/ de bzhin du/ ga ntuṃ phyin pa la'am 'gro ba la/ na tuṃ phyag 'tshal ba la/ sto tuṃ bstod pa la/ dā tuṃ ster ba la/ ma nduṃ shes pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈a bya yādbi bhakterluk/ mi zad pa las rnam dbye rnams 'jig go/ mi zad pa'i rtags kyi sde la/ rnam dbye bdun gsum nyer gcig thams cad 'jig pa'o/ /zhes pa spyir btang su bshad nas/ ༈sgrar gyur pa'i mi zad pa la dmigs gsal du rnam dbye mi 'jig par bya ba byed pa srid de/ rig byed dang tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa yin te/ pra kri ya la sogs pa nas bshad do/ /mi zad pa'i sde la/ pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba'i rtags tha dad mi 'dra ba cung zad kyang med de/ kun la sbyor bar bya ba kho na'o/ /gsungs pa/ rtags gsum la ni mnyam par mtshungs/ /rnam dbye thams cad la yang ngo*/ /tshig rnams thams cad la yang ste/ /dbyer med gang de mi zad pa'o/ /bshad pa 'dis na/ rtags kyi dbye ba med do/ /gang las kyang mi 'gyur bas na mi zad pa'o zhes bshad do/

/gzhan yang 'di ltar go dgos te/ mi zad pa'i sde dpag tu med pa zhig yod kyang*/ grags che ba dag 'dir smos pa la/ rgya skad du a bya yi zhes pa ni mi zad pa ste/ si sogs rnam dbye'i rkyen byin yang*/ rnam par 'gyur ba med pas mi 'gyur mi zad ces bya/ yang tshig gcig la yang skabs thob kyi don sna tshogs pa 'byung bas/ don zad pa med pa'i phyir yang mi zad pa zhes bya/ ༈yang 'di la rgya skad du/ ni pā ta zhes kyang zer ba/ sngon gyi lo tsa ba rnams kyis ni pā ta tshig phrad du bsgyur/ 'on kyang ni nges pa dang*/ pā ta tshig yin pa/ nges tshig zhes pa'i don du 'gyur gsungs*/ nges pa'i sgra don yang rkyen gyis mi 'gyur ba'i don no/ ༈sgra'i skabs 'dir ni pā ta zhes gnyis yod pa/ ni pā ta tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa dang*/ ni pā ta nges tshig gi rtags gnyis don mi gcig ste/ 'di dag ni pā ta'i rtags yin la/ cig shos ni sgra sgrub tshul dmigs gsal gyi nang tshan zhig go/ ༈mi zad pa'i rtags kyi sde la dbye na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mi zad pa dang*/ bsgyur pa'i mi zad pa dang*/ rkyen gyi mtha'i mi zad pa gsum yod do/ ༈dang po la dbye na/ nyer bsgyur dang*/ nyer bsgyur ma yin pa gnyis so/ /nyer bsgyur ni nyi shu'am ā bi bgrangs na nyer gcig yin la/ ༈gnyis pa la ming rkyang pa zhes pa dbyangs/ kho na ming du bzhag pa rnams dang*/ a la sogs pa dgag tshig rkyang pa rnams dang*/ tsa la sogs pa mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig dang*/ nu naṃ la sogs pa rang rkang can gyi tshig dang sa bya la sogs pa dus kyi don can te rig lnga yod do/ ༈gnyis pa bsgyur pa'i mi zad pa ni/ ta smin ta trar bsgyur ba dang*/ purb+basmin pu ra stāt ru bsgyur ba la sogs pa rnams so/ ༈rkyen gyi mtha' can gyi mi zad pa ni/ tas dang e hi dang tsit dang tsan dang*/ sād dang*/ kt+wa dang tum gyi mtha' can la sogs pa'o/ ༈gzhung 'dir/

rtags drug dang*/yusmad asmad du rnam dbye 'jug tshul dang thams cad rnam 'gyur 'byung tshul rgyas par bshad nas de rnams kyi dmigs gsal du rnam dbye rnams 'jug kyang rnam 'gyur med pa mi zad pa'i le'u bstan pa yin no/ /nyer bsgyur rnams rtags mtha' 'byung ba nyung la/ si sogs rnam dbye'i rnam 'gyur pha rol du mi 'byung zhes bya yi/ spyir rkyen gzhan gyi rnam 'gyur ni ches mang ste/ bai shra ba ṇā dang*/ au pa ga ba lta bu'o/ /de la tsa la sogs pa lnga bcu nga gsum dang*/ ༈ta tra la sogs pa bcu dgu dang*/ ༈sa dya la sogs pa bco brgyad dang*/ ༈nyer bsgyur nyi shu po rnams la ngag byang bar bya zhing*/ nyer bsgyur rnams kyi don la blo gros kyi 'jug pa rgyas par yang bya ste/ re zhig de tsam gyis kyang mkhas pa'i bya ba cung zad byed do/ /de yang phyogs mtshon tsam ni 'di lta ste/ ༈pra thog mar sbyar ba la/ pra ṇa ma ni rab bsngags te/ /phyag 'tshal ba'am oṃ yig go /pradzñā shes rab/ prābta thob/ /pra mā ṇa dang pra kirṇa/ /tshad ma dang ni bkram ba'i don/ /pra kṛ ti ni rang bzhin la'o/ /pra bhu khyab bdagapra be sha/ /'bebs pa la'o/ pra bha 'od/ /gzhol ba la ni pra ba ṇa/ /thal 'gyur la ni pra saṃ ga /tho rangs pra tar pra sanna/ /dang ba pra gra ha srabs pa/ /pra dhā na ni gtso bo la/ /pra ya tstsha ni sbyin pa stsol/ /pra yā da ni bka' drin zas/ /pra yo dza na dgos pa ste/ /prap dha shin du sbyangs pa la/ sogs kyi don la pra mu kha/ /pra bhri ta 'o pro ḍha dang*/ /pra ṇi ta ni gya noms pa'o/ gnyis pa pa rā'i don la/ /pa rā bhī bi ti ni brnyas pa'o/ /pa rā kra ma rnam gnon lkog gyur la/ /pa ro3 kṣa'o pa rā mṛṣta reg /pa rā bitta ta ni yongs gyur ro/ /rim min pa rā britta ta/ /pa rā dzi ta mchog tu rgyal/ /pa rā ga ta bral ba'o/ /pa rā mu kha phyir phyogs pa/ /pa rā shu ta rnam par rmongs// 10༈gsum pa a ba pa'i don ni/

/zhu gsol a ba tsā ya nā/ rma 'bebs a ba ka ra ghī/ /a ba rā dha gnod par bshad/ /bral ba a ba ga ta ste/ /sel ba la ni a bo ha/ /byang grol a ba brga ste/ /a ba pā ta smad ra'o/ /gnod pa a ba kā ri ṇaṃ/ /mi gsal a ba ba ra ṇaṃ/ /gsang tshig a ba la bha'o/ /bsnyon dor gsang ba a ba hu/ 12 ༈bzhi ba a nu'i don ni/ /rjes thogs a nu ṣaṃ ga ste/ /rjes dpag a nu mā nar brjod/ /a nu kū la mthun pa ste/ /a nu sha ya phra rgyas kyang bag la nyal/ /mthu la a nu bhā bar bshad/ /a nu kamba rtse ba la/ /rjes 'brang a nu pā ri ṇa/ /rjes gnang la ni a nu dzñā/ /a nu patti dma' ba'i phyogs/ /skyar ma dang ni yang yang dang*/ /snga ma'i rjes 'jug don la mang*/ 13 ༈lnga pa a ba'i don ni/ /a ba lamba 'dzar ba'i don/ /a ba dā na rtogs brjod la/ /a ba nā da zhal gdams so/ /zhum pa a ba mī naṃ ste/ nges bzung dkar ba zur bkol la/ /a ba dhā ra ṇa zhes grags/ /a ba dā ta dkar po ste/ /a ba ya ba cha shas la/ 'jug pa bar stongs skabs dang bklags/ / 'od snang a ba bhā sar brjod/ /a ba ta ra skye dang 'jug /a ba kirṇa khyab pa'o// 16 ༈drug pa nir gyi don ni/ /'di ni phal cher dgag tshig mang*/ /nirā ma ya skyon med te/ /nges pa'i tshig la ni rukta/ /nishtsita ni nges pa la'o/ /nirde sha ni rgyas bshad do/ /ni rbāṇa dang ni ryā ṇa/ /mya ngan 'das dang nges 'byung la'o/ /niḥshra ya ni nges legs te/ /ni shsha lya ni zug rngu spangs/ /ni shsha laṃ ka rnyog bral dang*/ /cha med pa la'ang 'jug pa yin/ /cho 'phrul ni rmi ta zhes brjod/ /ni ṣṣu ta ni gsal ba yin/ 12 ༈bdun pa dur gyi don ni/ /ngan pa dang ni dka' las la/ /phal cher dur gyi sgra 'jug ste/ /durga ti dang durbā sa/ /du rbhukta dang dur dza na/ /ngan 'gro gnas ngan za nyes dang*/ /mi ngan rnams la rim bzhin brjod/ /durga rdzong ste bgrod dka' zer/ /rnyed par dka' la dur la bha/

/dka' ba byed la du ṣka ra/ durba la ni nyams chung ba/ /duḥkha sdug bsngal yin par grags/ /du ryo dha na 'thab dka'o/ 11 ༈brgyad pa bi yi don la/ /bi nā ya ka rnam log 'dren/ bi pā ka ni rnam smin no/ /bai ro tsa na rnam snang mdzad/ /bi ma la dang bi pa shya/ /dri bral dang ni lhag mthong yin/ /bi ru ḍha ka bi de ha/ /lus 'phags nyid yin 'phags skyes zer/ /bkraṃ dang khyad 'phags pi shiṣta/ /sna tshogs la ni bi tsit/ /bi ti grub pa'am cho ga la/ /bi bhu mnga' bdag byā sta khyab/ /bi ma ti ni the tshom mo/ /bya ba lo ka lta ba ste/ /bkod pa bhyu ha la sogs/ 15 ༈dgu pa āng gyi don ni/ /ā di dang po ā ka sha/ /nam mkha' ā yu tshe la'o/ /ā kā ra dang ā ka ra/ /rnam pa dang ni 'byung gnas la/ /le lo la ni ā la sya/ ā sha ya dang ā sha ni/ gnyis ka 'dod dang bsam pa la/ /bza' ba la ni ā ha ra/ /'phel ba la yang ā be sha/ /lung dang sngags rgyud ā ga ma/ /ā khya ta ni bshad pa'i ming*/ /ā bar ta ya zhugs pa ste/ /skor ba la ni ā bṛtta/ dad gus la ni ā da ra/ /ring po ā ya ta zhes brjod/ /tha gru la yang ā ya ma/ ā bho ṣa ni 'bad rtsol yin/ /ā batti ni ltung ba zer/ zil ba la yang ā bar ta/ ā shirba ta shis brjod yin/ /ā ha smras dang bod pa la'o/ /āskā bka' lung gnang ba'i don/ /ā li dbyangs dang phreng ba'o/ /kun dga' ra ba ā rā ma/ /ā de sha ni snang ba dang*/ /kun nas sgyur ba'i don du 'dod/ /ā yu dha ni mtshon cha ste/ /ā bha ra ṇa rgyan la brjod/ 28 ༈bcu pa ni'i don ni/ /nges pa'i skad dod ni ya ma/ /ni ya ta yang de dang gcig/ni pā ta ni nges tshig ste/ /ni bā sa na gos dang thabs/ ni bṛtta zhes log pa'i don/ gling gzhi'i don la ni dā na/ /ni mand+ra zhes brda byed pa/ ltung zhing 'gyel ba ni pa da/ ni ka ṭa zhes thag nye ba/ /tshogs la ni ka ra zhes 'dod/ 10/ bcu gcig pa a dhi'i don ni/

/a dhi lhag pa'i don la mang*/ dper na lhag pa'i shes rab la/ /a dhi pradzñā zer ba bzhin/ /de sogs mang ste 'dir ma smos/ /a dhi pa ti bdag po che/ /a dhyātma ni nang gi don/ /lhag po la yang a dhi kaṃ/ a dhyu shi ta lhag par byung*/ /dag lus pa la a dhī na/ /a dhi ka ra dbang du byas/ /a dhi te ni 'don cing klog/bla dag a dhi bā tsa naṃ/ 10 ༈bcu gnyis pa a bi yi don ni/ /'di ni phal cher tshig gzhan gyi/ /mtshams sbyor phra mo yin pas na/ /thog ma la yang srid mod kyi/ /phal cher tha mar 'byung ba yin/ /thog mar bzhag pa'i dper brjod ni/ /a pi tsa ni gzhan yang ste/ /a pi hu zhes yin mod kyi/ /tha mar yod pa 'di 'dra ste/ /ta thā pi na de lta mod/ /ya thā bi ni ji ltar yang*/ /de bas kyang la ta ro3 bi/ /gang yang gzhan yang yo3 bi'o/ /ci 'dra'ang ya thā bi na ma/ /'di ni dbus su bzhag pa yin/ /a bi kho na'i tshig de yang*/ /kyang dang yang dag 'ang gi don/ 11 ༈bcu gsum pa a ti'i don ni/ /phul byung a ti sha ya ste/ /a ti mā tra chad med pa/ /a ti bā ta brgal ba'i tshig /a ti bhra ma shin du 'khor/ /a ti sa ra 'khru skyug ste/ /'das pa'i dus la a ti ta/ /a ti bra siddha zhes pa/ / mchog tu gsal bar grags shing grub/ /a ti phal cher shin du'i don/ /9 ༈bcu bzhi pa su'i don ni/ /su ni bzang bo mdzes dang bde/ /rab dang legs dang phul byung don/ /byed sla ba dang gces pa'i nor/ /de sogs rnam pa kun la 'gro /su dhī blo bzang zhes bya ste/ /su ba hu ni dpung bzang sogs/ phal cher bzang po'i don la 'jugasu rū pa ni gzugs mdzes dang*/ /bde gshegs su ga ta zhes bya/ /su bha dra ni rab bzang dang*/ /rab dga' la yang su ra ta/ /su kri ta ni legs byas te/ /lo legs skye rgyal su bhakṣi/ /su bi shuddha zhes pa ni/ /shin du rnam dag ces la sogs/ /shin du'i don la'ang yod pa mang*/

/ rnyed sla 'i don la su la bha/ /su hrid sems la gces par 'dzin/ /su ka ra ya bya sla ba/: /dang ba'i yid la su mā na/ 20 ༈bco lnga pa ut gyi don ni/ /rgyas pa la ni utpu la/ /dar ba rgyas pa skye dang 'byung*/ /'char ba rnams la u da ya/ /utpanna zhes skye ba la/ /dga' ston la yang ut+sa ba/ /byang phyogs mchog dang 'das pa dang*/ /bla ma phyi ma uttar/ /utta ma yang mchog la'o/ /ud dā na ni sdoms tshig ste/ /mdor bstan pa la ud de sha/ /utstsha ra ṇa smra dang brjod/ /ud gha ṭa dang utka ṭa/ /uṅga ra gsum rim pa bzhin/ /phye dang shas che bsgrags pa'o/ 19༈bcu drug pa a bhi'i don ni/ /'di ni phal cher mngon par gyi/ /don la 'jug mod gzhan yang yod/ /a bhi mu kha mngon du phyogs/ /a bhi bhu ni zil gnon yin/ /a bhikṣa ṇa yang yang ste/ /ming la a bhi dha nar brjod/ /a bhyu da ya mngon par mtho/ /a bhi dhya zhes brnab sems te/ /a bhi prā ya dgongs pa'o/ /a bhi u pa ga ma zhes/ khas len pa la rab tu grags/ /a bhi dhe ya brjod bya'o/ 10༈bcu bdun pa pra ti'i don ni/ /lan la pra ti ba tsa na/ /gzugs brnyan pra ti bimba'o/ /pra ti hi ta byin pa 'phrog /pra ti kirṇa yal ga ste/ /pra ti ṣi ta dgag pa'o/ /pra ti bannā mi mthun pa/ /mngon sum la ni pra tyakṣa/ /bshags 'bul pra ti de sha na/ /spobs pa pra ti bhā na'o/ /rkyen la pra tya ya zhes bya/ /chu ngogs pra ti rañtsa dang*/ pra ti gha dang pra ti dzña/ khong khro ba dang dam bca' la'o/ /sku gzugs pra ti mā na ste/ pra ti bandha 'brel ba dang*/ /pra ti gṛhṇa zhes pa ni/ /zhugs pa'i don la bshad pa'ang yod/ /yal ga rgyas pa'i don la ni/ /shā ga pra ti zhes bya ba/ /tha mar sbyar ba'ang 'di la yod/ 14 ༈bco brgyad pa pa ri'i don ni/ /rnam grangs la ni paryā ya/ /paryaṅka ni skyil krungs dang*/ /mal stan la yang 'dod pa yin/ /yongs rdzogs la ni paryanta/

/yongs su 'joms la pa ri gha/ /pa ri pa ra'am pa ri ṣa/ /'khor g.yog nye ba'i ming du brjod/ /pa ri mi ta blos 'jal ba/ /pa ri ṇā ma bsngo ba dang*/ /yongs su bsgyur ba'i don yin no/ /pa ri sheṣti ta zhes dang*/ /pa ri bitta yongs su bskor/ /pa rī tta ni chung du'o/ /smre sdags pa ri de ba na/ /longs spyod pa ri bho gar bshad/ /kun rgyu pa ri pra dza ka /pa ri ka ra zhes pa ni/ /yan lag la 'jug sdoms la'ang 'jug26 ༈bcu dgu pa u pa'i don ni/ /u pa ya na u pa har/ /u pa gra haṃ u pa dhā/ /de bzhi skyes dang 'bul ba dang*/ /zhu rten phyag rten rnams kyi ming*/ /u pa ma na u pa mā/ /dper dang nyer 'jal gnyis la 'jug /u pa dra ba nyer 'tshe ga nod*/ /u pā hi ta rang bzhin no/ /u pa ra ta spangs pa yin/ /gdan khri u pa dha zhes brjod/ /u pā shu ni 'gol ba la/ /u pā ya ni thabs yin no/ /mal gdan u pa dhā nar brjod/ /u pa li ni nye bar 'khor/ /u pa ba dha tsi lang ṭi/ /u pa dhya yi mkhan po'o/ /u pa nā zhes bya ba ni/ /bsnyen gnas len pa'i ming du brjod/ /u pā sa ni snyung gnas so/ /nyer sgyur dang ni gnod byed la/ /u pa sarga zhes par grags/ /u pa n+ya ba nye bar 'god/ /u pa rā ga'ang nyer sgyur dang*/ /lam du 'god dang glu lan len/ 19 ༈nyi shu pa sam gyi don ni/ /sambha ra dang saṃ ke ta ni tshogs dang brda/ /kun 'dzin sandha ra ste 'byor ba saṃ gṛ dhi/ /kun 'byung sa mu da ya spyi la swa mā na/ /chags thogs sa ma saṃ ga phyags dar saṃ ka ra/ /sa myak yang dag saṃ dzñā mi/ /sa mā ga ma mjal dang 'phrad/ /santā na ni rgyu la'o/ /brjod dang sdud pa sadgī ti/ /bsdus pa la ni saṃ gra ha/ /dus dang brda dang rtogs pa dang*/ /gzhung lugs grub mtha' dam tshig la/ /sa ma ya zhes brjod pa yin/ /saṃ sthā naṃ ni dbyibs la'o/ /sambandha ni 'brel bar bshad/ /the tshom la ni saṃ sha ya/ /tshogs pa'i don la sando ha/

/kun spyod sa mā tsa ra ste/ /sa manta ni kun nas so/ /yang dag rgyal las rā taṭa/ /santarpa ni tshim pa yin/ /'pho ba la yang sañtsa ra/ /saṃ pri ta ni kun rdzob bo/ /g.yul 'gyed pa la saṃ gra ma/ /saṃ ha ta na grims po'o/ /sdud pa la ni sañtsa ya/ /saṃ khyā grangs kyi ming yin te/ samba t+sa ra dus kyi lo/ /phun sum tshogs pa saṃ banna/ 37 zhes bya'o/ /nye bsgyur nyi shu po 'di dag la/ /ka tsan gnyis kyi lugs so so la yang go rim mi 'dra ba re 'dug cing*/ 'dir bshad pa yang*/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mi'i gzhung dang go rim 'dra mod/ go rim mi gcig na/ a nu sogs ngur sogs zhes pa lta bu ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba tsam dgos pa ma gtogs/ lar ni ngo bo gcig pas don la khyad med do/ sam ni lugs 'di la nyer sgyur bzhi pa yin par dkyus la bshad kyang skabs 'dir nyi shu par bton pa ni/ thog ma pra dang*/ tha ma saṃ du byed pa tshig bkra legs pa'i don no/ ༈ pra pā rā pa sa ma nwa ba nirdu rb+yād/ n+ya dha yo3 bya ti sū da bha ya pra ti paryu pa/ zhes pa lugs 'di dang mthun pa'i rim pa ltar nyer sgyur mtshams sbyar ba'i sdoms yin/ ༈ka lā pa'i lugs kyi go rim ni/ pra dang pā ra ni nir utra dur sam/ /bi dang a ba a nu pa ri dang*/ /a bhi a dhi pra ti su dang āng/ /a ti a ba a pi u ba'o/ /de la 'phags mchog tsand+ra go mis/ nyer bsgyur la 'grel ba bsdus pa mdzad/ paṇḍi ta gha ṭa ba'i 'grel ba cung zad rgyas pa yang yod/ dbyangs can brda sprod rang lugs la yang mang du yod 'dug na'ang ma mthong la/ phyis bod du lo tsa ba chos skyong bzang pos rgya dpe mang po gzigs nas rnyed tshad bsdus pa'i 'grel chen yod pas rgyas par de dag tu shes par bya'o/ /'on kyang phyi ma 'di la 'dod rgyal kho na'i ming 'ga' re nyer sgyur rang min pa'ang cung zad 'dres sam snyam mod*/ mkhas pa'i phyag rjes la blun pos skyor 'byin mi byed do/

/lar nas dpe de mthong na nye sgyur gyi don la ngo mtshar ches che ba skyed par snang ngo*/ /de ltar na mi zad pa'i le'u bshad zin to/ ༈ da ni rtags gsum ngos bzung pa'i don du khyad par shes par 'dod pas/ mo rtags kyi rkyen nam/ bud med du sgrub pa'i rkyen 'jug tshul bshad par bya'o/ /bud med la a las ā p'o/ /zhes pa'i mdo sngar byung ba 'grel pa mkhan pos/ dgos pa'i dbang las gong du bcug gi /gzhung gi go rim la 'dir 'jug go /de yang*/ dzā ya zhes pa la ā p bud med rkyen byin/ p rjes 'grel/ 'dra ba ring bo/ dzā yā/ bu mo mtshan bzang mo des mtshon nas de bzhin du/ ma ya la/ ma yā nor can ma'o sgyu ma can/ me dha la/ me dhā blo ldan ma/ shraddha la shraddhā dad can ma/ dhar la dharā chang ba dang mtshon cha'i so/ mā la la mālā phreng rgyud mkhan ma/ sogs pa'o/ ༈ a dzā de shtsāp/ a dza la sogs pa'i yang āp'o/ 'di yang dpe 'ga' las/ bakta byaḥzhes lung 'dren du byas pa dang*/ phal cher 'di nyid kyi mdo dngos su 'dod pa gnyis byung ba/ bakta bya zhes pa med pa'i phyogs mdo dngos yin pa legs par sems so/ /de yang bud med la a la āp zhes byung bas a dza la sogs pa dgos su smos pa ci snyam na/ dza yā sogs la āp byin pa mo rtags yin yang 'jug pa'i yul ma nges pa nyid de/ /pho dang ma ning gi dngos po la 'gro ba'ang yod la/ /a dza sogs la bud med kyi rkyen āp byin pa ni yul bud med kho na la 'jug pas/ mo rtags kho na las nam yang 'gyur ba med par go ba'i phyir ro/ /a dza la ap byin na/ a dzā ra mā de bzhin du/ e ṭa ka la/ e ṭa lug ma mo/ kā ko ki la la/ ko ki lā khu byug mo/ bā la la/ bā bu lā mo lo bcu drug ma/ shu dra la/ shu drā dmangs mo/ /ga ṇi ka la/ ga ṇi kā tshogs can ma ste smad 'tshong ma/ sogs pa'o/ /de yang dza yā sogs la brjod bya'i yul mo ma nges la/

a dzā sogs la nges pa'i phyir don la khyad par yod pas kha gsal byed dgos byung ba yin no/ ༈ kā pya taḥ kāp la i at kyi'o/ /kā pi i a t ngas rnams sbyar ba las mdo tshig de ltar byung ste/ kā pi zhes pa ni/ kāp dang di'o/ /kāp ni mo rkyen āp dang bcas pa'i kā yi ming ste/ kāp'i snga rol kyi de ma thag pa'i a yig ni i yig tu 'gyur te/ kā ra ka āp pa rjes 'brel/ kā ra kā zhes par song ba'i rjes de ma thag/ra'i a de kāp'i sngon ma nyid yin pa'i phyir/ i yig tu 'gyur bas/ kā ri kā byed mkhan nam tshig le'u byas pa bsgyur te/ zhes pa grub bo/ /pā ṭha kā/ pā ṭhi kā klog pa mo/ pā tsa kā pā tsa kī 'chos pa mo ste g.yos pa/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ka n+ya kā la sogs pa la ni/ kāp'i mtha' yin yang*/ gong ma'i a yig i yig tu mi 'gyur te/ kān+ye kā zhes pa mi bsgyur te/ ka n+ya kā nyid la gnas pa'o/ ༈'grel par kha bkang ba la/ nyer bsgyur a ba a bi dag gi a dbyi bar bha gu ri 'dod do zhes 'byung ste/ bha gu ri ni drang srong zhig go/ de yang gdam nga ste/ a ba gā hyaṃ zhes pa la/ /rang gnas/ ba gā hyaṃ zhes pa dang*/ a pi dhā naṃ la rang gnas sam/ pi dha naṃ zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈yang has'i mtha' rnams la 'dir āp yang ngo*/ /zhes kyang drangs te/ bā ts āp p rjes 'brel/ bā tsā ni sh āp/ ni sha di sh āp/ di shā zhes pa'o/ ༈hra swo bā/ thung ngu yang na'o/ /mo? rtags la kāp pha rol du yod pa'am/ ta rā pha rol tu yod pa la/ snga ma rtags mtha'i dbyangs ring po yod na thung ngur 'byung ba yang yod de/ 'dam ga la 'dra mnyam dang*/ shas che chung gnyis yod pa las/ thung ngu shas che'o/ /kap pha rol la/ be ṇi kā lan tshar can ma/ zhes pa'am/ be ṇī kā na di kā zhes pa'am/ na dī/ rgyun can ma ste chu bo*༈ ta rā pha rol can ni/ shre ya si ta rā'am/ shre ya dge legs can ma sī ta rā kā zhes so/

༈ /nau kā gru mkhan ma la sogs pa mang po zhig la ring po thung ngur bsgyur pa'i bya ba mi thob ste/ dper/ nau kā thung ngur byed na/ nu kā ru 'gyur ba las/ 'dir de ltar mi 'gro'o/ /gzhung gis yang na bar bshad pas/ nau kā sogs la mi bsgyur bar nges pa yang ci snyam na/ yang na'i skad dod bā zhes pas zin te/ tshig gcig la don du ma yod pas na mi zad pa ste/ bā zhes pa 'di yang mi zad pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir yang don gnyis te/ be ni kā sogs la/ yang na ba'i don dang*/ nau kā sogs la byed pa 'gog pa'i don de gnyis ka 'jug pa'o/ /de ltar gyur pa'i āp'i mtha' kun la rnam dbye 'jug tshul gang gā'i sgra dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /nra ṇi īp/ n ṛ an las īpa'o/ /n mtha' ṛ mtha'/ aṇ mtha' ste/ aṇ gyi rkyen byin pa'i der rjes a'i mtha' la yang*/ mo rkyen 'jug pa yin na rkyen ci lta bu snyam na īp 'jug go /daṇḍin la īp/ pa rjes 'brel/ drangs/ danḍa nī dbyugs pa can ma'i chad pa mkhan ma/ dantin/ īp/ danti nī so ldan ma/ kā rin/ īp/ ka ri ṇī glang chen ma/ mā lin/ īp/ mā li nī 'phreng ldan ma/ rādzñā īp/ āp la rādzñā'i a dbyi'o zhes bshad pas/ rādzñā dngos su dbyangs mtha' yin yang*/ rā dzn las byung bas 'dir smos te/ dzñā'i a phyis/ ī la drangs/ rāo dzñī rgyal ma/ shwan īp/ shwa yi ba sgra u ru bsgyur te/ shu nī khyi mo ṛ mtha' la/ kart-i? īp/ ṛ r r dang ta ī la drangs/ ka rt+rī byed pa ma h-irt+ra īp/ ha mo rt+rī rkun chung*/ ༈ aṇ mtha' la/ u pa ga ba/ bu brgyud rkyen gyis 'gyur ba/ au pa ga ba/ ba'i a phyis/ īpa ྄la drangs pas/ au pa ga bī/ phyugs skyong ma/ ༈ mā tṛ ma dang dang*/ swa sṛ sgyug mo la sogs pa ṛ mtha' bud med kyi don yin yang*/ īp mi 'jug ste bud med kyi rtags su rang grub pas so/ /zhes dgongs so/

༈yu ban īp/ yu ba'-i ba u ru song*/ /u 'dra ba'i yi ge yu ring po/ yū nī lang tsho ma/ ma gha ba na/ īp wa u ru song*/ a u la o ru song*/ ma gho nī brgya byin mo zhes so/ ༈ ya sya lo paḥ i a dag gi dbyi'o/ /rtags mtha' la i'am a yod la/ /pha rol rkyen dbyangs dang ya yig yod na/ a dang i phyis par 'gyur ro/ gong gi au pa ga ba'i ba yi a dbyi ba'i gzhung yang 'di kho na'o/ //ṣ-iḍabrataḥ ṣṭ u ṛ las so/ ṣ yig rjes 'brel sngon song can te/ da lta rjes 'brel dngos su med kyang*/ sngar byung ba'i rigs dang*/ de bzhin du ṭ dang u dang*/ ṛ yig rjes 'brel sngon song can gyi ming la mo rtags byed na/ īp ster te/ ༈ṣa rjes 'brel gyi dpe ni/ ba rā ka lta bu ste/ de byings/ bṛ la ṣka'i rkyen btags pa las byung ba'o/ ༈ṭa rjes 'brel dper brjod/ ku ru tsa ra/ ṭa byin pa'i rjes yin pa dang*/ u rjes 'brel/ go ma ta lta bu ste/ sngon go ma tu zhes pa bsgyur bas so/ ༈pa tsanta/ pa ṭhaṃ ta/ bha baṃ ta/ zhes pa/ pa tsaṃ tṛ la sogs par yod pa rkyen gyis bsgyur bas 'di dag ṛ rjes kyi dpe'o/ /de rnams la īp ster bas/ i a dag gi dbyi'o/ zhes pas/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs phyis/ drangs pas/ pā ra kī mdzes ma/ ༈ku ru tsa rī ku ru'i yul gyi bud med/ ༈ go ma tī chu bo'i nang tshan/ bha ma banti skal can/ ༈ pa tsaṃ tī g.yos ma/ ma ṭhantī klog ma/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ na dā deḥ/ na da la sogs pa las so/ na da/ gau ra/ gau ta mi/ tsa turthī/ pañtsa mi/ pi tanta/ sharba ra la sogs pa la yang*/ īp ster te/ i a dag gi dbyi ste/ na dī/ gau rī/ gau ta mī/ tsa turthī pañtsa mī/ bī baṃ tī/ sharba rī zhes par 'gyur ro/ ༈ind+rā de rā ṇā+-i p tsa/ ind+ra la sogs pa las ā nīp yang ngo*/ /ind+ra la sogs pa rtags mang po la/ ā ṇīp ster te/ 'dra ba ring po byas pas/

ind+rā ṇī/ bha bā ṇī/ ru drā ṇī/ ༈īp sa mā hū re gu ṇashtsa/ īp mnyam par bsre ba la yon tan yang ngo*/ /mnyam par bsre pa'i don can gyi mthar īp byin pa la gong ma yon tan dgos te/ dper/ tra ya ṇī/ zhes gsum rnams/ be dā nāṃ/ zhes pa rig byed rnams zhes pa tshig de dag dang*/ rig byed gsum po sdoms par byed pa la/ /be dā nāṃ gsal bar brjod don yin pas phyis/ nuṭ kyi n yang brjod don/ /tshig sdud rnam dbye ām phyis/ t y tsam las p rkyen phyis pas rang gnas su ldog/tri ru song*/ īp ī e ru song*/ e y ru drangs/ trā yī/ ༈pho dang ldan pa la yang īp'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ shū dra la/ īp/ i a dbyi/ drangs/ shū drī/ dmangs rigs kyi chung ma zhes skyes pa yang go ba lta bu ste/ ga ṇa kī/ rtsis mkhan gyi chung ma zhes pas rtsis mkhan yang go ba la sogs pa'o/ /yang zhes pas/ go bā la ka phyugs rdzi'i don te/ de dang sbyor ba la mo rkyen du īp mi 'byung ste/ āp kho na'o/ /kāp a ta kyi i'o/ /zhes pa/ la li ru song*/ go bā li kā/ zhes sogs mang po dag go ༈ dzā te ra yo ba dhāt/ rigs las ya ma yin pa'i u pa nghā las so/ /rigs brjod pa'i don la u pa dhā la ya yig med pa zhig byung na/ de la īp thob ste/ bud med kyi don du sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa gzhir bzhag pa la'o/ /me ṣa/ ma hi ṣa/ shū ka ra/ haṃ sa/ kūka ṭa/ brāhmaṇ/ zhes pa rnams la īp byin/ rtags mtha'i a phyis/ me ṣī/ ma hi ṣī/ shū ka rī/ haṃ sī/ kūkku ṭī/ brahma ṇī/ zhes par gyur pa sogs shin du mang po'o/ ༈ya min pa zhes pas u pa dhā ya yig yin na īp mi ster te/ kṣa tri ya dang*/ bai shya īp mi thob/ mo rtags su byed na/ āp byin te/ kṣa tri yā/ bai shyā zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈dang po'i na tshod brjod pa la/ at las īp'o/ /zhes bshad pas/

rgan po dang dar bab la sogs pa'i don mi brjod par/ na tshod dang po byis pa dang gzhon nu brjod pa mo rtags la īp thob ste/ ku mā ra/ īp rtags mtha'i a phyis/ ku mā rī/ ki sho rī/ ka la bhī la sogs pa mang po'o/ ༈dang po'i na tshod smos pas/ pṛddha dang*/ sthā bi rā ches rgas pa/ zhes pa lta bu mo rtags la āp ster ro/ ༈a t las zhes pas/ dang po'i na tshod yin kyang*/ i u sogs la/ īp mi thob ste/ shi shuḥzhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈swāṃ gāṅgā lus mdzes la zer/ rang lus la yang na'o/ /rang rang gi lus kyi yan lag gi don brjod pa la mo rtags sbyor na/ īp ster/ yang na īp bkag ste/ āp ster zhes pa yin na/ rang lus zhes pa'i rang gi don shes pa po dang bcas pa ster/ sems rgyud kyi bzung ba'i don no/ /yang na'-i don yang rtags gcig la/ yang na bar sbyor ba min te/ yan lag gi don can gyi mo rtags su bsgrub rgyu'i sde tshan gcig la īp dang*/ gcig shos la āp ster ba'i don no/ /su mu kha la/ īp/ i a dbyi/ drangs/ su mu khī/ de bzhin du/ mṛ gakṣa la/ mṛ gakṣī/ ta nwa gaṃ lus phra la/ ta nwadgī/ la sogs shin du mang po'o/ ༈yang na ba'i don/ padma ba da na lta bu mo rtags su īpa ྄mi ster te/ āp ster bas/ 'dra ba ring bo/ padma ba da nā/ de bzhin du/ ka ma la na ya na āp/ ka ma la na ya nā/ ka lyā ṇa kro ḍa āp/ ka lyā ṇa kro ḍā/ ki sha la ya ka ra āp/ ki sha la ya ka rā bu mo lo bcu gcig ma'am/ chu shing sdong po 'dra ba'i lag ma/ mṛṇā la bhu dza āp/ mṛ ṇā la bhu dzā zhes pa ni ku ba 'dra ba'i sa'i khri shing ring po gcig ste de dang 'dra ba lag pa ring bo'a'o/ su hasta āp/ su hasta/ de dag la sogs pa mang po zhig la īp mi 'jug go /༈kṛt kyi i yig kti min pa la īp yang na'o/ zhes bshad pa/ kṛt rkyen nang gi i yig yod pa'i rkyen yin pa/

kti ma yin pa de lta bu rkyen gyi mtha' can la īp ster ba dang mi ster ba gdam nga ste/ aṅgu la li/ īp byin na/ i a dbyi/ drangs/ aṅgu lī/ si 'jiga.īp ma byung na/ de la si byin pa rnam bcad/ aṅgu liḥ/ dhu li īp i phyis/ dhu lī/ yang na si rnam bcad dhu li ཿ/ a dzi īp byin pa la/ a dzi ma byin pa la/ a dziḥ/ de rnams kti can ma yin te/ de sogs gzhan yang ngo*/ ༈kti ma yin pa zhes pas/ kti rkyen mtha' can la/ īp mi 'byung ba kho na ste/ si rnam bcad du byas pas/ kṛ tiḥbhū tiḥ matiḥ bhṛ tiḥ dhṛ tiḥ/ la sogs pa'o/ /༈ai tsa ma nwā deḥ/ ma nu la sogs pa las ai yang ngo*/ /ma nu la sogs pa mo rtags su sgrub pa la/ īp sbyin na rtags mtha' ai ru 'gyur te/ ma nu īp/ ma nai/ ai ā ya/྄ mn ā y ī drangs/ ma nā yī/ tshangs pa'i bu ma nu zhes pa'i rgyal po bcu bzhi'i chung ma rnams la de 'drar brjod do/ yang zhes pas/ au ru bsgyur ba'ang yod de/ ma nu īp/ ma nau ī/ au ā b/ ma nā bī/ bṛ ṣā ka pā dbang phyug gi glang ste phyu mchog spre'u zer/ īp/ aibṛ ṣā ka pai/ ai ā y/ bṛ ṣā ka bā yī/ ༈patan+ya da yaḥ/ patan+ya la sogs pa'o/ /pa tnī bud med/ o nta rbatnī klas thams cad kyi nang nas nye ba ma/ sa khī grogs mo/ a sa khī grogs min mo/ /ardha dza ra tī phyed rgan mo/ u ba tī lang tsho ma/ a shi shrī phru gu med de mo gsham/ 'di rnams ni pā ta yin te/ /mo rtags su bsgyur bas 'gyur ba'o/ /pra tī tsyā da yaḥshapdā ni pā tyante/ pra tī tsa la sogs pa'i sgra ni pā ta rnams so/ /pra tī tsa la sogs pa ni/ pra tī tsī nub/ u dī tsī byang/ prā tsī shar/ a pā tsī shar lho/ la sogs pa mang po dag go /patni la sogs pa dang*/ pra tī tsā la sogs pa 'di rnams/ īp ster ba la ma ltos par/ patni la sogs pa dang*/ pra tī tsā la sogs par bsgyur ba kho nas mo rtags su grub pa'o/

༈ dā ra bud med kyi ming la sogs pa bud med la brjod pa yin mod*/ ap dang īp mi 'jug cing*/ rtags kyi ngo bo yang mo rtags ma yin te/ pho rtags yin no/ de'i phyir rnam dbye pho rtags dbyangs a'i mtha' can spyir btang bzhin yin pa las/ gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig mi 'jug pas dzas sogs mang tshig bdun po kho na 'jug ste/ dā rāḥ/ dā rān/ de raiḥ/ dā re bhyaḥ dā re bhyaḥ dā rā ṇāṃ/ dā re ṣu/ zhes 'byung ngo*/ /dā ra'i sgra 'jug yul bud med kho na yin kyang ming pho rtags yin no/ baurgu ṇā t/ yang na u yon tan la'o/ /tshul rol u yig mtha' can yon tan brjod pa'i don las/ pha rol tu bud med kyi rkyen īp ster ba dang mi ster ba gdam ka ste/ byin na/ pa ṭu īp/ i dang a yin na dbyi mod kyi/ 'dir u yin pas mi dbyi ste u b ru 'gyur/ pa ṭwī/ yang na zhes pas īp mi ster bas/ si rnam bcad de/ pa ṭuḥ/ de bzhin du/ mṛ dwī/ mṛ du 'jam mnyenaḥ ta nwī/ ta nu lus graḥ ṛ dzrī/ ri dzu 'jam klas maḥ zhes pa la sogs pa dag go ༈u ta ūḥ/ u ta las ū'o/ /u yig mtha' can gzhan bud med du sgrub na/ ūp zhes pa'i mo rkyen ster/ de yang gdam nga ste/ paṃ gu zhes pa la/ ūp byin/ 'dra ba las ring po/ si rnam bcad/ paṅgūḥ/ ūp ma byin na/ si rnam bcad tsam ste/ paṅguḥ bā mo rū ūp/ bā mo rū brla mdzes ma/ yang na bā mo ruḥ/ ka ra bho ru ūp/ ka ra gho rū lag mdzes glng mo'i sna zhagasaḥ ka ra bho ruḥ ༈yū nastiḥ yu ban las ti'o/ yu ban'i sgra la ti zhes pa'i rkyen ster te/ n phyis te/ yu ba ti/ si rnam bcad/ yu ba tiḥ/ zhes so/ /de ltar bshad pa de rnams ming gi pha rol du si sogs rkyen 'jug pa'i gnas sam gzhi ru sgrub pa'i bya byed de/ mo rtags su bsgrubs zin pa gong du bshad pa de thams cad la tshig tu sgrub pa'i phyir/

si sogs ster dgos pa las/ re zhig dper na si sbyin pa'i dbang du byas na āp'i mtha' la/ āp kyi si dbyi ba dang*/ īp mtha' la yang ha sa dang īp la si dbyi/ a nīp yang*/ īp tu gtogs/ gzhan ū dang ti la si rnam bcad do/ /āp mtha' kun la gaṅga dang 'dra/ īp mtha' kun la na dī dang 'dra/ ūp mtha' kun la bā dhū dang 'dra'o/ ༈mo rtags la byings las ming du grub tsam na mo rtags su rang grub pa dang*/ sngar ming du grub zin pa gcig slar mo rtags su bsgyur ba dang*/ mo'i don la skyes pa'i bya ba ste gsum mo/ ༈dang po ni/ st+ri dang mā tṛ la sogs pa yin la/ ༈gnyis pa la yang bsgyur ba tsam dang*/ mo rtags sgrub byed kyi rkyen byin pa gnyis so/ ༈dang po patni la sogs pa thung ngu pho rtags rnams ring po mo rtags su byas pa blos bzung ba tsam mo/ /de bzhin pra tyaṃ tsa/ pra tī tsī/ u dañtsa/ u dī tsī/ prāg/ prā tsī/ a bā tsa/ a bā tsi/ zhes par blos bzung zhing ngag gi bsgyur ba tsam yin gyi/ rkyen gyi byed pa can ma yin no/ /༈gnyis pa rkyen byin pas bsgyur ba la gzhung 'dir/ āp/ īp/ a ṇīp/ ūp ti zhes pa ste rkyen lnga bshad/ āp la dbye na/ sbyir btang yul nges pa dang ma nges pa gnyis/ dmigs gsal kāp la yang kāp spyi dang*/ dmigs gsal gyi yang dmigs gsal gnyis yod do/ /dīp dang ḍāp dang dīṣ dang*/ ūng*/ tsāpa/ ti dang*/ ṣyang ste bdun/ zhes pa ltar bud med kyi rkyen bdun gzhung gzhan las bshad do/ ༈gsum pa bud med kyi don la skyes pa'i bya ba ni/ dā ra'i sgra la sogs pa'o/ ༈bud med kyi rtags ni bye brag ba yin pas gsar du sgrub tshul rgyas pa yod/ pho dang ma ning gi rtags ni phal cher rang grub ba'o/ /de ltar na/ bud med kyi rkyen gyis mo rtags su 'gro tshul rags pa ni de tsam mo/ bud med kyi rkyena'ajug tshul bshad zin to/

/༈ da ni byed pa can gyi le'u'i don cung zad bshad par bya'o/ /de yang byed pa can dang byed pa can ma yin pa'i dbye ba bshad pa la/ tshig nyung ba'i phyir byed can gyi le'ur ming btags pa yin gyi/ don la le'u 'dir/ rnam dbye thams cad kyi 'jug pa'i yul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de yang rnam dbye sde tshan bdun las/ don tsam ste dngos po'am rdzas gtso bor brjod pa ni dang po yin la/ dngos don de'i khyad par dang 'brel ba'i ldog pa nyid thun mong min pa'i brjod byar byed pa ni phyi ma drug go /byed po bya ba byed pa las bzhi'i don gtso bor ston pa byed can du grags pa ni/ dang po sogs lnga dang bdun pa ste/ sde tshan drug po de yin la/ sde tshan drug pa ni 'brel ba gtso bor ston pas byed can du mi 'jog go de dag las rnam dbye dang po'i yul bshad pa ni/ ༈ liṅgārthe pra tha mā/ rtags kyi don la dang po'o/ /'dir rtags dang ming dang sgra zhes bya ba rags par na don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su bya'o/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ ji skad du/ rtags la sogs pa yang dang po'i don no/ /zhes 'byung ste/ sogs pa ni bod pa la sogs pa'o/ rtags zhes pas pho rtags/ mo rtags/ ma ning gi rtags gsum car bsdus te/ byings la kṛt mtha'i rkyen byin pas/ byings las 'gyur te ming du grub la/ si sogs dang ti sogs kyi rnam dbye'i rkyen ma byin pa de la rtags zhes bya ste/ ming dngos yin la/ ming gi mthar si sogs kyi rkyen byin zin pa dang*/ byings kyi mthar ti sogs kyi rnam dbye'i cho ga grub zin pa ni/ tshig zhes bya ste/ de'i nang na ming yod kyang*/ mthar gzhan du gyur/ mthar gzhan du gyur pa sogs kyi phyir/ rtags kho na dang*/ ming rkyang ba dang ming tsam ma yin no/ /skabs 'dir ming gi mthar si sogs byin pa'i cho ga grub pa na/ ming las yongs su gyur te tshig tu grub pa zhes bya ste/

byings las ming du sgrubs/ ming las tshig tu sgrubs pa'o/ /'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ti sogs kyi rkyen rnams kyis ni/ phal cher ming ma brgyud par byings nyid las tshig tu sgrub par byed do/ /de ltar na skabs 'dir 'brel bar rkyen bor ba zhes pa ni/ gong du rnam dbye spangs shing zhes bshad pa dang don gcig pas/ rnam dbye'i rkyen kho na ma byin pa la zer gyi /rkyen yin tshad la 'jog pa ma yin te/ rkyen du mas ming du sgrub zin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈de lta bu'i ming de la yang*/ dgos pa ni don yod pa tsam ston pa'i tshig tu sgrub pa'i phyir/ rnam dbye dang po 'jug ste/ ji skad du snyan tshigs gi rig byed las/ ta t+sadb+ra hma zhes 'byung ba bsgyur na tshangs pa de yod pa'o/ zhes so/ de zhes pas lkog gyur go dgos la/ yod pa ni bden pa'o/ /brahma ni tshangs pa zhes pa ste/ grags shing grub pa'i skyes bu dang*/ sems rgyud tsam gyi gang zag dang*/ lha chen tshangs pa rnams la ci rigs par 'jug go /'dir tshangs pa zhes pa bden pa zhes dang 'brel bas/ sems tsam gyi skyais bu ste bdag la zer gyi /lha tshangs pa nyid la zer ba ma yin la/ gzhan yang 'di 'dra gnas skabs mang por go dgos so/ /grags shing grub pa'i skyes bu lha mi ni/ ngan par grags pa dang grub pa la mi zer gyi/ spyod pa bzang po'am/ bde bar kun la grangs shing dngos su de 'dra yin pa'i gang zag la zer ro/ bod ston mkhas rlom grub mtha'i bshad pa byed pa rnams kyis/ grags shing grub pa la tshangs pa dang*/ skyes bu tsam gyi tshangs pa dang*/ mes po lha tshangs pa'i dbye ba ma phyed par cal col smra bar byed do/ /dper na/ bu gcig tshangs pa mchog tu bden/ zhes pa'i tshangs pa'ang skyes bu sems la zer/ tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa ye min no/ don yod pa tsam zhes pa ni/ dngos po de'i don gyi ngo bo tsam ston gyi/ tsam zhes pas ldog pa'am khyad par mi ston pa'i don yin te/

lha zhes spyi ming nas brjod pa'am/ /brgya byin zhes dgos kyi ming nas brjod kyang rung khyad med de ngo bo tsam zhig ston no/ dngos po thams cad kyi ming la des rigs 'gre /ldog pa mi brjod ces pa yang*/ ldog pa'i khyad par gtan nas mi brjod pa ni ma yin te/ rnam dbye dang po la yang lha dag lha rnams zhes gnyis dang mang po brjod pa yang*/ /lha'i ldog pa'i khyad par brjod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du/ /ba lang dkar po la sogs pa'i khyad par brjod pa la yang rnam dbye dang po nyid 'jug ste/ las dang bya byed dang 'brel ba'i ldog pa'i khyad par mi brjod pa la 'dir ldog pa mi brjod ces pa'o/ /des na las su bya ba la sogs pa byed tshig rnams ni khyad par can gyi ldog pa brjod pa ste/ 'jim pa la sku gzugs bzhengs zhes brjod na/ /sku gzugs nyid 'jim pa las rdzas gzhan du ni med la/ gnyis po rnam pa thams cad du gcig na ni 'jim pa nyid sku gzugs su thal ba'i phyir/ las su bya ba'i yul 'jim pa la 'bras bu sku gzugs byed mi dgos par 'gyur na/ sku gzugs su gyur pa ni 'jim pa de'i ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'jim pa la zhes pa'i tshig phrad kyi la yig ni ldog pa sku gzugs lta bu de la 'jug gi /las su bya ba'i ldog pa gang yang med na/ la zhes pa'i tshig gi phrad la don stong pas/ phrad kyi sbyor ba des ni ldog pa las su bya ba de ston no/ ༈de bzhin du byed pa po'i ngo bo dang po'i tshig gis ston kyang*/ byed por mtshon pa'i tshig gi nus pa bya ba'i tshig dang byed pa'i tshig la yod pas byed pa por 'jog byed/ dper na byed pa'i tshig lag pas/ mang pos/ gnyis kyis zhes pa'i pas/ pos kyi zhes pa'i yul ni byed pa'i ldog pa la 'jog pa dang*/ ༈ched du bya ba yang*/ yul las dang byed pa po 'dzom pa'i ldog pa yin pa dang*/ ༈des mtshon te gnas gzhi'i bar du yang*/ byed tshig rnams kyis dngos su ldog pa nyid brjod par byed do/

༈'dir dang po'i don la dper brjod kyi tshigs bcad gzhan gyis bshad pa ni/ ra bi ri ba rā dza te rā dzā/ ro ṣā tku mā rī ro rū ya te/ bo bhu dzya te bhu baṃ bhū pā laḥ/ prā gā staṃ rā ma lakṣ+ma ṇau/ de bod skad du/ nyi ma 'dra bar rgyal po gsal bar byed/ /gzhon nu ma ni khros las ngu bar byed/ sa la longs spyod byed de sa skyong ba/ dga' byed mtshan ldan dag ni sngon dus byung*/ zhes te/ rā dzā zhes pa rgyal po/ rnam dbye dang po byed pa po'i don tsam ston pa'i dpe yin/ /gcig tshig gi rkyen si'o/ rā dzan si/ u pa dhā ring po/ /si dang n dbyi ba'o/ /rā dza te zhes pa gsal bar byed ces te bya ba'i tshig go nyi ma dang 'dra dper brjod pa yin kyang byed pa ston no/ /nyi mas mun pa sel dngos po gsal bar byed pa/ rgyal pos kyang khrims dag pas skye bo rnams bya byed kyi rim pa go bar byed do/ ku mā rī ni gzhon nu ma ste byed pa po/ bud med la si phyis dang po'i gcig tshig yin/ ro rū ya te ni ngu bar byed de/ bya ba'i tshig go /bhū pā laḥ/ sa skyong pa ste byed pa po dang*/ dang po'i gcig tshig si rnam bcad/ bhu baṃ zhes pa sa la ste gnyis pa las kyi tshig am gyi rjes so/ /bo bhū dzya te longs spyaud par bya ba ste kṛ ya'i tshig go /ṇau zhes dang po'i gnyis tshig au'i rjes so/ /de ni rā ma dga' byed/ lakṣ+ma ṇa rā ma'i nu bo mtshan nyid ldan te/ de dag la dngos po dang ngo bo dang byed po gnyis yod pas so/ /prā ga a staṃ/ sngon byung ba zhes pa kṛ ya pa da'o/ /dpe kha gcig las/ bhu pā lāḥ/ sa skyong rnams zhes dzas kyi rjes yod na/ dang po'i mang tshig dper brjod do/ /yang santi santaḥki yantaḥlegs par byed pa/ legs pa ji tsam zhes pa ste/ santi legs par byed/ santaḥlegs pa po/ ki yantaḥci tsam zhes te/ spyod tshul legs pa'i skyes bu legs po bzang po mang nyung ji tsam yod ces pa la/

santaḥbyed po'i tshig dang*/ /santi bya ba'i tshig go /de bzhin du/ ku mā rāḥshe ra te swai raṃ/ ro rū yante tsa nā ra kāḥ ye gī yante tsa gī ta dzñāḥ/ me mṛ yante ru dzā dzi tāḥ de bsgyur na/ rang dga' nyol shig gzhon nu rnams/ /dmyal ba pa rnams ngu bar byed/ /glu shes gang rnams glu len te/ /nad las rgyal min 'chi 'gyur bdag/ces so/ /ku mā rāḥni gzhon nu rnams zhes byed po ste/ dang po'i mang tshig dzas/ she ra te ni nyol shigakṛ ya pa da swai raṃ rang dgar zhes pa ste/ byed pa brjod pa yin mi zad pa'o/ /nā ra kāḥ/ dmyal ba pa rnams te/ karta'i tshig dang po'i mang tshig dzas so/ ngu bar byed ces pa bya ba'i tshig go/ ye zhes pa gang rnams/ gī ta dzñāḥglu shes pa rnams/ zhes pa byed po dang po'i mang tshig/glu len pa ni bya ba'o/ /ru dza nad/ a dzi tāḥ/ rgyal ba ma yin pa'o/ /nad kyi sdug bsngal ni rigs mang bas sam/ yang chen po la yang mang tshig 'jug pas/ tāḥzhes dzas kyi rnam 'gyur byung gi /nad pa mi mang po'i don ma yin te/ bdag ces gcig pur 'chad pas so/ /'chi 'gyur ni bya ba yin/ bdag ces pa las tshig go /'di rnams dang po'i mang tshig dper brjod pa'o/ ༈ ā mand+ra ṇe tsa/ bod pa la yang ngo*/ ā mand+ra zhes pa'i bod pa ni/ pho nya btang ste 'gugs pas 'bod pa lta bu dang*/ lag brda la sogs pas ma yin te/ abhi mu kha zhes pa mngon du phyogs pa'am*/ dngos su mthong thos kyi yul skad kyis bod pa'o/ /bod pa'i don la rnam dbye dang po kho na ste/ /dang po'i ni gcig tshig gnyis tshigamang tshig thams cad 'jug tu rung ngo*/ /gnyis pa la sogs pa gzhan mi 'jug ste/ las sogs ston pa'i tshig 'ga' bod pa'i zla la byung srid na'ang*/ de 'dra dang 'dres pa yin gyi /des bod par mi 'gyur te/ rta la zhon pa'i mi zhes bos na/ rta la zhes pa bdun pa'i tshig yin kyang*/ de ni bod pa min la/ ming zhes pa de la bod tshig 'jug ste/
